items.name: 风险与模糊决策
items.description: 被试在确定收益与赌局之间选择，赌局结果概率或已知（风险）或未知（模糊），如 Ellsberg 罐子问题。模糊性增加杏仁核与眶额 BOLD 活动，而纹状体活动与期望奖赏相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants choose between a certain payoff and gambles whose outcome probabilities are either known (risk) or unknown (ambiguity), as in the Ellsberg urn problem. Ambiguity increases amygdala and orbitofrontal BOLD activity, whereas striatal activity correlates with expected reward.

items.name: 类比推理
items.description: 被试判断两组词对是否具有相同关系（A:B :: C:D），并与只判断语义联想的条件比较，以区分关系整合与语义提取。类比整合激活前额叶喙外侧（额极）区，而语义提取激活前部额下回。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants judge whether two word pairs share the same relation (A:B :: C:D) compared with judging semantic association alone, so that relational integration can be separated from semantic retrieval. Analogical integration engages rostrolateral (frontopolar) prefrontal cortex, whereas retrieval engages anterior inferior frontal cortex.

items.name: 注意网络测试
items.description: 一种带提示的 Flanker 任务：警示提示与空间提示先于被一致或不一致箭头包围的目标箭头出现，从而分别得到警觉、定向和执行控制的反应时指标。提示诱发视觉 N1 与关联性负变，目标诱发 P3。
items.descriptionEnglish: A cued flanker task in which warning and spatial cues precede an arrow flanked by congruent or incongruent arrows, yielding separate reaction-time measures of alerting, orienting and executive control. Cues elicit visual N1 and contingent negative variation, and targets elicit a P3.

items.name: 注意网络测试-交互版（ANT-I）
items.description: 注意网络测试的一个版本：警觉由听觉提示音操纵，定向由有效或无效的外周视觉线索操纵，再与一致或不一致的箭头 flanker 组合，从而测量警觉、定向与执行控制之间的交互。
items.descriptionEnglish: A version of the Attention Network Test in which alerting is manipulated with an auditory warning tone and orienting with valid or invalid peripheral visual cues, combined with congruent or incongruent arrow flankers, so that interactions among alerting, orienting and executive control can be measured.

items.name: 反向眼跳
items.description: 外周目标出现时，被试须抑制朝向目标的反射性眼跳，转而注视其镜像位置（反向眼跳），常与正向眼跳试次混合呈现。眼跳准备伴随 EEG 中的眼跳前电位和动眼网络（额叶眼区、顶叶）的 BOLD 活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: When a peripheral target appears, participants must suppress the reflexive saccade towards it and instead look to the mirror location (antisaccade), often intermixed with prosaccade trials. Preparation is accompanied by presaccadic potentials in EEG and by oculomotor (frontal eye field, parietal) BOLD activity.

items.name: 替代用途任务（发散思维）
items.description: 给被试一个日常物品，要求在限定时间内想出尽可能多的新颖用途，并与创造性较低的对照任务比较。创造性观点生成伴随额区和后部 α 功率的任务相关升高。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are given an everyday object and generate as many original uses for it as possible within a time limit, compared with a less creative control task. Creative idea generation is accompanied by task-related increases in alpha power at frontal and posterior sites.

items.name: 气球模拟风险任务
items.description: 被试为虚拟气球充气，每充一次获得一定金钱，并可随时存入收益；若气球在其随机爆破点爆炸，该气球的收益全部损失。结果反馈诱发 FRN，fMRI 中冒险行为激活背外侧前额叶。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants pump up a virtual balloon, earning money for each pump, and can bank the money at any time; if the balloon bursts at its random explosion point, the money for that balloon is lost. Outcome feedback elicits the FRN, and risk taking engages dorsolateral prefrontal cortex in fMRI.

items.name: S1-S2 预期任务
items.description: 警示刺激（S1）出现后经固定间隔呈现要求快速反应的命令刺激（S2）。在 S1–S2 间隔中，额中央头皮区逐渐形成一个缓慢的负向偏移，即关联性负变（CNV）。
items.descriptionEnglish: A warning stimulus (S1) is followed after a fixed interval by an imperative stimulus (S2) that requires a speeded response. During the S1-S2 interval a slow negative shift, the contingent negative variation, develops over fronto-central scalp sites.

items.name: 决策信心判断（知觉元认知）
items.description: 每次知觉决策后，被试在从“肯定错误”到“肯定正确”的量表上评定对决策正确性的信心。反应后错误正波（Pe）的波幅随信心连续变化，把信心判断与错误检测联系起来。
items.descriptionEnglish: After each perceptual decision, participants rate their confidence that the decision was correct, on a scale ranging from certainly wrong to certainly correct. The amplitude of the post-response error positivity varies continuously with confidence, linking confidence judgements and error detection.

items.name: 持续操作测验（X-CPT）
items.description: 被试监视长时间、快速呈现的字母流，每当目标字母出现即作反应，需要持续数分钟的注意。目标诱发 P3。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants monitor a long, rapid stream of letters and respond whenever a target letter appears, which requires sustained attention over many minutes. Targets elicit a P3.

items.name: AX 持续操作任务（AX-CPT）
items.description: 字母以线索–探测刺激对呈现：只有当探测刺激 X 跟在线索 A 之后（AX，最常见）才作目标反应，对 AY、BX、BY 作非目标反应，从而测量线索情境的保持及其对优势反应的抑制。线索诱发为探测刺激做准备的关联性负变，探测刺激诱发 P3。
items.descriptionEnglish: Letters are presented as cue-probe pairs, and participants make a target response only to the probe X when it follows the cue A (AX, most frequent), and a non-target response to AY, BX and BY pairs, so that maintenance of cue context and its use to inhibit a prepotent response can be measured. Cues elicit a contingent negative variation in preparation for the probe, and probes elicit a P3.

items.name: 渐变呈现持续操作任务（gradCPT）
items.description: 场景图片（如城市与山景）逐张渐变过渡，没有突然出现；被试对常见类别作反应、对罕见类别抑制。反应时变异性的逐刻波动划分出"专注"与"走神"两种注意状态，二者伴随不同的默认模式网络活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Scene images (e.g., cities and mountains) gradually morph from one to the next without abrupt onsets; participants respond to the frequent category and withhold to the rare one. Moment-to-moment fluctuations in response-time variability define 'in the zone' and 'out of the zone' attentional states, which are associated with differing default-mode activity.

items.name: 延迟折扣
items.description: 被试反复在较早可得的较小奖赏与延迟后可得的较大奖赏之间选择，由无差异点得到折扣函数。fMRI 中，腹侧纹状体与腹内侧前额叶的活动反映选项的主观价值。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants repeatedly choose between a smaller reward available sooner and a larger reward available after a delay, and the indifference points yield a discount function. In fMRI, ventral striatum and ventromedial prefrontal activity tracks the subjective value of the options.

items.name: 双任务
items.description: 两个各需单独快速反应的刺激以可变的刺激起始间隔先后呈现；间隔越短，对第二个刺激的反应越慢（心理不应期）。对第二个刺激的 P3 潜伏期和额中线 θ 被用来定位和量化中枢加工瓶颈。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two stimuli, each requiring its own speeded response, are presented with a variable stimulus onset asynchrony; responses to the second stimulus slow down as the asynchrony shortens (psychological refractory period). The latency of the P3 to the second stimulus and frontal midline theta are used to localise and quantify the central processing bottleneck.

items.name: 努力决策
items.description: 被试在低努力、低奖赏选项与高努力（如更多按键或更难的认知任务）、高奖赏选项之间选择，奖赏概率常被同时操纵。努力代价的评估与背侧前扣带 BOLD 活动相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants choose between a low-effort option with a small reward and a high-effort option (e.g., more button presses or a harder cognitive task) with a larger reward, often under varying reward probability. Effort-cost valuation is associated with dorsal anterior cingulate BOLD activity.

items.name: Flanker 任务（字母版）
items.description: 被试辨认中央目标字母，其两侧干扰字母对应相同（相容）或相反（不相容）的反应。不相容试次诱发额中央 N2，错误反应诱发错误相关负波（ERN），随后出现错误正波（Pe）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants identify a central target letter flanked by noise letters that are associated with the same (compatible) or the opposite (incompatible) response. Incompatible trials elicit a fronto-central N2, and erroneous responses elicit the error-related negativity followed by the error positivity.

items.name: Flanker 任务（箭头版）
items.description: 被试判断中央箭头的方向，两侧箭头指向相同（一致）或相反（不一致）方向。箭头版是目前 ERP 研究的标准形式：错误诱发 ERN 与 Pe，不一致试次诱发额中央 N2，干扰箭头引起先偏向错误手的偏侧化准备电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants indicate the direction of a central arrow flanked by arrows pointing in the same (congruent) or the opposite (incongruent) direction. The arrow version is the standard form in current ERP research, where errors elicit the ERN and Pe, incongruent trials a fronto-central N2, and flankers an initial lateralised readiness potential towards the wrong hand.

items.name: 觅食决策（留守/探索）
items.description: 被试决定是接受当前提供的选项，还是付出代价在环境中搜索其他选项，因而觅食的价值取决于环境的平均价值。背侧前扣带 BOLD 活动反映搜索的价值和环境平均价值。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants decide whether to engage with a currently offered option or to search the environment for alternatives at a cost, so that the value of foraging depends on the average value of the environment. Dorsal anterior cingulate BOLD activity tracks the value of searching and the average environmental value.

items.name: Go/NoGo
items.description: 被试对高频的 Go 刺激快速反应，对低频的 NoGo 刺激抑制反应。成功抑制的 NoGo 试次诱发增强的额中央 N2，随后出现额中央的 NoGo-P3。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants respond quickly to frequent Go stimuli and withhold the response to infrequent NoGo stimuli. Correctly withheld NoGo trials elicit an enhanced fronto-central N2 followed by a fronto-central NoGo-P3.

items.name: 爱荷华赌博任务
items.description: 被试反复从四副牌中抽牌，各牌组的得失安排不同，其中两副即时收益大但长期损失更大。损失和收益反馈诱发 FRN，腹内侧前额叶活动与有利选择相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants repeatedly draw cards from four decks that differ in their schedules of gains and losses; two decks give large immediate gains but larger long-term losses. Loss and gain feedback elicits the FRN, and ventromedial prefrontal activity relates to advantageous choice.

items.name: 混合赌局（损失厌恶）
items.description: 被试接受或拒绝胜负各半的赌局，每个赌局包含大小独立变化的潜在收益与潜在损失，损失通常比收益权重更大。纹状体与腹内侧前额叶 BOLD 活动随潜在收益增加而升高，随潜在损失增加而降低。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants accept or reject 50/50 gambles that combine a potential gain and a potential loss of independently varied sizes, and losses are typically weighted more heavily than gains. Striatal and ventromedial prefrontal BOLD activity increases with potential gains and decreases with potential losses.

items.name: 掩蔽反应启动
items.description: 短暂呈现并被掩蔽的启动刺激（如向左或向右的箭头）先于需要左/右反应的可见目标出现，启动与目标相容或不相容。偏侧化准备电位显示启动刺激所对应的反应先被部分激活，在较长的启动–目标间隔下随后出现反转（负相容效应）。
items.descriptionEnglish: A briefly presented, masked prime (e.g., a left- or right-pointing arrow) precedes a visible target that requires a left or right response, with prime and target compatible or incompatible. The lateralised readiness potential shows partial activation of the prime-assigned response followed, at longer prime-target intervals, by a reversal (negative compatibility effect).

items.name: 多源干扰任务
items.description: 被试看到三个数字，报告与另两个不同的那个数字；干扰试次中目标数字的身份与其位置冲突，且两侧数字本身也是可选反应，从而合并了 Stroop、Flanker 与 Simon 型干扰。干扰试次在个体被试中稳定地增加背侧前扣带 BOLD 活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants see three digits and report the identity of the one that differs from the other two; on interference trials the target's identity conflicts with its position and flanking digits are possible responses, combining Stroop-, flanker- and Simon-type interference. Interference trials reliably increase dorsal anterior cingulate BOLD activity in individual subjects.

items.name: 知觉决策（随机点运动，按试次）
items.description: 被试观看随机点运动图，其中一部分（比例可变）点一致运动，被试报告整体运动方向。感觉证据的累积反映在中央顶区正波（CPP）上，其上升速率与运动一致性成正比，并在决策时刻前后达到峰值。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants view a random-dot kinematogram in which a variable fraction of dots moves coherently and report the net motion direction. Sensory evidence accumulation is reflected in a centro-parietal positivity that builds up at a rate proportional to motion coherence and peaks around the decision.

items.name: 连续监视随机点运动任务
items.description: 被试持续观看无一致运动的随机点画面，在不可预测的时刻、没有任何突然起始地出现一段一致运动，被试一旦察觉即报告其方向。由于证据开始时没有感觉瞬变，中央顶正波的累积过程可与刺激诱发活动分离。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants continuously watch an incoherent random-dot display, and at unpredictable times a period of coherent motion appears without any abrupt onset; they report its direction as soon as they detect it. Because evidence onset is not marked by a sensory transient, the build-up of the centro-parietal positivity can be isolated from stimulus-evoked activity.

items.name: 远距离联想（创造力）
items.description: 被试看到三个线索词，须找出能与每个词构成复合词或联想的第四个词，并常需报告答案是否通过顿悟获得。顿悟解答之前出现后部 α 功率的变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are shown three cue words and must find a fourth word that forms a compound or association with each of them, often reporting whether the solution came by insight. Insight solutions are preceded by changes in posterior alpha power.

items.name: 瑞文推理
items.description: 被试观看一个缺失一格的几何图案矩阵，依据其中的关系规则选出能补全矩阵的图块。解答矩阵问题激活 fMRI 中的外侧额顶网络，且随需要整合的关系数量增加而增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants view a matrix of geometric patterns with one cell missing and select the piece that completes it according to the underlying relational rules. Solving matrix problems engages a lateral frontoparietal network in fMRI, increasing with the number of relations to integrate.

items.name: 随机数生成
items.description: 被试尽可能随机地生成一串数字（或字母），通常由声音提示节拍，这需要抑制如顺序计数之类的习惯性序列。随机生成增加背外侧前额叶血流，对该区域施加 TMS 会增加习惯性计数。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants generate a sequence of numbers (or letters) as randomly as possible, typically paced by a tone, which requires suppression of habitual sequences such as counting. Random generation increases dorsolateral prefrontal blood flow, and TMS over this region increases habitual counting.

items.name: 持续注意反应任务（SART）
items.description: 数字以固定的快速节奏呈现，被试对除罕见目标（如 3）以外的每个数字都要反应，因此抑制反应依赖于对原本自动化反应的持续注意。成功抑制的目标诱发 NoGo-P3，刺激前后部 α 功率与注意失误相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Digits are presented at a fixed rapid rate and participants respond to every digit except a rare target (e.g., 3), so that withholding requires sustained attention to an otherwise automatic response. Withheld targets elicit a NoGo-P3, and pre-stimulus posterior alpha power relates to attentional lapses.

items.name: Simon 任务（听觉版）
items.description: 被试对呈现于左耳或右耳的听觉刺激的非空间特征作左/右键反应，与任务无关的刺激侧别与反应侧一致或不一致。不一致试次反应变慢，并诱发额中央 N2 及先偏向错误手的偏侧化准备电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants respond with a left or right key to a non-spatial feature of an auditory stimulus presented to the left or right ear, while the task-irrelevant stimulus side corresponds or does not correspond to the response side. Non-corresponding trials slow responses and elicit a fronto-central N2 and an initial lateralised readiness potential towards the incorrect hand.

items.name: Simon 任务（视觉版）
items.description: 被试对出现在注视点左侧或右侧的刺激的颜色（或形状）作左/右键反应，与任务无关的刺激位置与反应侧一致或不一致。不一致试次反应变慢，并诱发额中央 N2 及先偏向错误手的偏侧化准备电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants respond with a left or right key to the colour (or shape) of a stimulus presented to the left or right of fixation, while the irrelevant stimulus location corresponds or not to the response side. Non-corresponding trials slow responses and elicit a fronto-central N2 and an initial lateralised readiness potential towards the incorrect hand.

items.name: 停止信号任务
items.description: 被试对 Go 刺激反应；在少数试次中，Go 刺激之后以可变延迟出现停止信号，要求被试取消已启动的反应，并依据竞赛模型估计停止信号反应时。成功停止诱发额中央的停止 P3，并伴随右额下回 β 频段活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants respond to a go stimulus, and on a minority of trials a stop signal follows after a variable delay, instructing them to cancel the response already initiated; stop-signal reaction time is estimated from a race model. Successful stopping elicits a fronto-central stop-P3 and is accompanied by right inferior frontal beta-band activity.

items.name: Stroop 任务（卡片版，口头命名）
items.description: 被试尽快口头命名一整张卡片或列表上颜色词的墨水颜色（词义与墨色不一致），与命名色块相比，多用的时间即为干扰量。神经记录多用单试次版本（CTL-STR-002），其中不一致试次诱发 N450。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants name aloud, as fast as possible, the ink colours of a list or card of colour words printed in incongruent colours, compared with naming colour patches; the extra time needed for the incongruent list measures interference. Neural recordings mostly use single-trial versions (CTL-STR-002), in which incongruent trials elicit the N450.

items.name: Stroop 任务（单试次计算机化颜色词）
items.description: 颜色词逐个以一致或不一致的墨水颜色呈现，被试在每个试次上报告墨色，通常按键（也可口头）。不一致试次反应变慢，并诱发约 450 ms 达峰的额中央负波（N450）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Colour words are presented one at a time in a congruent or incongruent ink colour, and participants report the ink colour on each trial, usually by button press (or vocally). Incongruent trials slow responses and elicit a fronto-central negativity peaking around 450 ms (N450).

items.name: 任务切换（交替序列）
items.description: 被试按可预测的顺序（如两次任务甲、两次任务乙）在同一刺激上交替完成两个简单任务，切换试次的反应慢于重复试次。切换试次伴随后部切换相关正波与额中线 θ 增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants alternate between two simple tasks on the same stimuli in a predictable sequence (e.g., two trials of one task, then two of the other), and responses are slower on switch than on repeat trials. Switch trials are associated with a posterior switch-related positivity and increased frontal midline theta.

items.name: 线索提示任务切换
items.description: 每个刺激前呈现一个显式线索，告诉被试本试次完成两个任务中的哪一个，任务顺序随机，因而可分离线索加工、准备（线索–刺激间隔）与任务重构。切换试次慢于重复试次，并诱发线索锁时的切换正波与额中线 θ 增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: An explicit cue presented before each stimulus tells the participant which of two tasks to perform, with the task sequence random, so that cue processing, preparation (cue-stimulus interval) and task reconfiguration can be separated. Switch trials are slower than repeat trials and elicit a cue-locked switch positivity and increased frontal midline theta.

items.name: 自主任务切换
items.description: 被试在每个试次上自由选择完成两个任务中的哪一个，通常被要求两任务大致同样频繁、顺序随机，因而任务选择与切换代价反映内部产生的控制，而非外部线索。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants freely choose on each trial which of two tasks to perform, usually instructed to perform both about equally often and in a random order, so that task choice and switch costs reflect internally generated control rather than external cues.

items.name: 三段论推理
items.description: 被试判断三段论或其他演绎论证的结论是否在逻辑上由前提推出，论证内容可为具体、抽象或与信念相关。演绎推理激活分布式、偏左侧的额叶与顶叶网络，包括喙部前额叶。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants evaluate whether the conclusion of a syllogism or other deductive argument follows logically from its premises, with content that is concrete, abstract or belief-laden. Deductive inference engages a distributed left-lateralised frontal and parietal network, including rostral prefrontal cortex.

items.name: 伦敦塔（计划）
items.description: 被试规划以最少步数把木桩上的彩球从初始状态重排为目标状态，问题难度由所需步数决定。规划负荷增加 fMRI 中的背外侧前额叶活动，以及 fNIRS 中前额叶的氧合血红蛋白。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants plan the minimum sequence of moves needed to rearrange coloured balls on pegs from a start state into a goal state, with problem difficulty set by the number of moves. Planning load increases dorsolateral prefrontal activity in fMRI and prefrontal oxygenated haemoglobin in fNIRS.

items.name: 基于价值的选择（支付意愿）
items.description: 饥饿的被试观看食物，并在激励相容的拍卖中出价表示愿意为每种食物支付多少，从而得到逐试次的主观目标价值指标。内侧眶额/腹内侧前额叶 BOLD 活动随支付意愿增加而升高。
items.descriptionEnglish: Hungry participants view food items and bid how much they are willing to pay for each in an incentive-compatible auction, providing a trial-wise measure of subjective goal value. Medial orbitofrontal/ventromedial prefrontal BOLD activity scales with willingness to pay.

items.name: Wason 选择任务
items.description: 被试看到四张卡片和一条条件规则（“如果 P 则 Q”），须选出需要翻开以检验规则是否成立的卡片；成绩强烈依赖规则内容。该任务的神经影像研究报告基于规则推理时外侧前额叶的活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are shown four cards and a conditional rule ('if P then Q') and must select the cards that need to be turned over to test whether the rule holds; performance depends strongly on rule content. Neuroimaging studies of the task report lateral prefrontal activity during rule-based reasoning.

items.name: 威斯康星卡片分类
items.description: 被试按颜色、形状或数量对卡片分类，分类规则须从对/错反馈中推断，连续正确若干次后规则会无提示地改变。规则转换激活背外侧前额叶（fMRI、fNIRS），提示需要转换的反馈诱发 P3。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants sort cards by colour, shape or number according to a rule they must infer from right/wrong feedback, and the rule changes without warning after a run of correct sorts. Rule shifts engage dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (fMRI, fNIRS), and feedback signalling a shift elicits a P3.

items.name: 情感（评价）启动
items.description: 短暂呈现的启动词或图片之后出现靶刺激，被试判断其为正性或负性；启动与靶刺激效价一致时反应更快。效价不一致的靶刺激诱发更大的 N400，并调制晚期正电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: A briefly presented prime word or picture is followed by a target that participants classify as positive or negative; responses are faster when prime and target share valence. Valence-incongruent targets elicit a larger N400 and modulate the late positive potential.

items.name: 自传体回忆情绪诱发
items.description: 被试在无外部情绪刺激的条件下提取并重新体验个人记忆，通常由线索词或事先准备的脚本引导。回忆情绪性与中性事件的差异体现在杏仁核 BOLD 与脑电频段功率的调制上。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants retrieve and relive personal memories, typically cued by words or by scripts prepared beforehand, without external affective stimuli. Recall of emotional versus neutral episodes modulates amygdala BOLD and EEG band power.

items.name: 点探测注意偏向任务
items.description: 两个线索（一个情绪性如威胁性、一个中性）短暂呈现于两个位置，随后探测刺激替换其中之一；对出现在情绪线索位置的探测刺激反应更快，即为注意偏向。在脑电中，情绪线索诱发 N2pc，并调制随后探测刺激的 P1。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two cues, one emotional (e.g. threatening) and one neutral, appear briefly at two locations, and a probe then replaces one of them; faster responses to probes at the emotional location index attentional bias. In EEG, the emotional cue elicits an N2pc and modulates the P1 to the subsequent probe.

items.name: 情绪 Stroop
items.description: 被试对情绪词和中性词的书写颜色进行命名；情绪词命名变慢反映了词义对注意的捕获，而非颜色—词义的反应冲突。情绪词增强 LPP，并调制额中央 N2。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants name the ink colour of emotionally charged and neutral words; slower naming for emotional words reflects attentional capture by word meaning rather than colour-word response conflict. Emotional words enhance the LPP and modulate the fronto-central N2.

items.name: 情绪面孔加工
items.description: 逐张呈现带有情绪或中性表情的面孔照片，被试被动观看或完成与表情无关的任务（如检测重复或靶刺激）。情绪表情调制脑电中的 N170 与早期后部负波，并增强杏仁核 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Photographs of faces with emotional or neutral expressions are presented one at a time, with passive viewing or an orthogonal task such as detecting a repeated or target stimulus. Emotional expressions modulate the N170 and the early posterior negativity in EEG and increase amygdala BOLD.

items.name: 情绪面孔匹配任务（Hariri）
items.description: 以组块形式进行：被试从屏幕下方两张面孔中选出与上方面孔表情（愤怒或恐惧）相同的一张，与匹配几何图形的组块交替进行。与图形组块相比，面孔组块增强杏仁核 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: In blocks, participants choose which of two faces at the bottom of the screen matches the expression of a face at the top (angry or fearful faces), alternating with blocks in which they match geometric shapes. Face blocks increase amygdala BOLD relative to shape blocks.

items.name: 巴甫洛夫恐惧条件化
items.description: 在一次实验中，中性条件刺激（CS+）多次与轻微电击或强噪声等厌恶性无条件刺激配对，对照刺激（CS-）从不配对，其后可接无电击的消退阶段。CS+ 与 CS- 的差异反应包括习得阶段杏仁核 BOLD 的变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: In one session, a neutral conditioned stimulus (CS+) is repeatedly paired with an aversive unconditioned stimulus such as a mild shock or loud noise, while a control stimulus (CS-) is never paired, and an extinction phase without shocks may follow. Differential CS+ > CS- responses include amygdala BOLD changes during acquisition.

items.name: 恐惧泛化（CS 相似度梯度）
items.description: 在差别条件化之后，呈现一组在 CS+ 与 CS- 之间按相似度逐级变化的泛化刺激（如大小分级的圆环），比较沿相似度梯度的反应。神经与自主反应随与 CS+ 相似度的降低而减弱。
items.descriptionEnglish: After differential conditioning, a set of generalization stimuli that vary stepwise in similarity between the CS+ and the CS- (for example rings of graded size) is presented, and responses are compared along the similarity gradient. Neural and autonomic responses decline with decreasing similarity to the CS+.

items.name: 两日恐惧条件化与消退回忆
items.english: Two-day fear conditioning with extinction recall
items.description: 第一天，CS+ 与厌恶刺激配对并随后消退；在之后的某一天再次呈现 CS（不给电击），检验消退记忆的回忆。消退回忆涉及腹内侧前额叶与杏仁核活动及额中线 θ。
items.descriptionEnglish: On day 1 a CS+ is paired with an aversive stimulus and then extinguished; on a later day the CS is presented again without shocks to test recall of extinction. Extinction recall involves ventromedial prefrontal and amygdala activity and frontomedial theta.

items.name: 影片片段离散情绪诱发
items.description: 被试观看经过验证的影片片段，每段用于诱发一种离散情绪（如愉悦、悲伤、恐惧、厌恶）或中性状态，每段之后报告情绪体验。持续的情绪状态以额叶 α 不对称与各频段功率模式为指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch validated film clips, each chosen to elicit one discrete emotion such as amusement, sadness, fear or disgust, or a neutral state, and report their emotional experience after each clip. Sustained affective states are indexed by frontal alpha asymmetry and by band-power patterns across frequency bands.

items.name: 音乐视频情绪诱发（维度评定）
items.english: Music-video emotion elicitation with dimensional ratings
items.description: 被试观看一分钟的音乐视频片段，每段之后评定唤醒度、效价、优势度、喜爱度与熟悉度；连续评分通常被划分为高、低两类用于脑电解码。效价与唤醒度与额叶 α 不对称及各频段功率模式有关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch one-minute excerpts of music videos and after each one rate arousal, valence, dominance, liking and familiarity; the continuous ratings are usually split into high and low classes for EEG decoding. Valence and arousal relate to frontal alpha asymmetry and band-power patterns.

items.name: 影片片段三分类效价诱发（SEED）
items.description: 被试观看用于诱发正性、中性或负性情绪的影片片段，每段前有简短提示，之后进行自评与休息；实验在不同日期重复进行。利用各频段的脑电微分熵与功率特征对三类情绪进行分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch film clips selected to induce positive, neutral or negative emotion, each preceded by a short hint and followed by self-assessment and rest, and the session is repeated on different days. EEG differential-entropy and band-power features across frequency bands are used to classify the three classes.

items.name: 影片片段四分类情绪诱发（SEED-IV）
items.description: 被试观看用于诱发快乐、悲伤、恐惧或中性状态的影片片段，同时记录脑电与眼动，每段后评定情绪。利用脑电各频段功率与眼动特征对四类情绪进行分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch film clips selected to induce happiness, sadness, fear or a neutral state, with EEG and eye movements recorded, and rate their emotion after each clip. EEG band-power and eye-movement features are used to classify the four classes.

items.name: 幽默欣赏
items.description: 被试观看有趣与匹配的无趣漫画或笑话，并评定其有趣程度。幽默材料激活中脑边缘奖赏脑区，其中腹侧纹状体 BOLD 随评定的有趣程度变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants view funny and matched non-funny cartoons or jokes and rate their funniness. Humorous items engage mesolimbic reward regions, including ventral striatum BOLD that scales with rated funniness.

items.name: 情绪图片观看
items.description: 被试观看愉快、不愉快和中性图片（通常取自国际情绪图片系统 IAPS），每张数秒，常随后进行效价与唤醒度评分。高唤醒图片在脑电中诱发更大的早期后部负波（EPN）与晚期正电位（LPP），并增强杏仁核 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Pleasant, unpleasant and neutral pictures, typically from the International Affective Picture System, are viewed for a few seconds each, often followed by valence and arousal ratings. Arousing pictures elicit a larger early posterior negativity and late positive potential in EEG and increase amygdala BOLD.

items.name: 金钱激励延迟任务
items.description: 线索提示本试次可能获得金钱、损失金钱或无激励；延迟后被试对靶刺激快速反应，随后反馈结果。奖赏预期激活腹侧纹状体 BOLD，结果反馈在脑电中诱发 FRN／奖赏正波。
items.descriptionEnglish: A cue signals whether a potential monetary gain, loss or no incentive is at stake; after a delay the participant responds quickly to a target, and feedback reports the outcome. Reward anticipation recruits ventral striatal BOLD, and outcome feedback elicits the FRN / reward positivity in EEG.

items.name: 社会激励延迟任务
items.description: 与金钱激励延迟任务相同，线索提示对随后靶刺激的快速反应能否获得奖励，但奖励是社会性的：成功试次之后出现微笑或赞许的面孔而非金钱。对社会奖赏的预期激活腹侧纹状体 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: As in the monetary incentive delay task, a cue announces whether a fast response to an upcoming target can earn a reward, but the incentive is social: successful trials are followed by a smiling or approving face instead of money. Anticipation of social reward recruits ventral striatal BOLD.

items.name: 情绪调节（认知重评）
items.description: 每个试次先出现指导语（注视或重评），随后呈现负性图片；被试或自然观看，或重新解释图片含义以减弱情绪反应，然后评定情绪。与注视条件相比，对不愉快图片的重评降低晚期正电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial an instruction (attend or reappraise) precedes a negative picture, and participants either attend naturally or reinterpret its meaning to reduce their emotional response, then rate their affect. Reappraisal of unpleasant pictures reduces the late positive potential relative to the attend condition.

items.name: 认知重评与表达抑制对比
items.description: 指导语要求被试自然观看负性刺激、对其进行重评，或抑制情绪的外部表达，从而比较两种调节策略之间及其与观看条件的差异。重评与抑制在前额叶激活的时程及对杏仁核反应的影响上不同。
items.descriptionEnglish: Instruction cues ask participants to watch a negative stimulus naturally, to reappraise it, or to suppress any outward expression of emotion, so that two regulation strategies are compared with each other and with watching. Reappraisal and suppression differ in the timing of prefrontal recruitment and in their effect on amygdala responses.

items.name: 情绪声音与语音韵律
items.description: 呈现情绪性与中性的非言语发声、环境声音或带情绪韵律的语句，任务为被动聆听或情绪识别。情绪韵律调制听觉 P200 及其后的晚期正成分。
items.descriptionEnglish: Emotional and neutral non-verbal vocalizations, environmental sounds or sentences spoken with emotional prosody are presented, with passive listening or emotion identification. Emotional prosody modulates the auditory P200 and later positivities.

items.name: 特里尔社会应激测试（TSST）
items.description: 被试在不给予支持性反馈的评价小组面前准备并发表自由演讲，然后大声进行连续减法；前后各有基线与恢复期。急性应激伴随额叶 α 不对称与前额叶 HbO 的变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants prepare and deliver a free speech and then perform serial subtraction aloud in front of an evaluative panel that gives no supportive feedback, with baseline and recovery periods before and after. Acute stress is accompanied by changes in frontal alpha asymmetry and prefrontal HbO.

items.name: 蒙特利尔影像应激任务（MIST）
items.description: 被试在扫描仪内完成心算，分三个条件：休息；无时间限制的控制条件；难度与时限自适应调整、使正确率保持较低的实验条件，并给出“正确／错误／超时”反馈及与平均成绩比较的显示。各轮之间研究者的反馈增加社会评价成分。
items.descriptionEnglish: In the scanner, participants solve mental arithmetic problems in three conditions: rest, a control condition without time limits, and an experimental condition whose difficulty and time limit are adapted to keep accuracy low, with correct/incorrect/timeout feedback and a display comparing their performance with an average. Social evaluation is added by investigator feedback between runs.

items.name: NPU 电击威胁测试
items.description: 线索或情境提示在某段时间内可能以可预测、不可预测的方式施加厌恶性电击或不会施加，实际电击很少或从不施加。短时与持续威胁产生不同的 BOLD 响应，包括杏仁核与前岛叶激活。
items.descriptionEnglish: Cues or contexts signal periods in which an aversive electric shock may be delivered predictably, unpredictably or not at all, and shocks are rarely or never actually given. Phasic and sustained threat produce distinct BOLD responses, including amygdala and anterior insula activation.

items.name: 情感触觉（C 触觉纤维最适触摸）
items.description: 以缓慢轻柔的刷触刺激有毛皮肤（优先激活无髓鞘的 C 触觉传入纤维），并与较快刷触或无毛皮肤刺激比较。C 触觉最适触摸激活后岛叶皮层。
items.descriptionEnglish: Slow, gentle brush strokes on hairy skin, which preferentially activate unmyelinated C-tactile afferents, are compared with faster strokes or stimulation of glabrous skin. CT-optimal touch activates the posterior insular cortex.

items.name: 情绪词阅读
items.description: 在默读或词汇、评价任务中呈现正性、负性和中性情绪词，常以快速序列呈现。情绪词在出现后约 200–300 毫秒诱发增强的早期后部负波，并诱发更大的晚期正电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Emotionally positive, negative and neutral words are presented, often in rapid streams, during silent reading or a lexical or evaluative task. Emotional words elicit an enhanced early posterior negativity about 200-300 ms after onset and a larger late positive potential.

items.name: 音高偏移听觉反馈（言语运动误差）
items.description: 被试持续发元音或说话，同时通过耳机听到自己的声音，反馈的音高被短暂上调或下调，形成感觉预测误差并引发代偿性发声反应。音高偏移诱发听觉 N1 与 P2，当偏移时间可预测时其波幅降低。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants sustain a vowel or speak while hearing their own voice through headphones, and the pitch of the feedback is briefly shifted up or down, producing a sensory prediction error that triggers a compensatory vocal response. Pitch shifts elicit auditory N1 and P2 responses whose amplitudes are reduced when the timing of the shift is predictable.

items.name: 运动适应（视觉旋转）
items.description: 被试向视觉目标做伸手或光标运动，代表手位置的光标相对实际运动方向被旋转，被试逐渐调整运动以抵消施加的感觉误差。揭示感觉预测误差的反馈诱发反馈锁时的事件相关电位，如错误相关电位与 P300。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make reaching or cursor movements towards visual targets while the cursor representing the hand is rotated relative to the actual hand direction, and gradually adapt their movements to cancel the imposed sensory error. Feedback revealing the sensory prediction error elicits feedback-locked ERPs such as error-related potentials and a P300.

items.name: 基于奖赏的运动学习（二值反馈）
items.description: 被试做伸手运动时看不到手的位置，只获得成功/失败的二值反馈（目标变绿或变红），因而依据奖赏而非感觉误差调整运动。二值奖赏反馈诱发反馈相关负波与 P300。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make reaching movements without seeing their hand position and receive only binary success/failure feedback (the target turns green or red), so that movements are adapted from reward rather than sensory error. Binary reward feedback elicits a feedback-related negativity and a P300.

items.name: 食欲性巴甫洛夫条件化（时间差分预测误差）
items.description: 视觉条件刺激与愉快味觉（如果汁）的给予配对，偶尔省略或意外给予奖赏以产生奖赏预测误差。腹侧纹状体（及眶额）BOLD 活动遵循时间差分预测误差信号，随着学习从奖赏给予时刻转移到线索出现时刻。
items.descriptionEnglish: Visual conditioned stimuli are paired with delivery of a pleasant taste (e.g., juice), and occasional omissions or unexpected deliveries create reward prediction errors. Ventral striatal (and orbitofrontal) BOLD activity follows a temporal-difference prediction-error signal that shifts from reward delivery to cue onset with learning.

items.name: 错误觉知（选择任务 + 正确性判断）
items.english: Error awareness (choice task with accuracy judgements)
items.description: 被试完成快速手动选择任务，并在每次反应后判断该反应是否正确，从而把错误分为觉察到的（被报告的）与未觉察的两类。错误正波（Pe）在觉察到的错误上大于未觉察的错误，而更早出现的 ERN 在两类错误间差异较小。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants perform a speeded manual choice task and, after each response, judge whether it was correct, so that errors can be sorted into aware (signalled) and unaware ones. The error positivity (Pe) is larger for aware than for unaware errors, whereas the earlier ERN differs less between them.

items.name: 反向眼跳任务中的错误觉知
items.english: Error awareness in the antisaccade task
items.description: 被试完成反向眼跳任务，并在每个试次后报告是否误向目标扫视。许多反射性扫视错误未被察觉；Pe 只在被报告的错误上明显出现，而 ERN 在两类错误上都会出现。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants perform an antisaccade task and signal after each trial whether they made an erroneous saccade towards the target. Many reflexive saccade errors go unnoticed; the Pe is present for signalled but largely absent for unsignalled errors, whereas the ERN occurs for both.

items.name: 错误觉知任务（EAT）
items.description: 以颜色词为刺激的改良 Go/NoGo 任务：被试对一致颜色词按键，对两类 NoGo 试次（与上一试次重复的词、颜色不一致的词）抑制反应；若察觉自己误按，在下一试次按另一个"错误报告"键。被察觉的误按错误伴随前额与顶叶激活。
items.descriptionEnglish: A modified Go/NoGo task with colour words: participants respond to congruent colour words and withhold to two types of NoGo trials (a word repeated on successive trials, or a word in an incongruent colour). They press a separate error-signalling button on the trial after a commission error they noticed. Aware commission errors are associated with prefrontal and parietal activation.

items.name: 多臂老虎机（探索-利用）
items.description: 每个试次中，被试在若干个回报会漂移或不确定的选项（摇臂）之间选择，在利用已知最佳选项与探索其他选项之间权衡。结果反馈诱发 FRN/奖赏正波，fMRI 中探索性选择激活额极皮层。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial participants choose among several options (arms) whose reward payoffs drift or are uncertain, trading off exploitation of the best-known option against exploration of others. Outcome feedback elicits the FRN/reward positivity, and exploratory choices engage frontopolar cortex in fMRI.

items.name: 因果学习
items.description: 被试观察或自行产生线索与结果事件序列（如食物与过敏反应），并判断线索在多大程度上导致结果，二者之间的统计关联性被系统操纵。fMRI 研究报告外侧前额叶存在与预测误差和关联性相关的活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants observe or produce sequences of cue and outcome events (e.g., foods and allergic reactions) and judge how strongly a cue causes the outcome, with the statistical contingency between them manipulated. In fMRI, prediction-error and contingency-related activity is reported in lateral prefrontal cortex.

items.name: 预测推断任务（变点条件）
items.description: 每个试次被试预测下一个结果的位置，然后观察实际结果；结果分布的均值会在无提示的变点处突变，因而可测量逐试次学习率。出乎意料的结果诱发反馈锁时的 P300，其幅度与随后的信念更新有关。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial participants predict where the next outcome will fall, then observe the outcome drawn from a distribution whose mean shifts abruptly at unsignalled change points, so that trial-wise learning rates can be measured. Surprising outcomes elicit a feedback-locked P300 whose amplitude relates to subsequent belief updating.

items.name: 预测推断任务（oddball 条件）
items.description: 预测推断任务增加一种生成条件：结果均值缓慢漂移，偶尔从宽分布中抽出应被忽略的离群值（oddball），与"出乎意料即意味着变化"的变点条件对比。反馈锁时 P300 在变点条件下与信念更新正相关，在 oddball 条件下负相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: The predictive inference task is run with an additional generative condition in which the outcome mean drifts slowly and occasional outliers (oddballs) are drawn from a broad distribution and should be ignored, contrasted with the change-point condition in which surprising outcomes signal a shift. The feedback-locked P300 relates positively to updating in the change-point condition and negatively in the oddball condition.

items.name: 交互式错误电位（离散用户指令）
items.description: 用户以离散指令（如按键）移动光标接近目标，界面偶尔执行与用户意图不符的动作。这类界面错误在错误反馈之后诱发额中央的交互式错误电位（ErrP），可在单试次上检测，用于纠正或自适应调整脑机接口。
items.descriptionEnglish: The user issues discrete commands (e.g., key presses) to move a cursor towards a target, and the interface occasionally executes an action other than the one intended. Such interface errors elicit a fronto-central error-related potential (interaction ErrP) time-locked to the erroneous feedback, which can be detected on single trials and used to correct or adapt a BCI.

items.name: 监视型错误电位（自主运行设备）
items.description: 用户不发出指令，只观看设备（如光标）自主向目标移动；部分步骤中设备朝错误方向移动。错误移动诱发额中央错误相关电位，可在单试次上检测，并作为强化信号让设备学习。
items.descriptionEnglish: The user does not issue commands but watches a device (e.g., a cursor) move autonomously towards a target; on a proportion of steps the device moves in the wrong direction. Erroneous movements elicit a fronto-central error-related potential that can be detected on single trials and used to teach the device by reinforcement.

items.name: P300 拼写器反馈错误电位
items.description: 用户使用在线 P300 拼写器，每次选择后看到拼写器选出的字符。与目标字符不符的选择是真实的 BCI 错误，在反馈后诱发错误相关电位，检测它可撤销或纠正该选择。
items.descriptionEnglish: Users spell with an online P300 speller and, after each selection, see the character chosen by the speller. Selections that differ from the intended character are genuine BCI errors and elicit an error-related potential to the feedback, which can be detected to cancel or correct the selection.

items.name: 连续反馈中的错误电位
items.description: 用户在简单电子游戏中连续控制光标并获得连续视觉反馈。在不可预测的时刻引入执行错误（反馈偏离用户输入）与结果错误（未达成动作目标），二者在没有试次划分的情况下诱发错误相关电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Users continuously control a cursor in a simple video game and receive continuous visual feedback. Execution errors (the feedback deviates from the user's input) and outcome errors (the action goal is not achieved) are introduced at unpredictable times and elicit error-related potentials without trial segmentation.

items.name: 赌博与奖赏反馈
items.description: 被试做出简单选择（如在两扇门或两张牌中选一个），随后获得基本与表现无关的金钱得失反馈。与获益反馈相比，损失反馈诱发额中央的反馈相关负波（等价地说，获益诱发奖赏正波）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make simple choices (e.g., between two doors or cards) and then receive monetary gain or loss feedback that is largely independent of performance. Loss feedback elicits a fronto-central feedback-related negativity relative to gain feedback (equivalently, gains elicit a reward positivity).

items.name: 门选择猜测任务（doors task）
items.description: 每个试次被试看到两扇门并选择其一，随后得到金钱收益（向上绿色箭头）或损失（向下红色箭头）的反馈，得失各占一半试次，收益约为损失的两倍。收益反馈相对损失反馈诱发奖赏正波；该任务被广泛用作临床生物标记范式。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial participants see two doors, pick one, and receive feedback of a monetary gain (upward green arrow) or loss (downward red arrow), each on half of the trials, with gains about twice the size of losses. Gain feedback elicits a reward positivity relative to loss feedback; the task is widely used as a clinical biomarker paradigm.

items.name: 被动老虎机结果
items.description: 被试观看计算机生成的老虎机给出收益或损失结果，结果与自身任何选择无关。结果反馈仍诱发反馈相关负波，从而把结果评价与动作选择分开。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch a computer-generated slot machine deliver gain or loss outcomes that are not contingent on any choice of their own. Outcome feedback still elicits a feedback-related negativity, allowing outcome evaluation to be separated from action selection.

items.name: 工具性条件化
items.description: 被试通过试错学习哪些动作会带来奖赏（或避免厌恶结果），由动作–结果关联塑造选择。工具性学习中的奖赏预测误差反映在纹状体 BOLD 信号中，EEG 中结果反馈诱发 FRN。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants learn by trial and error which actions lead to rewarding (or avoid aversive) outcomes, so that action-outcome contingencies shape choice. Reward prediction errors during instrumental learning are reflected in striatal BOLD, and outcome feedback elicits the FRN in EEG.

items.name: 观察性错误（观察他人完成选择任务）
items.english: Observation of errors (human performer, choice task)
items.description: 被试观看另一人完成快速选择任务（如 flanker 任务），只监视其反应而不亲自操作。被观察到的错误在内侧额区诱发观察性错误相关负波（oERN）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch another person perform a speeded choice task such as the flanker task and monitor the performer's responses without acting themselves. Observed errors elicit an observer error-related negativity (oERN) over medial frontal sites.

items.name: 观察他人 Go/NoGo 任务中的错误
items.english: Observation of errors in a Go/NoGo task
items.description: 被试观看另一人完成 Go/NoGo 任务，监视其在 NoGo 试次上是否成功抑制反应。被观察到的误按错误在观察者身上诱发早期内侧额区负波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch another person perform a Go/NoGo task and monitor whether the performer correctly withholds responses on NoGo trials. Observed commission errors elicit an early medial frontal negativity in the observer.

items.name: 沉浸式 VR 中观察化身的动作错误
items.english: Observation of avatar action errors in immersive VR
items.description: 被试佩戴头戴显示器，从第一或第三人称视角观看虚拟身体（化身）完成伸手抓握动作，化身偶尔出错。被观察到的化身错误诱发观察性错误相关负波，并受视角与具身感调节。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants wearing a head-mounted display watch a virtual body (avatar) perform reach-to-grasp actions, seen from a first-person or third-person perspective, and the avatar occasionally makes an erroneous action. Observed avatar errors elicit an observer error-related negativity, modulated by the perspective and the sense of embodiment.

items.name: 正交化 Go/NoGo 学习任务
items.description: 被试依据反馈学习四种线索，每种线索要求以反应（Go）或不反应（NoGo）来获得奖赏或避免惩罚，使动作与结果效价相互正交，从而可以测量巴甫洛夫偏向（为奖赏而 Go、为避罚而 NoGo）。克服巴甫洛夫偏向与线索锁时的额中线 θ 功率升高相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Four cues are learned by feedback, each requiring either a response (Go) or withholding (NoGo) to obtain a reward or avoid a punishment, so that action and outcome valence are orthogonal and Pavlovian biases (Go for reward, NoGo for punishment) can be measured. Overcoming the Pavlovian bias is associated with increased cue-locked midfrontal theta power.

items.name: 概率分类学习（天气预报任务）
items.description: 每个试次中，被试看到若干线索卡片的组合并预测两种结果之一（如下雨或晴天），每张卡片与结果之间只有概率性关联，被试依据反馈学习。概率性类别的学习伴随纹状体 BOLD 活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial participants see a combination of cue cards and predict one of two outcomes (e.g., rain or sunshine), each cue being only probabilistically related to the outcome, and they learn from feedback. Learning of the probabilistic categories is accompanied by striatal BOLD activity.

items.name: 概率反转学习
items.description: 被试依据概率性反馈学习两个刺激中哪一个通常获得奖赏，达到学习标准后刺激–奖赏关联在无提示的情况下反转。反馈诱发 FRN，奖赏预测误差和与反转相关的转换反映在纹状体（及眶额）BOLD 信号中。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants learn by probabilistic feedback which of two stimuli is usually rewarded, and the stimulus-reward contingency is reversed without warning once learning criteria are met. Feedback elicits the FRN, and reward prediction errors and reversal-related shifts are tracked by striatal (and orbitofrontal) BOLD.

items.name: 概率奖赏任务（信号检测）
items.description: 被试对短暂呈现、差异细微的刺激（如卡通脸上较短或较长的嘴）进行分类，其中一类刺激的正确判断获得奖赏的频率高于另一类，从而形成偏向高奖赏类别的反应偏向。奖赏反馈诱发 FRN，其波幅与反应偏向的形成相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants categorise briefly presented stimuli that differ subtly (e.g., a short or long mouth on a cartoon face), and correct identifications of one stimulus are rewarded more often than the other, producing a response bias towards the richly rewarded category. Reward feedback elicits the FRN, whose amplitude relates to the development of response bias.

items.name: 概率选择任务
items.description: 训练阶段，被试依据概率性反馈在奖赏概率不同的固定刺激对中学习选择；随后的测试阶段使用无反馈的新组合，检验被试更多地从正性还是负性结果中学习。训练阶段的反馈诱发 FRN 与额中线 θ，二者与随后的行为调整相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: In a training phase participants learn from probabilistic feedback to choose within fixed stimulus pairs that differ in reward probability; a subsequent test phase with novel pairings without feedback reveals whether they learned more from positive or from negative outcomes. Feedback during training elicits the FRN and frontal midline theta, which relate to subsequent behavioural adaptation.

items.name: 时间估计任务
items.description: 被试在提示后按键以估计一个固定时间间隔（如 1 秒），并获得估计是否落在自适应容差窗口内的反馈。负性表现反馈诱发额中央的反馈相关负波；该成分最早正是在这一范式中被描述的。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants estimate a fixed time interval (e.g., one second) by pressing a button after a cue and receive feedback on whether the estimate fell within an adaptive tolerance window. Negative performance feedback elicits a fronto-central feedback-related negativity, the paradigm in which this component was first described.

items.name: 两阶段决策（基于模型/无模型）
items.description: 被试在第一阶段做出选择，该选择按概率（常见或罕见转移）进入两个第二阶段状态之一，在第二阶段再做选择并以缓慢漂移的概率获得奖赏。罕见转移后的保持/转换行为可区分基于模型与无模型控制，纹状体 BOLD 预测误差同时反映二者。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make a first-stage choice that leads probabilistically (via common or rare transitions) to one of two second-stage states, where a second choice yields reward with slowly drifting probabilities. Stay/switch behaviour after rare transitions separates model-based from model-free control, and striatal BOLD prediction errors reflect both.

items.name: 确定性转移两阶段任务
items.description: 改良的两阶段任务：每个第一阶段选择确定地通向某个第二阶段状态，试次从两种不同的第一阶段状态之一开始，第二阶段奖赏以分数形式漂移。基于模型的控制表现为奖赏在不同起始状态间的泛化；该设计使基于模型的控制比原任务更有收益。
items.descriptionEnglish: A modified two-stage task in which each first-stage choice leads deterministically to one second-stage state and trials start from one of two different first-stage states, while second-stage rewards drift as graded points. Model-based control is revealed by generalisation of reward across start states, and the design makes model-based control pay off more than in the original task.

items.name: 虚拟现实视觉–触觉失配（预测误差负波）
items.description: 被试在虚拟现实中伸手触碰虚拟物体，少数试次中视觉/触觉的触碰反馈被提前给出，造成预测感觉反馈与实际反馈之间的失配。失配反馈诱发额中央负波（预测误差负波，约 100–200 ms），被提出可作为被动式脑机接口检测交互错误的信号。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants reach to touch virtual objects in VR, and on a minority of trials the visual/haptic touch feedback is delivered prematurely, creating a mismatch between predicted and actual sensory feedback. Mismatching feedback elicits a fronto-central negativity (prediction error negativity, ~100-200 ms), proposed as a passive-BCI signal of interaction errors.

items.name: 听觉想象
items.description: 被试看到一首熟悉歌曲歌词中的词，判断其中两个词之间音高是升还是降，条件为听到歌曲或在想象中重现歌曲。想象激活次级听皮层以及额叶和辅助运动区。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants see words from the lyrics of a familiar song and judge whether the pitch rises or falls between two of them, either while hearing the song or while imagining it. Imagery activates secondary auditory cortex together with frontal and supplementary motor regions.

items.name: 熟悉曲调续想
items.description: 被试听到一首熟悉的器乐曲调的前几个音，随后在想象中继续这段曲调，与只听而不续想的条件比较。对旋律的想象激活偏右侧的次级听皮层以及额叶和辅助运动区。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants hear the first notes of a familiar instrumental tune and then continue the tune in imagery, compared with hearing the notes without continuing them. Imagery of the melody activates right-lateralised secondary auditory cortex together with frontal and supplementary motor areas.

items.name: 指令跟随想象（意识评估）
items.description: 意识障碍患者（及健康对照）在功能磁共振扫描中按口头指令，在休息与想象打网球或想象在家中各房间走动之间交替。辅助运动区（网球）或海马旁回与顶叶导航区（房屋）可靠的任务锁时激活，被视为隐蔽指令跟随的证据。
items.descriptionEnglish: Patients with disorders of consciousness (and healthy controls) are verbally instructed to alternate between rest and imagining playing tennis or walking through the rooms of their home, in fMRI blocks. Reliable task-locked activation of the supplementary motor area (tennis) or of parahippocampal and parietal navigation regions (house) is taken as evidence of covert command following.

items.name: 床旁脑电运动想象指令跟随
items.description: 在床旁，意识障碍患者在大量短试次中听到以提示音标记的简短口头指令，想象两种动作之一或放松。若对指令特异的感觉运动节律变化的分类高于机会水平，即视为隐蔽指令跟随的证据。
items.descriptionEnglish: At the bedside, patients with disorders of consciousness hear short spoken commands, signalled by tones, to imagine one of two movements or to relax, in many short trials. Classification of command-specific sensorimotor rhythm changes above chance is taken as evidence of covert command following.

items.name: 基于想象的是/否沟通（功能磁共振）
items.description: 在定位扫描之后，被试回答口头提出的自传性是/否问题：用一种想象任务（打网球）表示“是”，用另一种（空间导航）表示“否”，30 秒想象期与休息交替。通过比较辅助运动区和海马旁回的激活与定位扫描的模式解码答案。
items.descriptionEnglish: After localiser scans, the participant answers spoken autobiographical yes/no questions by performing one imagery task (tennis) for 'yes' and the other (spatial navigation) for 'no' in 30-s imagery periods alternating with rest. The answer is decoded by comparing SMA and parahippocampal activation with the localiser patterns.

items.name: 心算
items.description: 被试默默进行计算，通常是从提示的起始数字连续减去一个小数，按组块与休息或另一种心理任务交替。计算使 fNIRS 测得的前额叶氧合血红蛋白升高、EEG 额中线 θ 增强，这些特征用于心理任务脑机接口。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants silently perform calculations, typically serial subtraction of a small number from a cued starting number, in blocks alternating with rest or another mental task. Calculation increases prefrontal oxygenated haemoglobin in fNIRS and frontal midline theta in EEG, which serve as features in mental-task BCIs.

items.name: 五分类心理任务脑机接口
items.description: 被试（此处为脑卒中或脊髓损伤的终端用户）每个试次按提示完成 5 种心理任务之一（其中包括心算），不给反馈，依据脑电对任务分类。心算是若干非运动与运动心理任务中的一类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants (here end-users with stroke or spinal cord injury) perform one of five cued mental tasks per trial, including a mental arithmetic task, and the task is classified from EEG without feedback. Mental arithmetic is one class among several non-motor and motor mental tasks.

items.name: 嗅觉想象
items.description: 以提示（如气味名称）让被试想象闻到某种气味，并与想象其视觉外观或休息条件比较。气味想象激活初级嗅觉（梨状）皮层及相关区域，部分类似于气味知觉。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are cued (e.g. by an odour name) to imagine smelling an odour, compared with imagining its visual appearance or with rest. Odour imagery activates primary olfactory (piriform) cortex and related regions in a way that partly mirrors odour perception.

items.name: 心理旋转
items.description: 被试判断两个视觉呈现的物体（或旋转后的物体与标准物体）是相同还是镜像；反应时随二者角度差增大而延长。旋转过程调用后顶叶与额叶区域，并伴随后部 α 功率的任务相关变化以及随旋转角度增大的顶叶负波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants judge whether two visually presented objects (or a rotated object and its standard) are identical or mirror images; reaction time increases with the angular disparity between them. Rotation engages posterior parietal and frontal regions and is accompanied by task-related changes in posterior alpha power and a parietal negativity that scales with rotation angle.

items.name: 体感注意定向
items.description: 双侧手腕同时接受相同的振动触觉刺激，被试在每个提示试次中注意一侧的感觉以完成二选一。选择性感觉在对侧体感皮层引起偏侧化的感觉运动节律 ERD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Both wrists receive equal vibrotactile stimulation, and on each cued trial the participant attends to the sensation on one side to make a binary selection. Selective sensation produces lateralised sensorimotor rhythm ERD over the contralateral somatosensory cortex.

items.name: 无刺激的体感注意定向
items.description: 在没有任何触觉刺激的情况下，被试按提示将注意定向到一只手（左或右）的感觉上。仅凭体感注意定向即可产生偏侧化的感觉运动节律 ERD，可像运动想象一样分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Without any tactile stimulation, the participant orients attention to the sensation of one hand (left or right) on cue. Somatosensory attentional orientation alone produces lateralised sensorimotor rhythm ERD that can be classified like motor imagery.

items.name: 想象语音（内部言语）
items.description: 被试按提示想象发出某个元音，但不动用发音器官、不发声，离线从头皮脑电中分类所想象的元音。该类的颅内研究报告言语皮层上项目特异的高 γ 活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are cued to imagine articulating a vowel without moving the articulators or producing sound, and the imagined vowel is classified offline from scalp EEG. Intracranial studies of the class report item-specific high-gamma activity over speech cortex.

items.name: 想象指令词（内部言语）
items.description: 每个试次由视觉提示指示一组少量指令词之一（如西班牙语的上、下、左、右），被试随后以内部言语默念该词；部分数据集另设出声或视觉化条件作比较。依据脑电对词分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial a visual cue indicates one of a small set of command words (e.g. Spanish words for up, down, left and right), which the participant then says silently in inner speech; some datasets add pronounced or visualised conditions as comparisons. The word is classified from EEG.

items.name: 想象音素、音节与词（混合集合）
items.english: Imagined phonemes, syllables and words (mixed set)
items.description: 向被试呈现一个提示，项目来自由音素、音节和语音相近的词组成的混合集合，被试想象说出该项目；依据 62 导脑电对项目分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are shown a prompt for one item of a mixed set of phonemes, syllables and phonologically similar words and imagine speaking it; the item is classified from 62-channel EEG.

items.name: 触觉想象
items.description: 被试先体验触觉刺激（如腕部振动），随后在提示试次中在无刺激时想象该感觉。触觉想象在对侧体感皮层引起可被分类的 mu 频段 ERD，方式与运动想象相似。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants first experience a tactile stimulus (e.g. vibration on the wrist) and then, on cued trials, imagine that sensation in its absence. Tactile imagery produces mu-band ERD over the contralateral somatosensory cortex that can be classified, in a way comparable to motor imagery.

items.name: 视觉想象
items.description: 被试闭眼想象学过的简单视觉图案，与实际看到同样图案比较。想象激活早期视觉皮层，并调节后部 α 功率。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants visualise simple learned visual patterns with their eyes closed, compared with seeing the same patterns. Imagery activates early visual cortex and modulates posterior alpha power.

items.name: 类别特异视觉想象（面孔对场景）
items.description: 被试按提示想象熟悉的面孔或熟悉的场所，与实际看到同类刺激比较。想象激活类别选择性的腹侧区域（面孔对应梭状回面孔区，场所对应海马旁回位置区），模式与知觉一致但较弱。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants imagine familiar faces or familiar places on cue, compared with perceiving the same categories. Imagery activates the category-selective ventral regions (fusiform face area for faces, parahippocampal place area for places) in proportion to, but weaker than, perception.

items.name: 人工语法学习
items.description: 被试先接触由有限状态人工语法生成的字母串，随后对新的字母串做合乎/不合语法的分类。学习后，违反语法的串诱发与自然语言句法违例相似的 ERP，包括晚期正波（P600）和早期前部负波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are exposed to letter strings generated by a finite-state artificial grammar and are then asked to classify new strings as grammatical or ungrammatical. After learning, grammar violations elicit ERP responses resembling those to natural-language syntactic violations, including a late positivity (P600) and an early anterior negativity.

items.name: 韵律边界加工
items.description: 被试聆听语调短语边界数量或位置不同、有时用词完全相同的自然语音句子。每个韵律边界在中央—顶区诱发正漂移（闭合正漂移，CPS），反映韵律切分，而不依赖于声学停顿本身。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants listen to naturally spoken sentences that differ in the number or position of intonational phrase boundaries, sometimes with otherwise identical words. Each prosodic boundary elicits a positive shift (closure positive shift, CPS) over centro-parietal sites, which indexes prosodic phrasing independently of the acoustic pause.

items.name: 阅读中的闭合正漂移（逗号标记边界）
items.english: Closure positive shift in reading (comma-marked boundaries)
items.description: 被试阅读逐词呈现的句子，其中逗号标记（或不标记）短语边界。逗号诱发与言语韵律边界相似的闭合正漂移，支持读者在阅读中施加隐性韵律切分的观点。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants read sentences presented word by word in which commas mark (or do not mark) a phrase boundary. Commas elicit a closure positive shift similar to the one evoked by prosodic boundaries in speech, supporting the view that readers impose implicit prosodic phrasing.

items.name: 言语—手势整合
items.description: 被试观看说话者的视频，说话时伴随的形象手势与言语内容一致或不一致，有时还改变手势与言语的时间关系。与一致手势相比，与言语语义不一致的手势诱发更大的 N400，表明手势意义与言语意义发生了整合。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch videos of a speaker producing words or sentences accompanied by iconic hand gestures that either match or mismatch the speech, sometimes with varied timing between gesture and speech. Gestures that are semantically incongruent with the accompanying speech elicit a larger N400 than congruent gestures, indicating integration of gestural and verbal meaning.

items.name: 语言层级结构频率标记
items.description: 呈现等时的音节序列，音节组合成短语和句子，但边界处没有任何声学线索；对照序列使用随机音节或被试不懂的语言。皮层响应不仅在音节频率处出现谱峰，还在短语与句子频率处出现谱峰，且只有当听者能够解析语言结构时才出现。
items.descriptionEnglish: Isochronous sequences of syllables are presented in which syllables combine into phrases and sentences that carry no acoustic cue to their boundaries; control sequences use random syllables or an unknown language. Cortical responses show spectral peaks not only at the syllable rate but also at the phrase and sentence rates, which appear only when listeners can parse the linguistic structure.

items.name: 词汇判断
items.description: 逐个呈现字母串，被试尽快判断它是真词还是可发音的假词，同时操纵词频等词汇变量。真词与假词的 N400 不同，其波幅还受词频等词汇变量调制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Letter strings are presented one at a time and participants decide as quickly as possible whether each is a real word or a pronounceable pseudoword, while lexical variables such as frequency are manipulated. Words and pseudowords differ in the N400, whose amplitude is also modulated by lexical variables such as word frequency.

items.name: 语言定位任务
items.description: 被试阅读逐词呈现的句子组块与可发音非词序列组块，以“句子 > 非词”对比在每个个体中界定语言响应区。该对比识别出左偏侧的额颞语言网络，再考察其在其他条件下的 BOLD 响应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants read blocks of sentences and blocks of pronounceable nonword sequences presented word by word, and the sentences > nonwords contrast is used to define language-responsive regions in each individual. The contrast identifies a left-lateralised frontotemporal language network whose BOLD response is then examined in other conditions.

items.name: 听觉语言定位任务（完整 vs 退化语音）
items.english: Auditory language localizer (intact vs degraded speech)
items.description: 被试聆听短的口语段落组块，以及这些段落经声学退化、无法理解的版本组块。“完整 > 退化”对比在每个个体中定位高级语言区，可用于不能阅读的情况。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants listen to blocks of short spoken passages and blocks of acoustically degraded versions of the same passages that are unintelligible. The intact > degraded contrast localises high-level language regions in each individual and can be used where reading is not possible.

items.name: 音乐句法违例
items.description: 被试聆听和弦序列或旋律，其中部分和弦在和声上出乎预期，如在应出现主和弦的位置出现离调和弦或那不勒斯和弦。音乐句法不规则的和弦诱发早期右前负波（ERAN），在某些设计中还诱发随后的正波，这些响应常与语言句法违例的 ERP 相比较。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants hear chord sequences or melodies in which some chords are harmonically unexpected, such as an out-of-key chord or a Neapolitan chord at a position where the tonic is expected. Music-syntactically irregular chords elicit an early right anterior negativity (ERAN) and, in some designs, a later positivity, and these responses have been compared with ERP responses to syntactic violations in language.

items.name: 语义违例
items.description: 句子以视觉方式逐词呈现，以一致的词或语义异常的词结尾。语义异常的句末词比一致结尾诱发更大的中央—顶区负波，即 N400。
items.descriptionEnglish: Sentences are presented visually word by word and end either with a congruent word or with a semantically anomalous word. Anomalous sentence-final words elicit a larger centro-parietal negativity, the N400, than congruent endings.

items.name: 按完形概率分级的句末词
items.description: 句末词都在语义上可接受，但完形概率不同，即在常模研究中被用作该句框补全的频率不同；有的设计还改变意外词与预期词的语义关联。N400 波幅随完形概率升高而分级降低。
items.descriptionEnglish: Sentence-final words are all semantically acceptable but differ in cloze probability, that is, in how often they are produced as completions of the sentence frame in a norming study; some designs also vary the semantic relation of unexpected words to the expected word. N400 amplitude decreases graded with increasing cloze probability.

items.name: 自然语音聆听
items.description: 被试聆听有声书、故事或播客等连续自然语音，除理解外通常不执行其他任务。神经活动跟随语音的慢幅度包络，可用时间响应函数或刺激重建来估计这种包络跟踪。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants listen to continuous natural speech such as audiobooks, stories or podcasts, usually without a task other than comprehension. Neural activity follows the slow amplitude envelope of the speech, and this envelope tracking is estimated with temporal response functions or stimulus reconstruction.

items.name: 新词学习
items.description: 被试接触新的假词，其意义可从句子语境、图片或定义中推断，随后对这些词进行测试。随着意义的习得，新词开始诱发与已知词类似的 N400 效应，例如其后呈现语义相关词时 N400 减弱。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants encounter novel pseudowords whose meanings can be inferred from sentence contexts, pictures or definitions, and are later tested on them. As meaning is acquired, novel words come to elicit N400 effects similar to those of known words, for example an N400 reduction when followed by semantically related words.

items.name: 出声或尝试言语产生
items.description: 植入电极的被试朗读或复述提示的辅音—元音音节，同时记录腹侧感觉运动皮层活动；解码离线进行（开环）。与发音器官对应的高 γ 活动揭示了言语发音的躯体定位与时间组织，是后来言语神经假体的基础。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants with implanted electrodes read aloud or repeat prompted consonant-vowel syllables while neural activity is recorded from ventral sensorimotor cortex; decoding is done offline (open loop). Articulator-specific high-gamma activity reveals the somatotopic and temporal organisation of speech articulation that later speech neuroprostheses build on.

items.name: 尝试言语：小词表单词实时解码
items.english: Attempted speech: small-vocabulary word decoding with real-time output
items.description: 严重瘫痪、构音不能的被试根据屏幕提示尝试说出固定小词表中的词，同时记录言语感觉运动皮层的 ECoG。单词分类器结合语言模型组成句子，实时解码所尝试的词并显示给被试。
items.descriptionEnglish: A participant with severe paralysis and anarthria attempts to say words from a fixed small vocabulary, cued on a screen, while ECoG is recorded over speech sensorimotor cortex. Word classifiers, combined with a language model to form sentences, decode the attempted words in real time and display them to the participant.

items.name: 尝试言语：大词表句子解码
items.description: 瘫痪被试出声或无声地尝试说出提示的句子，同时用皮层内电极阵列或高密度 ECoG 记录言语运动皮层；音素或子词级解码器结合大词表语言模型在尝试说句时连续输出文字，部分系统还合成语音或驱动虚拟形象。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants with paralysis attempt to speak cued sentences, aloud or silently, while intracortical arrays or high-density ECoG record speech motor cortex; phoneme- or subword-level decoders combined with a large-vocabulary language model output text continuously as the sentence is attempted, and some systems also synthesise speech or animate an avatar.

items.name: 句法违例
items.description: 逐词呈现句子，其中含句法违例（如一致性或短语结构错误），与合法的对照句比较。句法违例诱发中央—顶区晚期正波（P600，又称句法正漂移），部分研究中形态句法违例之前还有左前负波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Sentences are presented word by word and contain syntactic violations, such as agreement or phrase-structure errors, compared with well-formed control sentences. Syntactic violations elicit a late centro-parietal positivity (P600, also called syntactic positive shift), and morphosyntactic violations are in some studies preceded by a left anterior negativity.

items.name: 花园路径句
items.description: 句子在前半部分暂时歧义，最初偏好的结构在消歧词处被证明是错的（花园路径句），与无歧义对照句比较。消歧词诱发 P600，被解释为句法重新分析。
items.descriptionEnglish: Sentences are temporarily ambiguous so that the initially preferred structure turns out to be wrong at a disambiguating word (garden-path sentences), and they are compared with unambiguous controls. The disambiguating word elicits a P600, interpreted as syntactic reanalysis.

items.name: 音位范畴化
items.description: 被试聆听取自两个音位之间声学连续体的音节（如 /ba/-/da/-/ga/），并识别每个刺激。以高 γ 响应测得的颞上回群体活动反映的是被知觉到的音位范畴，而非线性变化的声学参数，与范畴知觉相对应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants hear syllables drawn from an acoustic continuum between two phonemes (for example /ba/-/da/-/ga/) and identify each token. Population activity in the superior temporal gyrus, measured as high-gamma responses, reflects the perceived phoneme category rather than the linear acoustic change, mirroring categorical perception.

items.name: 语音意识
items.description: 被试判断视觉呈现的两个词（或字母、假词）是否押韵。押韵判断激活左侧颞顶与额下语言区，阅读障碍者激活较弱；语音技能与语音失匹配负波相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants judge whether two visually presented words (or letters / nonwords) rhyme. Rhyme judgments engage left temporoparietal and inferior frontal language regions, which are less activated in readers with dyslexia, and phonological skills are related to speech-sound mismatch negativity.

items.name: 图片命名
items.description: 被试尽快准确地出声命名物体或动作图片。命名在 fMRI 中激活左偏侧的语言与言语运动区；ECoG 显示高 γ 依次从视觉皮层扩展到颞、额与感觉运动皮层，临床上用于语言定位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants name pictures of objects or actions aloud as quickly and accurately as possible. Naming engages left-lateralised language and speech-motor regions in fMRI, and ECoG shows sequential high-gamma increases from visual to temporal, frontal and sensorimotor cortex, which is used clinically for language mapping.

items.name: 图词干扰
items.description: 被试命名图片，同时忽略书面或口语干扰词；干扰词与图片名称语义相关、语音相关或无关，并以不同的刺激起始间隔呈现。语义相关干扰词使命名变慢（语义干扰），语音相关干扰词使命名变快（语音促进），并伴随左侧颞叶与额叶语言区活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants name pictures while ignoring a written or spoken distractor word that is semantically related, phonologically related or unrelated to the picture name, presented at different stimulus onset asynchronies. Semantically related distractors slow naming (semantic interference) and phonologically related ones speed it (phonological facilitation), with associated activity in left temporal and frontal language regions.

items.name: 语义启动
items.description: 先呈现启动词，随后呈现与之语义相关或无关的目标词，被试对目标词作出反应（如词汇判断）或仅阅读。与无关目标词相比，相关目标词加工更快，诱发的 N400 更小。
items.descriptionEnglish: A prime word is followed by a target word that is either semantically related or unrelated to it, and participants respond to the target, for example with a lexical decision, or simply read it. Related targets are processed faster and elicit a smaller N400 than unrelated targets.

items.name: 掩蔽语义启动
items.description: 短暂呈现的启动词前后被掩蔽，几乎或完全不能被意识到，随后呈现相关或无关的目标词。比较掩蔽与非掩蔽启动的 N400 启动效应，用于检验 N400 反映的是自动的词汇—语义通达还是词汇后整合。
items.descriptionEnglish: A briefly presented prime word is forward- and/or backward-masked so that it is hardly or not consciously seen, and is followed by a related or unrelated target word. Comparing N400 priming effects for masked and unmasked primes is used to test whether the N400 reflects automatic lexical-semantic access or post-lexical integration.

items.name: 自然阅读（眼动同步）
items.description: 被试自由阅读句子或文本，同时记录 EEG 和眼动，EEG 以注视词语的起始时刻为锁时点进行分段。注视相关电位可揭示可预测性等词汇层面的效应，并可与逐词序列呈现所得的 ERP 相比较。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants read sentences or texts freely while EEG and eye movements are recorded simultaneously, and EEG epochs are time-locked to the onset of fixations on words. Fixation-related potentials reveal word-level effects such as predictability, which can be compared with ERPs from serial word-by-word presentation.

items.name: 句子理解
items.description: 被试阅读或聆听结构复杂度或暂时歧义程度不同的句子（如宾语关系从句与主语关系从句、花园路径句），并回答理解问题。复杂句或需要重新分析的句子提高左侧额颞语言网络的 BOLD 活动，并在关键词处调制 N400 和 P600 响应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants read or listen to sentences that vary in structural complexity or temporary ambiguity, such as object- versus subject-relative clauses or garden-path sentences, and answer comprehension questions. Complex or reanalysis-requiring sentences increase BOLD activity in the left frontotemporal language network and modulate N400 and P600 responses at the critical words.

items.name: 手语句子理解
items.description: 聋人或听人母语手语者观看手语句子视频，与无意义手势序列或其他基线比较；部分设计还与听人被试的书面或口语句子比较。手语理解激活左偏侧的外侧裂周围语言网络，母语手语者中还报告了额外的右半球参与。
items.descriptionEnglish: Deaf or hearing native signers watch videos of signed sentences, compared with meaningless gesture sequences or other baselines, and in some designs with written or spoken sentences in hearing participants. Sign language comprehension engages the left-lateralised perisylvian language network, with additional right-hemisphere involvement reported in native signers.

items.name: 语义判断任务（语言定位）
items.description: 被试听或读词语（通常为动物名称），判断其是否满足某个语义标准，并与对照任务（如判断音调序列中是否包含目标音高）比较。“语义减音调”对比激活左侧化的额、颞、顶区网络，用于术前语言偏侧化评估。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants hear or read words, typically animal names, and decide whether each meets a semantic criterion, compared with a control task such as deciding whether a tone sequence contains a target pitch. The semantic-minus-tone contrast activates a left-lateralised network of frontal, temporal and parietal regions and is used for presurgical language lateralisation.

items.name: 言语诱发抑制与听觉反馈
items.description: 被试发出言语声音并听到自己的声音，将其听觉反应与被动聆听同一录音时的反应比较。说话时听觉皮层反应（M100/N1 与高 γ 活动）比聆听时受到抑制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants produce speech sounds while hearing their own voice, and the auditory responses are compared with passive listening to recordings of the same sounds. Auditory-cortex responses (M100/N1 and high-gamma activity) are suppressed during speaking compared with listening.

items.name: 改变听觉反馈下的说话
items.description: 被试说话时，自身声音的听觉反馈被实时改变（如音高或共振峰偏移、混入噪声），与未改变的反馈以及聆听回放比较。当反馈与预期声音不符时，说话时听觉 M100/N1 的抑制减弱。
items.descriptionEnglish: While participants speak, the auditory feedback of their own voice is altered in real time (for example shifted in pitch or formants, or mixed with noise) and compared with unaltered feedback and with listening to playback. The suppression of the auditory M100/N1 during speaking is reduced when the feedback does not match the expected sound.

items.name: 统计学习（言语切分）
items.description: 被试聆听连续的音节流，其中仅由转移概率界定的“词”反复出现，随后测试对嵌入词的识别。随着学习进行，神经反应除音节速率外还开始跟随词速率，这是一个频率标记的切分指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are exposed to a continuous stream of syllables in which items form recurring 'words' defined only by transitional probabilities, and are then tested on recognising the embedded words. As learning proceeds, neural responses come to track the word rate in addition to the syllable rate, a frequency-tagged index of segmentation.

items.name: 双语语言切换
items.description: 双语被试根据线索用其中一种语言命名图片或数字，语言在相邻试次间重复或切换。切换试次有反应时代价，ERP 研究报告切换试次的额中央 N2 增强，被解释为对非目标语言的抑制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Bilingual participants name pictures or digits in one of their languages as indicated by a cue, with the language either repeating or switching between trials. Switch trials incur reaction-time costs, and ERP studies report an enhanced frontocentral N2 on switch trials that is interpreted as inhibition of the non-target language.

items.name: 接受性语言切换
items.description: 双语被试阅读或聆听在两种语言之间可预测或不可预测地切换的词，执行基于理解的任务（如语义分类），而不是说话。ERP 比较切换与非切换试次，考察理解中的语言控制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Bilingual participants read or hear words that switch unpredictably or predictably between their two languages and perform a comprehension-based task (for example a semantic categorisation) rather than speaking. ERPs compare switch with non-switch trials to examine language control during comprehension.

items.name: 言语流畅性
items.description: 每个线索给定固定时长，被试尽可能多地说出以指定字母开头（音位流畅性）或属于指定类别（语义流畅性）的词，以正确词数计分。流畅性生成在 fNIRS 中提高前额叶氧合血红蛋白，在 fMRI 中激活左侧额下区域。
items.descriptionEnglish: Within a fixed time per cue, participants say aloud as many words as possible that begin with a given letter (phonemic fluency) or belong to a given category (semantic fluency); the number of correct words is the score. Fluency generation increases prefrontal oxygenated haemoglobin in fNIRS and activates left inferior frontal regions in fMRI.

items.name: 默想生词心理任务（fNIRS/EEG BCI）
items.english: Covert word generation mental task (fNIRS/EEG BCI)
items.description: 在短的提示试次中呈现一个字母，被试默想以该字母开头的词；生词试次与休息（基线）试次交替。对前额血流动力学与 EEG 特征分类，区分生词与休息，使该心理任务可作为二分类主动式 BCI 指令。
items.descriptionEnglish: In short cue-paced trials, a letter is shown and participants silently generate words beginning with it; generation trials alternate with rest (baseline) trials. Prefrontal haemodynamic and EEG features are classified to distinguish word generation from rest, so that the mental task can serve as a binary active-BCI command.

items.name: 言语流畅性 fNIRS 组块设计
items.description: 言语流畅性任务期中被试按依次给出的字母（或类别）线索出声说词，任务期前后各有重复简单序列（如元音或数数）的控制期；主要指标是任务期相对控制期的前额氧合血红蛋白增加。该协议广泛用于精神科临床 fNIRS 研究。
items.descriptionEnglish: A verbal fluency task period, in which participants say aloud words for successive letter (or category) cues, is preceded and followed by control periods of repeating a simple sequence (for example vowels or counting); the prefrontal oxygenated-haemoglobin increase during the task period relative to the control periods is the main measure. The protocol is widely used in clinical psychiatric fNIRS studies.

items.name: 动词生成
items.description: 被试看到或听到名词后，为每个名词生成一个相关动词（如“锤子”—“敲”），并与单纯复述或朗读名词比较。动词生成激活左侧额下回及语言网络其他部分，常用于临床语言偏侧化评估。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants see or hear nouns and generate an associated verb for each (for example 'hammer' - 'pound'), compared with simply repeating or reading the noun. Verb generation activates the left inferior frontal gyrus and other parts of the language network, and the task is widely used for clinical language lateralisation.

items.name: 视觉词形加工（字词定位）
items.description: 被试观看书面词语以及辅音串、伪字体、面孔或物体等对照刺激，常配合简单的检测任务。与对照串相比，书面词语在左侧腹侧枕颞“视觉词形区”诱发更强的响应，并诱发更大、左侧化的枕颞 N170（文字调谐）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants view written words alongside control stimuli such as consonant strings, false fonts, faces or objects, often with a simple detection task. Written words evoke stronger responses in the left ventral occipitotemporal 'visual word form area' and a larger, left-lateralised occipitotemporal N170 than control strings (print tuning).

items.name: 变化检测
items.description: 短暂呈现分布于整个屏幕的简单视觉项目（如彩色方块）记忆阵列，经过短暂空白保持期后呈现测试阵列，其中可能有一个项目发生变化，被试报告是否有变化。通过改变集合大小估计视觉工作记忆容量。在这一全视野配置中不能直接测得本类的标记物（对侧延迟活动），后者由偏侧化配置 MEM-CD-003 获得。
items.descriptionEnglish: A memory array of simple visual items (for example coloured squares) is briefly shown across the display, followed by a short blank retention interval and a test array in which one item may have changed; participants report whether a change occurred. Set size is varied to estimate visual working-memory capacity. In this whole-display configuration the class marker (contralateral delay activity) is not directly measurable; it is obtained with the lateralised configuration MEM-CD-003.

items.name: 延迟估计（连续报告）
items.description: 记忆阵列之后是保持期，随后探测一个位置，被试在连续量尺上复现该项目被记住的特征（如在色轮上选颜色或调整朝向）。误差分布把记忆精度与存储概率分开；保持期 EEG 活动（如 CDA）与记忆负荷和精度相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: A memory array of simple items is followed by a retention interval, after which one location is probed and participants reproduce the remembered feature of that item on a continuous scale (for example by selecting a colour on a colour wheel or adjusting an orientation). The error distribution separates the precision of memory from the probability of having stored the item; delay-period EEG activity such as the CDA is related to memory load and precision.

items.name: 偏侧化变化检测（CDA）
items.description: 每个试次开始时箭头线索指示被试只记忆双侧记忆阵列中一侧视野的项目；短暂保持期后呈现测试阵列，被试报告被提示一侧是否有项目变化。保持期内记忆一侧对侧后部电极的持续负波（对侧延迟活动，CDA）随所保持项目数增加，直至个体容量上限。
items.descriptionEnglish: An arrow cue at the start of each trial tells participants to remember the items in one hemifield of a bilateral memory array; after a short retention interval, a test array is shown and participants report whether an item in the cued hemifield changed. The sustained negativity over posterior sites contralateral to the memorised hemifield during the delay (contralateral delay activity, CDA) increases with the number of items held, up to the individual capacity limit.

items.name: 剑桥面孔记忆
items.description: 被试从多个视角学习陌生面孔，然后在难度递增的三选一强迫选择试次中（包括新视角和加噪声的图片）从干扰面孔中识别学过的面孔。该测验用于刻画个体的面孔识别能力，其成绩与面孔选择性的神经响应（如 N170 和腹侧视觉皮层面孔选择区的 BOLD 活动）相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants learn unfamiliar faces from several viewpoints and then identify the learned face among distractor faces in three-alternative forced-choice trials of increasing difficulty, including novel views and added visual noise. Performance on the test is used to characterise individual face-recognition ability and is related to face-selective neural responses such as the N170 and BOLD activity in face-selective ventral visual cortex.

items.name: 隐匿信息测试（P300）
items.description: 逐个呈现单个项目：与只有知情者才知道的信息（如模拟犯罪细节）相关的探测项、若干同样合理的无关项，以及所有被试都需以不同按键确认的靶项。探测项只对知情被试有意义，因而比无关项诱发更大的 P3b，以探测项与无关项之差检测被隐瞒的再认。
items.descriptionEnglish: Single items are presented one at a time: a probe related to information known only to knowledgeable participants (for example a detail of a mock crime), several equally plausible irrelevant items, and a target item that all participants must acknowledge with a distinct button press. Because the probe is meaningful only for a knowledgeable participant, it elicits a larger P3b than irrelevant items, and the probe-irrelevant difference is used to detect concealed recognition.

items.name: 复合试次协议（P300 隐匿信息测试）
items.description: 每个试次包含两个刺激：先是探测项或无关项，被试不论类型都按同一个键确认；随后是靶或非靶项目，需要区分性反应。这样把探测项与靶任务分开，目的是使探测项诱发的 P3b 比三刺激协议更能抵抗反测谎手段。
items.descriptionEnglish: Each trial contains two stimuli: first a probe or an irrelevant item, which participants acknowledge with a single button press regardless of type, and then a target or non-target item that requires a differentiated response. Separating the probe from the target task in this way was introduced to make the probe-elicited P3b more resistant to countermeasures than in the three-stimulus protocol.

items.name: 定向遗忘
items.description: 被试逐个学习项目，每个项目后出现记住或遗忘的指示（逐项法），随后测试全部项目的记忆。被指示遗忘的项目记得较差；项目后指示期伴随后部 α 功率与背外侧前额叶活动的变化，被解释为停止复述或主动抑制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study items one at a time, and after each item an instruction tells them to remember it or to forget it (item method); memory for all items is later tested. Forget-cued items are remembered less well, and the post-item cue period is associated with changes in posterior alpha power and dorsolateral prefrontal activity interpreted as withdrawal of rehearsal or active suppression.

items.name: 列表法定向遗忘
items.description: 被试学习第一个列表后，收到遗忘该列表或继续记住的指示，然后学习第二个列表；最后测试两个列表的记忆。遗忘指示降低列表 1 的回忆并提高列表 2 的回忆；EEG 研究把遗忘指示与振荡活动的变化联系起来，并解释为心理情境转换或抑制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study a first list of items and then receive an instruction either to forget that list or to keep remembering it, before studying a second list; memory for both lists is tested at the end. A forget instruction reduces recall of list 1 and enhances recall of list 2, and EEG studies relate the forget cue to changes in oscillatory activity that are interpreted as a shift of mental context or inhibition.

items.name: 延迟匹配
items.description: 先呈现样本刺激，经过空白延迟后呈现探测刺激，被试判断探测是否与样本相同。延迟期分离出保持过程；人类 EEG/MEG 研究报告延迟期后部 α 的调制以及随记忆内容变化的头皮 γ 功率增加。
items.descriptionEnglish: A sample stimulus is presented, followed by a blank delay and then a probe; participants indicate whether the probe matches the sample. The delay isolates maintenance, and human EEG/MEG studies report delay-period modulation of posterior alpha and increases of scalp gamma power that depend on the memorized content.

items.name: 错误记忆（DRM）
items.description: 被试学习若干词表，每个词表中的词都是同一个未呈现的关键诱饵词的语义联想词，随后进行回忆或再认测试，关键诱饵词常被错误地“记起”。ERP 研究比较学过的词、关键诱饵词与无关新词，利用额中部（FN400）和左顶叶新旧效应区分熟悉性与回忆对真实再认和错误再认的贡献。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study lists of words that are all semantic associates of a single non-presented critical lure and are later tested by recall or recognition; the critical lure is frequently falsely remembered. ERP studies compare studied words, critical lures and unrelated new words, using the mid-frontal (FN400) and left parietal old/new effects to separate familiarity- and recollection-based contributions to true and false recognition.

items.name: 数字广度
items.description: 被试听到或看到长度递增的数字序列，并按原顺序复述（顺背广度）；广度为能正确复述的最长序列。计算机化版本的 EEG 研究报告编码与保持期额中线 θ 随负荷增加。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants hear or see sequences of digits of increasing length and repeat them in the same order (forward span); span is the longest sequence reproduced correctly. EEG studies of computerised versions report load-related increases of frontal-midline theta during encoding and maintenance.

items.name: 倒背数字广度
items.description: 被试听到或看到数字序列，并按相反顺序复述；序列长度递增直到复述失败。倒序在保持之外增加了操作成分；与 ERP 兼容的计算机化版本以固定速率呈现数字并设置探测或反应期，以便对编码与保持相关活动做平均。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants hear or see sequences of digits and reproduce them in reverse order; sequence length increases until recall fails. Reversing the order adds manipulation to maintenance; ERP-compatible computerised versions present digits at a fixed rate with a probe or response period so that encoding- and retention-related activity can be averaged.

items.name: 情景未来思维
items.description: 在词语线索提示下，被试回忆具体的个人过去事件，或想象具体而合理的未来事件，通常分为构建和细化两个阶段。回忆与想象都激活包括海马和内侧前额叶在内的共同核心网络，部分区域在想象未来时比回忆过去时更活跃。
items.descriptionEnglish: Cued by words, participants either remember specific past personal events or imagine specific plausible future events, typically with separate construction and elaboration phases.
