Both remembering and imagining engage a common core network including the hippocampus and medial prefrontal cortex, with some regions more active for future than past events.

items.name: 自由回忆与词表学习
items.description: 被试逐个学习词表中的词，经过延迟或分心任务后以任意顺序尽可能多地回忆；每个学习—测试循环使用新词表。编码期之后被回忆与被遗忘词之间的活动差异（后续记忆效应，Dm）以及成功编码和提取时颅内高 γ 功率的增加是主要神经指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study a list of words presented one at a time and, after a delay or distractor task, recall as many words as possible in any order; a new list is used on each study-test cycle. Encoding-period activity that differs between later-recalled and later-forgotten words (the subsequent memory effect, Dm) and intracranial high-gamma power increases during successful encoding and retrieval are the main neural measures.

items.name: Rey 听觉词语学习测验
items.description: 朗读 15 个词的列表，连续五次学习—回忆，然后呈现一次干扰列表，再进行第一列表的短延迟回忆、长延迟回忆与再认测试。这是临床评估言语学习与记忆的标准测验；神经研究用改编版本把编码期活动与之后的回忆联系起来。
items.descriptionEnglish: A list of 15 words is read aloud and recalled over five consecutive learning trials, followed by a single interference list, a short-delay recall of the first list, a long-delay recall and a recognition test. The test is a standard clinical measure of verbal learning and memory; neural studies use adapted versions to relate encoding activity to later recall.

items.name: 元记忆（知晓感、学习判断）
items.description: 在知晓感（FOK）程序中，被试先尝试回忆问题答案或线索词的目标；对未能回忆的项目评定自己之后能认出答案的可能性，随后进行再认测试。以再认成绩评估 FOK 的准确性；fMRI 研究显示元记忆判断激活额极（前部前额叶）皮层。
items.descriptionEnglish: In the feeling-of-knowing (FOK) procedure participants first try to recall answers to questions or targets of cue words; for items they fail to recall they rate how likely they are to recognise the answer, and a recognition test follows. FOK accuracy is assessed against recognition performance, and metamemory judgments engage frontopolar (anterior prefrontal) cortex in fMRI studies.

items.name: 学习判断（JOL）
items.description: 被试学习词对等项目，每项学完后（立即或延迟）预测自己在之后测试中记住它的可能性，随后进行线索回忆测试。以回忆成绩衡量预测准确性，延迟判断通常比立即判断更准确。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study items such as word pairs and, after each item (immediately or after a delay), predict how likely they are to remember it on a later test; a cued-recall test follows. The accuracy of the predictions is measured against recall, and delayed judgments are typically more accurate than immediate ones.

items.name: 记忆相似性（模式分离）
items.description: 被试在附带编码阶段观看日常物体图片，随后把测试项目判断为“旧”“相似”或“新”；相似诱饵与学过的项目在知觉上相近。把诱饵正确判断为“相似”反映行为上的模式分离；fMRI 研究显示海马齿状回/CA3 区对诱饵的 BOLD 响应与对新项目的响应相似。
items.descriptionEnglish: After an incidental encoding phase with pictures of everyday objects, participants judge test items as old, similar or new; similar lures are perceptually related to studied items. Correctly calling lures 'similar' indexes behavioural pattern separation, and fMRI studies show lure-related BOLD responses in the hippocampal dentate gyrus/CA3 region that resemble responses to new items.

items.name: 偶然编码的记忆相似性（重复抑制设计）
items.description: 呈现日常物体图片：有的只出现一次，有的重复，有的之后出现相似诱饵，被试只做与记忆无关的偶然判断（如室内或室外），不需要再认决策。以海马对诱饵的 BOLD 反应是像重复项那样出现重复抑制、还是像新项目那样恢复，推断模式分离。
items.descriptionEnglish: Pictures of everyday objects are shown once, repeated, or followed by a similar lure while participants perform an incidental judgement unrelated to memory (for example indoor versus outdoor); no recognition decision is required. Pattern separation is inferred from whether the hippocampal BOLD response to lures shows repetition suppression like repeats or recovers like new items.

items.name: 虚拟空间导航记忆
items.description: 被试以第一人称视角学习虚拟城镇，随后导航到目标地点：或寻找新路线（寻路），或沿熟悉路线行进；测量空间记忆与导航准确性。导航与空间学习伴随颅内记录中的海马 θ 振荡，以及与使用基于地点策略相关的海马 BOLD 响应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants learn a virtual town from a first-person view and then navigate to target locations, either finding new routes (wayfinding) or following well-learned routes; spatial-memory performance and navigation accuracy are measured. Navigation and spatial learning are associated with hippocampal theta oscillations in intracranial recordings and with hippocampal BOLD responses that relate to the use of place-based strategies.

items.name: 虚拟放射臂迷宫
items.description: 在第一人称虚拟环境中，被试从带有若干臂的中央平台出发，通过进入各臂收集奖励，避免再次进入已访问的臂（工作记忆错误）和从未放置奖励的臂（参考记忆错误）。远端地标支持基于地点的策略；考察策略的版本把海马灰质与活动和地点学习联系起来。
items.descriptionEnglish: In a first-person virtual environment, participants start from a central platform with several arms and must collect rewards by visiting arms, avoiding re-entries into arms already visited (working-memory errors) and arms never baited (reference-memory errors). Distal landmarks support place-based strategies, and versions that probe strategy use relate hippocampal grey matter and activity to place learning.

items.name: 虚拟 Morris 水迷宫
items.description: 被试在四周有远端线索的虚拟圆形水池中，从不同起点出发寻找隐藏平台；之后进行无平台的探测试次，以在目标象限停留的时间衡量地点记忆。虚拟水迷宫中的地点学习与海马活动和 θ 振荡相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants navigate a virtual circular pool surrounded by distal cues to find a hidden platform from varying start positions across trials, followed by a probe trial without the platform in which time spent in the target quadrant measures place memory. Place learning in the virtual water maze is associated with hippocampal activity and theta oscillations.

items.name: n-back
items.description: 被试监视单一序列刺激流，每当当前项目与 n 个位置之前的项目相同时作出反应，每轮 n 固定。n-back 负荷在刺激不变的情况下提高工作记忆需求；负荷越高，额中线 θ 越强、后部 α 越弱、探测刺激的 P3b 越小，前额与额顶血流动力学响应也随负荷变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants monitor a single stream of serially presented stimuli and respond whenever the current item matches the item presented n positions earlier, with n fixed for a run. The n-back load increases working-memory demand while keeping the stimuli constant; higher load is accompanied by increased frontal-midline theta, decreased posterior alpha, a reduced P3b to probes and load-dependent prefrontal and frontoparietal hemodynamic responses.

items.name: 含 0-back 控制的多负荷 n-back（组块设计）
items.description: 不同负荷的 n-back 组块（通常包括对固定靶反应的 0-back 控制以及两个或以上 n > 0 的水平）与休息或彼此交替，比较或分类不同负荷水平的神经活动。这是神经影像与被动式 BCI 心理负荷研究的标准协议：负荷增加使额中线 θ 增强、后部 α 与 P3b 波幅降低、前额与额顶血流动力学响应增加。
items.descriptionEnglish: Blocks of n-back with different loads (typically a 0-back control in which participants respond to a fixed target, and two or more n > 0 levels) alternate with rest or with each other, and neural activity is compared or classified across load levels. This is the standard neuroimaging and passive-BCI mental-workload protocol: load increases frontal-midline theta, decreases posterior alpha and P3b amplitude, and increases prefrontal and frontoparietal hemodynamic responses.

items.name: 双通道 n-back
items.description: 同时呈现两个独立的刺激流，通常是屏幕上方块的空间位置与口语字母，被试同时监视两个流中的 n-back 匹配，并对视觉与听觉靶分别作出反应。两个流的结合使负荷超过单流 n-back；fMRI 研究比较单任务与双任务版本中随负荷变化的前额叶活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two independent stimulus streams are presented simultaneously, typically spatial positions of a square on a screen and spoken letters, and participants monitor both streams for n-back matches, responding separately to visual and auditory targets. Combining two streams raises the load beyond single-stream n-back; fMRI studies compare load-dependent prefrontal activity in single and dual versions.

items.name: 自适应双 n-back 训练
items.description: 被试多次训练双 n-back，每个组块后根据成绩调整 n，使任务始终保持较高难度；训练前后以未训练的测验评估迁移。该范式用于研究工作记忆训练及其神经与行为迁移效应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants train on the dual n-back over many sessions, and the level n is adjusted from block to block according to their performance so that the task stays demanding; transfer is assessed with untrained tests before and after training. The paradigm is used to study working-memory training and its neural and behavioural transfer effects.

items.name: 新旧再认
items.description: 学习阶段之后，学过的（旧）项目与未学过的（新）项目混合呈现，被试判断每个项目是旧还是新。正确再认的旧项目比正确拒绝的新项目诱发更正的 ERP：较早的额中部效应（FN400）与熟悉性相关，较晚的左顶叶效应与回想相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: After a study phase, participants see studied (old) items intermixed with unstudied (new) items and judge whether each item is old or new. Correctly recognised old items elicit more positive ERPs than correctly rejected new items: an earlier mid-frontal effect (FN400) associated with familiarity and a later left parietal effect associated with recollection.

items.name: 记得/知道再认
items.description: 测试时，被试把认出的项目分为“记得”（能回想起学习情节的具体细节）或“知道”（只有熟悉感而无回想），其他项目判为新。ERP 与 fMRI 研究比较“记得”与“知道”反应，以分离与回想和熟悉性相关的活动，如顶叶新旧效应与 FN400。
items.descriptionEnglish: At test, participants classify each item they recognise as 'remember' (recollection of specific details of the study episode) or 'know' (familiarity without recollection), and other items as new. ERP and fMRI studies compare remember and know responses to separate recollection- and familiarity-related activity such as the parietal old/new effect and the FN400.

items.name: 配对联想学习
items.description: 被试学习词—词配对，随后以每对的第一个词为线索回忆（或再认）其配对词。成功的联想编码与提取伴随海马 BOLD 活动以及颅内记录中的海马 θ 振荡。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study pairs of words and are later cued with the first word of each pair to recall (or recognise) its associate. Successful associative encoding and retrieval are associated with hippocampal BOLD activity and with hippocampal theta oscillations in intracranial recordings.

items.name: 视空间配对联想学习
items.description: 图案或物体逐一呈现在不同位置，随后被试指出每个图案或物体出现过的位置；配对数逐级增加。该任务用于记忆障碍的临床评估，fMRI 版本显示编码与提取物体—位置配对时的海马活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Patterns or objects are shown one at a time in different locations, and participants then have to indicate the location in which each pattern or object appeared; the number of pairs increases across stages. The task is used in clinical assessment of memory impairment, and fMRI versions show hippocampal activity during encoding and retrieval of object-location pairs.

items.name: 前瞻记忆
items.description: 被试执行进行中任务，同时保持一个意图：当进行中任务的刺激中出现特定事件线索时作出另一反应（事件型前瞻记忆）。前瞻记忆线索比进行中任务刺激在枕顶部诱发 N300，保持意图激活前部前额叶（额极）皮层。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants perform an ongoing task while holding an intention to make a different response when a specific event cue appears among the ongoing-task stimuli (event-based prospective memory). Prospective-memory cues elicit an N300 over occipito-parietal sites relative to ongoing-task stimuli, and maintaining the intention engages anterior prefrontal (frontopolar) cortex.

items.name: 时间型前瞻记忆
items.description: 被试执行进行中任务，同时须在指定时刻（如每隔一分钟）作出前瞻记忆反应，通常可以查看时钟；没有外部事件线索。fMRI 显示前部前额叶的短暂活动在查看时钟之前增加，与事件型前瞻记忆中报告的持续活动不同。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants perform an ongoing task and must make a prospective-memory response at specified times (for example every minute), usually with the option of checking a clock; there is no external event cue. fMRI shows transient anterior prefrontal activity that increases before clock checks, in contrast to the sustained activity reported for event-based prospective memory.

items.name: 回溯线索
items.description: 被试编码记忆阵列，在保持期中出现线索，指示哪个项目或哪一侧视野将被测试；与无线索或无信息线索相比，被提示项目的成绩提高。指向内部表征一侧的回溯线索引起后部 α 偏侧化，表现为被提示位置对侧的 α 相对降低。
items.descriptionEnglish: A memory array is encoded and, during the retention interval, a cue indicates which item or hemifield will be tested; performance improves for the cued item relative to no-cue or uninformative-cue trials. Retro-cues directing attention to one hemifield of the internal representation produce posterior alpha lateralization, with relative alpha decrease contralateral to the cued location.

items.name: 提取诱发遗忘
items.description: 被试学习类别—样例词对，然后对部分类别中的部分样例反复进行提取练习，最后回忆全部项目。被练习类别中未被练习的样例，其回忆成绩低于未被练习类别的项目；fMRI 显示，在提取练习过程中，竞争记忆在类别选择性视觉皮层中的激活模式逐渐受到抑制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants study category-exemplar pairs, then repeatedly retrieve a subset of exemplars from some categories (retrieval practice), and finally recall all items. Unpractised exemplars from practised categories are recalled worse than items from unpractised categories, and fMRI shows that the cortical activity patterns of competing memories are progressively suppressed in category-selective visual cortex across retrieval practice.

items.name: 奖赏驱动的记忆编码
items.description: 每个项目学习前，线索提示成功记住该项目将获得高奖赏或低奖赏，之后（常在延迟后）测试记忆。高奖赏线索提高中脑边缘奖赏系统的活动，预期性的奖赏相关活动与海马活动共同预测更好的后续记忆。
items.descriptionEnglish: Before each item is studied, a cue signals whether successfully remembering it will earn a high or a low reward; memory is tested later, often after a delay. High-reward cues increase activity in the mesolimbic reward system, and anticipatory reward-related activity together with hippocampal activity predicts better subsequent memory.

items.name: 重复启动（内隐记忆）
items.description: 词语、图片或面孔等刺激先呈现一次，之后（通常在附带任务中）重复呈现，在不要求有意识回忆的情况下测量重复项目的行为易化。与首次呈现相比，重复项目在腹侧视觉皮层和前额叶诱发较弱的 BOLD 响应（重复抑制），对于词语还表现为 N400 减弱。
items.descriptionEnglish: Stimuli such as words, pictures or faces are presented once and later repeated, usually in an incidental task, and behavioural facilitation for repeated items is measured without requiring conscious recollection. Repeated items evoke reduced BOLD responses in ventral visual and prefrontal cortex (repetition suppression) and, for words, an attenuated N400 relative to first presentations.

items.name: 近期探测任务（前摄干扰）
items.description: 一种项目再认（Sternberg 型）任务，其中部分负探测项属于上一试次的记忆集（近期负探测项），其余不属于；拒绝近期负探测项更慢、更易出错，反映工作记忆中的前摄干扰。解决该干扰稳定地伴随左侧额下回 BOLD 活动增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: An item-recognition (Sternberg-type) task in which some negative probes were members of the previous trial's memory set (recent negatives) while others were not; rejecting recent negatives is slower and more error-prone, indexing proactive interference in working memory. Resolution of this interference is consistently associated with increased BOLD activity in left inferior frontal gyrus.

items.name: Sternberg 工作记忆
items.description: 先呈现包含一到数个项目的记忆集，经过保持期后呈现单个探测项，被试判断探测项是否属于记忆集。反应时随记忆集大小增加而延长；保持期内额中线 θ 与后部 α 功率随记忆负荷增加而增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: A memory set of one to several items is presented, followed by a retention interval and a single probe; participants decide whether the probe was in the set. Reaction time increases with set size, and during retention frontal-midline theta and posterior alpha power increase with memory load.

items.name: 后续记忆效应
items.description: 记录项目编码时的神经活动，并按每个项目在随后记忆测试中被记住还是被遗忘进行分类。后来被记住的项目在编码时诱发更正的 ERP（记忆差异效应，Dm），并在海马和内侧颞叶表现出更强的编码相关 BOLD 活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Neural activity recorded while items are encoded is sorted according to whether each item is later remembered or forgotten in a subsequent memory test. Later-remembered items show more positive ERPs during encoding (difference due to memory, Dm) and greater encoding-related BOLD activity in the hippocampus and medial temporal lobe.

items.name: 来源记忆
items.description: 项目在两种或以上的情境之一中学习（如呈现在左侧或右侧、由两种声音之一朗读、配合两种编码任务之一）；测试时被试再认项目并报告其学习情境。除较早的再认效应外，来源信息的提取还伴随晚期持续的右额新旧 ERP 效应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Items are studied in one of two or more contexts (for example presented on the left or right, in one of two voices, or with one of two encoding tasks); at test, participants recognise items and report the context in which each was studied. Retrieval of source information is associated with a late, sustained right frontal old/new ERP effect in addition to the earlier recognition effects.

items.name: 自我参照编码
items.description: 被试在不同编码指令下判断人格形容词，例如该词是否描述自己、是否描述他人或是否具有某种字形特征，随后进行意外记忆测试。与他人参照或语义判断相比，自我参照判断带来更好的记忆，并更强地激活内侧前额叶。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants judge trait adjectives under different encoding instructions, for example whether the word describes themselves, describes another person, or has a particular structural property, and are later given a surprise memory test. Self-referential judgments produce better memory and engage medial prefrontal cortex more than other-referential or semantic judgments.

items.name: 空间工作记忆
items.description: 主试依次敲击（或计算机依次点亮）板上的若干方块，被试复现这一序列；广度为能正确复现的最长序列（Corsi 方块敲击）。空间工作记忆保持激活额顶区域的血流动力学活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: The experimenter taps (or a computer highlights) a sequence of blocks on a board, and participants reproduce the sequence; span is the longest sequence reproduced correctly (Corsi block tapping). Spatial working-memory maintenance engages frontoparietal hemodynamic activity.

items.name: 睡眠中目标记忆再激活
items.description: 学习时每个项目与各自的声音相关联（如物体声音与物体位置配对）；随后睡眠中（通常在慢波睡眠）重放其中一部分声音，醒后比较被提示与未被提示项目的记忆。线索呈现诱发慢振荡与睡眠纺锤波，这些反应与被提示项目的记忆获益相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: During learning, each item is associated with its own sound (for example an object sound paired with an object location); during subsequent sleep, a subset of the sounds is re-presented, usually in slow-wave sleep, and memory for cued and uncued items is compared after waking. Cue presentation evokes slow oscillations and sleep spindles, and these responses are related to the memory benefit for cued items.

items.name: 睡眠中气味线索的情境再激活
items.description: 整个学习过程中都有一种气味，随后在慢波睡眠中再次呈现同一气味（或无味对照）；醒后测试全部学习材料的记忆。慢波睡眠中再次接触气味可提高依赖海马的陈述性记忆的保持，并激活海马。
items.descriptionEnglish: An odour is present throughout a learning session, and the same odour (or an odourless control) is presented again during subsequent slow-wave sleep; memory for the whole learned material is tested after waking. Odour re-exposure during slow-wave sleep improves retention of hippocampus-dependent declarative memories and activates the hippocampus.

items.name: 想/不想
items.description: 被试先学习线索—目标词对，之后每个试次呈现线索并指示其回忆相应目标（想）或阻止目标进入意识（不想），最后测试全部目标的记忆。“不想”试次伴随海马 BOLD 活动降低和额中央类 N2 负波增强，被抑制的目标随后记忆成绩较差。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants learn cue-target pairs and then, on each trial, see a cue with an instruction either to retrieve the associated target (think) or to prevent it from coming to mind (no-think); memory for all targets is tested afterwards. No-think trials are associated with reduced hippocampal BOLD activity and with enhanced frontocentral N2-like negativity, and suppressed targets are later remembered less well.

items.name: 尝试运动（瘫痪患者）
items.description: 瘫痪被试按视觉提示尝试完成其无法实际执行的足部动作，并与同一足的被动运动比较。尝试运动在运动皮层足区引起感觉运动 β 节律 ERD/ERS；不给反馈。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants with paralysis are visually cued to try to perform a foot movement that they cannot overtly execute, and the attempt is compared with passive movement of the same foot. The attempt produces sensorimotor beta ERD/ERS over the foot area of motor cortex; no feedback is given.

items.name: 按口头指令尝试运动（意识障碍）
items.english: Attempted movement to spoken command (disorders of consciousness)
items.description: 意识障碍患者在床旁脑电记录中按口头指令尝试活动某一身体部位，试次在尝试运动与休息之间交替。与指令锁时、可靠的感觉运动节律变化被视为隐蔽指令跟随的证据。
items.descriptionEnglish: Patients with disorders of consciousness are instructed by spoken commands to try to move a body part, in trials that alternate between movement attempts and rest, while EEG is recorded at the bedside. Reliable command-locked sensorimotor rhythm changes are taken as evidence of covert command following.

items.name: 多类别尝试上肢与手部运动（脊髓损伤）
items.english: Multi-class attempted arm and hand movements (spinal cord injury)
items.description: 颈髓损伤被试按视觉提示尝试 5 种上肢与手部动作之一（前臂旋后/旋前、手张开、掌握、侧捏）。依据低频脑电解码动作，在线部分检测到动作时显示动作图标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants with cervical spinal cord injury attempt one of five arm and hand movements (forearm supination or pronation, hand opening, palmar grasp, lateral grasp) after a visual cue. Movements are decoded from low-frequency EEG, and in the online part a movement icon is shown when a movement is detected.

items.name: 双手协调
items.description: 被试以同相（镜像对称）或反相模式有节律地移动双手，通常由节拍器定速，并逐步加快直至反相协调失稳。协调需求反映在感觉运动节律的调制以及左右感觉运动皮层之间的相干上。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants move both hands rhythmically in in-phase (mirror-symmetric) or anti-phase patterns, often paced by a metronome whose rate is increased until anti-phase coordination becomes unstable. Coordination demands are reflected in sensorimotor rhythm modulation and in coherence between left and right sensorimotor cortices.

items.name: 闭环光标控制
items.description: 被试通过自主调节感觉运动 mu 节律，使光标从屏幕中央垂直移向上缘或下缘的目标，在线解码器将节律幅值转换为光标速度。光标的连续视觉反馈构成闭环。
items.descriptionEnglish: The participant moves a cursor vertically from the centre of the screen to a target at the top or bottom edge by volitional modulation of the sensorimotor mu rhythm, which an online decoder converts into cursor velocity. Continuous visual feedback of the cursor closes the loop.

items.name: 二维脑电光标控制
items.description: 被试将光标从屏幕中央移向周边的目标，光标的水平和垂直速度分别由 mu/β 节律幅值的加权组合驱动。自适应算法选择用户能调节的特征；光标的连续反馈构成闭环。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants move a cursor from the centre of the screen to targets placed around the periphery, with horizontal and vertical cursor velocity each driven by a weighted combination of mu/beta rhythm amplitudes. An adaptive algorithm selects the features users can modulate; continuous cursor feedback closes the loop.

items.name: 皮层内点击式光标打字
items.description: 瘫痪被试在尝试或想象手臂运动时，由运动皮层神经元放电解码出光标的二维速度，并以解码出的点击选择屏幕键盘上的按键。光标连续反馈与离散选择用于抄写打字和自由打字。
items.descriptionEnglish: A participant with paralysis controls the two-dimensional velocity of a cursor decoded from motor cortical spiking during attempted or imagined arm movements and selects keys of an on-screen keyboard with a decoded click. Continuous cursor feedback and discrete selections are used for copy typing and free typing.

items.name: 等长力控制
items.description: 被试以等长收缩（如捏力或伸腕）维持或跟踪目标力，同时记录 EEG/MEG 和表面肌电。持续收缩期间，对侧运动皮层与活动肌肉之间出现 β 频段相干，并伴随感觉运动 β 功率的调制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants maintain or track a target force with an isometric muscle contraction (e.g. pinch or wrist extension) while EEG/MEG and surface EMG are recorded. Sustained contraction is accompanied by beta-band coherence between contralateral motor cortex and the active muscle, together with modulation of sensorimotor beta power.

items.name: 抓握与手势
items.description: 被试按提示以不同的自然抓握方式抓取物体，离线从皮层脑电中解码抓握类型。感觉运动皮层上抓握特异的高 γ 活动模式提供分类所需信息。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants grasp objects with different natural grasp types after a cue, and the grasp type is decoded offline from electrocorticographic activity. Grasp-specific high-gamma patterns over sensorimotor cortex carry the information used for classification.

items.name: 复杂手势
items.description: 被试按视觉提示做出 4 种复杂手势之一，依据覆盖手部感觉运动皮层的高密度皮层脑电对手势分类。手势特异的高 γ 模式提供信息。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants form one of four complex hand gestures after a visual cue, and the gesture is classified from high-density electrocorticography over hand sensorimotor cortex. Gesture-specific high-gamma patterns carry the information.

items.name: 自定步调的自然伸手抓握（脑电）
items.description: 坐姿被试在自选时刻伸手抓取桌上的物体，用掌握（如空罐）或侧捏（如罐中的勺子），并与休息对照。以动作起始为参照分析脑电，解码抓握类型。
items.descriptionEnglish: Seated participants reach, at self-chosen times, for objects on a table and grasp them with a palmar grasp (e.g. an empty jar) or a lateral grasp (e.g. a spoon in a jar), contrasted with rest. EEG is analysed relative to movement onset to decode the grasp type.

items.name: 抓握–提起（负载与摩擦变化）
items.english: Grasp-and-lift with load and friction changes
items.description: 被试伸手以精确握持抓起一个带传感器的物体，提起并保持，再放回原处；物体的重量和接触面摩擦在试次间不可预测地变化。同步记录脑电、肌电和运动学，解码运动阶段与握力的适应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants reach for an instrumented object, grasp it with a precision grip, lift and hold it, and replace it, while the object's weight and contact-surface friction change unpredictably between trials. EEG, EMG and kinematics are recorded to decode the movement phases and the adaptation of grip forces.

items.name: 尝试手写
items.description: 瘫痪被试仿佛握笔一样尝试书写提示的字母或句子。解码每个尝试书写字符期间的运动皮层神经元放电，得到笔迹轨迹或字符身份，从而输出文本。
items.descriptionEnglish: A participant with paralysis attempts to handwrite cued letters or sentences as if holding a pen. Motor cortical spiking during each attempted character is decoded into pen trajectories or character identities to produce text.

items.name: 实际书写字母（头皮脑电）
items.description: 健康被试注视屏幕，在一个方框内用手指书写提示的字母，书写时没有笔迹的视觉反馈；通过连续解码书写运动学，从脑电中对字母分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Healthy participants write a cued letter with a finger inside a box while fixating on the screen, without visual feedback of the writing, and the letter is classified from EEG via continuous decoding of the writing kinematics.

items.name: 意向绑定（主体感）
items.description: 被试自主按键，短暂延迟后出现声音，被试判断动作或声音出现的时刻（如借助 Libet 时钟）或二者的间隔。自主动作时，知觉到的动作与结果时刻相互靠近；神经相关指标包括动作前的准备电位，以及对自身引起声音的听觉 N1 衰减。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make a voluntary key press that is followed after a short delay by a tone, and judge the timing of the action or the tone (e.g. with a Libet clock) or the interval between them. Perceived action and outcome times shift towards each other for voluntary actions; neural correlates include the readiness potential before the action and attenuation of the auditory N1 to self-caused tones.

items.name: Libet 意图时刻判断任务
items.description: 被试一边观看旋转的时钟，一边做自发的手腕或手指动作，事后报告首次感到想动的冲动或意图（W）时、或实际动作（M）时时钟指针的位置。以动作起始为零点平均的准备电位早于所报告的意图时刻出现。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make spontaneous wrist or finger movements while watching a rotating clock and afterwards report the clock position at which they first felt the urge or intention to move (W) or actually moved (M). The readiness potential averaged to movement onset begins before the reported time of intention.

items.name: 运动执行
items.description: 被试按提示完成一侧手或手指的短暂实际动作（如手指屈曲、手的张合），与休息交替。运动引起对侧感觉运动区 mu/β ERD 及运动后 β 反弹，颅内记录中可见局灶性高 γ 增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants perform a brief overt movement of one hand or finger (e.g. finger flexion, hand opening/closing) on cue, alternating with rest. Movement produces contralateral sensorimotor mu/beta ERD with post-movement beta rebound and, in intracranial recordings, focal high-gamma increases.

items.name: 单指运动
items.description: 被试按视觉提示屈曲一只手的单个手指，同时用数据手套测量手指位置，从皮层脑电中解码运动的手指（或其屈曲轨迹）。手部感觉运动皮层上具有精细躯体定位的局灶高 γ 增强可区分各手指。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants flex individual fingers of one hand in response to a visual cue while finger positions are measured with a data glove, and the moving finger (or its flexion trajectory) is decoded from electrocorticography. Focal high-gamma increases with fine somatotopy over hand sensorimotor cortex distinguish the fingers.

items.name: 地面/跑步机行走
items.description: 被试在地面或跑步机上行走，通常与站立对照，同时记录移动脑电。行走在步态周期内调制腿区感觉运动 mu/β 功率；没有试次分段。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants walk overground or on a treadmill, typically contrasted with standing, while mobile EEG is recorded. Walking modulates sensorimotor mu/beta power over the leg area within the gait cycle; there is no trial segmentation.

items.name: 节律提示手指敲击（运动定位任务）
items.description: 被试按视觉或听觉节律刺激设定的频率敲击手指，敲击组块与休息组块交替，是标准的运动定位任务。敲击组块激活对侧 M1、辅助运动区、前运动区和小脑。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants tap a finger at a rate set by a visual or auditory pacing stimulus in blocks alternating with rest, as a standard motor localizer. Tapping blocks activate contralateral M1, SMA, premotor cortex and cerebellum.

items.name: 单侧上肢多关节运动执行（6 类动作 + 休息）
items.english: Upper-limb multi-joint movement execution (six movements + rest)
items.description: 提示音与注视十字之后，视觉提示指示被试执行右上肢 6 种动作之一（肘屈/伸、前臂旋后/旋前、手张开/握拳）或休息。依据低频时域脑电解码这些动作。
items.descriptionEnglish: After a beep and fixation cross, a visual cue instructs the participant to execute one of six movements of the right arm (elbow flexion or extension, forearm supination or pronation, hand opening or closing) or to rest. The movements are decoded from low-frequency time-domain EEG.

items.name: 提示性运动想象
items.description: 每个试次由视觉箭头提示被试想象左手或右手的动作，但不实际执行。对侧手区感觉运动 mu/β 节律的偏侧化 ERD 区分两类；试次中不给反馈（筛查/校准设计）。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial a visual arrow cue instructs the participant to imagine moving the left or the right hand without executing it. Lateralised ERD of sensorimotor mu/beta rhythms over the contralateral hand area distinguishes the two classes; no feedback is given during the trials (screening/calibration design).

items.name: 四分类运动想象（左手/右手/双脚/舌头）
items.english: Four-class motor imagery (left hand / right hand / feet / tongue)
items.description: 警示音与注视十字之后出现指向左、右、下或上的箭头，提示被试想象左手、右手、双脚或舌头的运动，直到注视十字消失。四类想象产生空间分布不同的感觉运动 mu/β ERD/ERS；不给反馈。
items.descriptionEnglish: A warning tone and fixation cross are followed by an arrow pointing left, right, down or up, which instructs the participant to imagine moving the left hand, right hand, both feet or the tongue until the fixation cross disappears. The four imagery classes produce distinct spatial patterns of sensorimotor mu/beta ERD/ERS; no feedback is given.

items.name: 单侧上肢多关节运动想象（6 类动作 + 休息）
items.english: Upper-limb multi-joint motor imagery (six movements + rest)
items.description: 提示音与注视十字之后，视觉提示指示被试想象右上肢 6 种动作之一（肘屈/伸、前臂旋后/旋前、手张开/握拳）或休息。各类主要依据低频时域脑电解码；同一实验设计也记录了实际执行的动作（MOT-ME-005）。
items.descriptionEnglish: After a beep and fixation cross, a visual cue tells the participant which of six movements of the right arm to imagine (elbow flexion or extension, forearm supination or pronation, hand opening or closing) or to rest. The classes are decoded mainly from low-frequency time-domain EEG; the same session design also records executed movements (MOT-ME-005).

items.name: 足部运动想象脑开关（β 反弹）
items.english: Foot motor imagery brain switch (beta rebound)
items.description: 被试按提示短暂想象双脚动作，与休息对照；检测想象结束后头顶区的 β 反弹（β ERS），作为一个开关式指令。单一想象类对休息的设计用于可在自定步调模式下操作的“脑开关”。
items.descriptionEnglish: The participant is cued to perform brief imagery of both-feet movement, contrasted with rest, and the post-imagery beta rebound (beta ERS) over the vertex is detected as a single switch-like command. The single imagery class against rest is intended for a 'brain switch' that can later be operated in self-paced mode.

items.name: 带连续视觉反馈的左/右手运动想象
items.english: Left/right-hand motor imagery with continuous visual feedback
items.description: 与二分类提示范式相同，箭头提示被试想象左手或右手；不同的是在想象期内，在线分类器的输出以移动的视觉对象（如向左或向右移动的笑脸）连续反馈给被试。闭环使被试能在试次内调整其感觉运动节律调制。
items.descriptionEnglish: As in the two-class cue-based paradigm, an arrow cue instructs left- or right-hand imagery, but during the imagery period the output of an online classifier is fed back continuously as a moving visual object (e.g. a smiley moving left or right). The closed loop lets participants adjust their sensorimotor rhythm modulation within the trial.

items.name: 右手对双脚运动想象（提示驱动，无反馈）
items.english: Right-hand vs feet motor imagery (cue-based, no feedback)
items.description: 视觉提示指示被试想象右手或双脚的运动，按提示分试次进行，不给反馈。手的想象在左侧手区引起 ERD，脚的想象在头顶区引起 ERD/ERS，因此两类主要沿内外侧方向而非左右半球区分。
items.descriptionEnglish: A visual cue instructs the participant to imagine movement of the right hand or of the feet, in cue-paced trials without feedback. Hand imagery produces ERD over the left hand area and foot imagery ERD/ERS at the vertex, so the two classes are separated mainly along the medial-lateral axis rather than by hemisphere.

items.name: 带连续反馈的右手对双脚运动想象
items.english: Right-hand vs feet motor imagery with continuous feedback
aliases: hand vs foot MI with cursor feedback
items.description: 被试按提示想象右手或双脚运动，想象期内由在线、自适应校准的分类器驱动连续视觉反馈（光标或条形图）。该协议用于从第一次实验起训练无经验的用户。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants imagine right-hand or feet movement on cue while an online, adaptively calibrated classifier drives continuous visual feedback (a cursor or bar) during the imagery period. The protocol is used to train naive users from the first session.

items.name: 三分类运动想象（左手/右手/双脚）
items.english: Three-class motor imagery (left hand / right hand / feet)
items.description: 预备提示音后，指向左、右或下方的箭头提示被试在数秒内想象左手、右手或双脚的运动，随后为黑屏。三类结合了偏侧化的手部 ERD 与中线的足部模式。
items.descriptionEnglish: After a preparatory beep, an arrow pointing left, right or down instructs imagery of the left hand, right hand or feet for several seconds, followed by a blank screen. The three classes combine the lateralised hand ERD with the midline foot pattern.

items.name: 异步（自定步调）运动想象（含空闲态）
items.english: Asynchronous (self-paced) motor imagery with idle state
items.description: 先以两类运动想象做提示驱动的校准；评估数据为连续脑电，长度不等的想象期与空闲期交替出现，没有试次分界。解码器须连续输出想象类别或空闲态。
items.descriptionEnglish: After a cue-based calibration with two motor imagery classes, the evaluation data consist of continuous EEG in which periods of imagery of varying length alternate with idle periods, without trial demarcation. The decoder must output the imagery class or the idle state continuously.

items.name: 双手对双脚运动想象（目标提示）
items.english: Both-hands vs both-feet motor imagery (target cue)
items.description: 屏幕上方或下方出现目标，被试想象双手握拳张开（上方）或双脚动作（下方），直到目标消失，并与休息交替。双手想象与双脚想象依据外侧与中线 ERD 模式区分。
items.descriptionEnglish: A target appears at the top or bottom of the screen and the participant imagines opening and closing both fists (top) or both feet (bottom) until the target disappears, alternating with rest. Bilateral hand imagery and foot imagery are separated by their lateral vs midline ERD patterns.

items.name: 单侧上肢 11 类动作想象
items.description: 被试在三天的记录中想象（并在另外的组块中执行）单侧上肢的 11 种不同动作任务，同时记录脑电、肌电和眼电。这一直观的大任务集面向单臂多自由度控制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants imagine (and in separate blocks execute) eleven different movement tasks of one upper extremity over three recording days, with EEG, EMG and EOG recorded together. The large intuitive task set targets multi-degree-of-freedom control of a single arm.

items.name: 镜像描摹
items.description: 被试只能通过镜子看到自己的手，在视觉反馈左右或上下颠倒的条件下描摹图形（如星形），并随练习逐渐改善。视觉运动技能习得伴随运动网络 BOLD 的变化，涉及前运动区、顶叶和小脑。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants trace a figure (e.g. a star) while seeing their hand only in a mirror, so that visual feedback is reversed, and improve over repeated trials. Visuomotor skill acquisition is accompanied by changes in motor network BOLD, including premotor, parietal and cerebellar regions.

items.name: 自主运动准备（准备电位）
items.description: 被试在自选时刻完成短暂的自主动作（如手指屈曲或踝背屈），以动作起始为零点向前平均脑电。动作前中央中线区出现缓慢上升的负电位（准备电位），临近起始时在对侧变陡。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants perform brief voluntary movements (e.g. finger flexion or ankle dorsiflexion) at self-chosen times, and EEG is averaged backwards from movement onset. A slowly rising negativity (Bereitschaftspotential) begins over central midline sites before the movement and steepens contralaterally just before onset.

items.name: 提示驱动的运动相关皮层电位（联合式脑机接口）
items.description: 视觉提示指示被试何时想象（或尝试）踝背屈，测量与提示锁时的运动相关皮层电位；在联合式版本中，于提示后按校准所得的 MRCP 峰潜伏期的固定延迟施加外周（腓总）神经电刺激，使二者同时到达。
items.descriptionEnglish: A visual cue tells the participant when to imagine (or attempt) a dorsiflexion of the ankle, and the MRCP time-locked to the cue is measured; in the associative version, peripheral (common peroneal) nerve stimulation is delivered at a fixed latency after the cue so that it coincides with the MRCP peak determined in calibration.

items.name: 自定步调在线 MRCP 检测触发外周刺激
items.english: Self-paced online MRCP detection triggering peripheral stimulation
items.description: 没有外部提示，被试在自选时刻想象踝背屈，同时从脑电中连续检测 MRCP（如用匹配滤波器）；每次检测到即触发腓总神经电刺激，在运动意图与传入输入之间形成闭环。
items.descriptionEnglish: Without any external cue, the participant imagines ankle dorsiflexions at self-chosen times while the MRCP is detected continuously from EEG (e.g. with a matched filter); each detection immediately triggers electrical stimulation of the common peroneal nerve, closing the loop between movement intention and afferent input.

items.name: 运动序列学习（手指序列）
items.description: 被试反复练习一个外显已知的手指动作序列（如拇指对指或按键序列），并在多个时段（常包括睡眠后复测）测量速度与准确性。学习相关变化表现为运动网络（M1、SMA、前运动皮层、纹状体、小脑）BOLD 的改变以及感觉运动 β 调制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants repeatedly practise an explicitly known sequence of finger movements (e.g. a finger-to-thumb opposition or key-press sequence) and are tested for speed and accuracy across sessions, often including post-sleep retests. Learning-related changes appear in motor network BOLD (M1, SMA, premotor cortex, striatum, cerebellum) and in sensorimotor beta modulation.

items.name: 镜像视觉反馈
items.description: 被试移动一只手，同时在另一只被遮挡的手的位置看到该手的镜像（或数字镜像视频），产生被遮挡的手在运动的错觉。镜像反馈调制运动手同侧感觉运动皮层上的 mu 与 β ERD，相关研究用于卒中后康复。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants move one hand while viewing its mirror reflection (or a digitally mirrored video) in the position of the other, hidden hand, creating the illusion that the hidden hand moves. Mirror feedback modulates mu and beta ERD over the sensorimotor cortex ipsilateral to the moving hand, which is used in post-stroke rehabilitation studies.

items.name: 动作观察
items.description: 被试在不运动的情况下观看动作视频或现场示范（通常为手部动作），并与静态或非生物运动对照刺激比较。动作观察使感觉运动皮层上的 mu/β 节律受抑制，并激活动作观察网络中的前运动区与顶叶区域。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch videos or live demonstrations of actions (typically hand movements) without moving, compared with static or non-biological control stimuli. Observation suppresses mu/beta rhythms over sensorimotor cortex and activates premotor and parietal regions of the action observation network.

items.name: 被动运动（本体感觉刺激）
items.description: 由实验者或（气动、机器人）装置被动移动放松被试的手指或肢体（常为节律性运动），同时记录运动学信号和 MEG/EEG。主要标记物为主要由本体感觉传入驱动的感觉运动皮层活动与运动学之间的相干（皮层-运动学相干）以及 β ERD/反弹。
items.descriptionEnglish: A finger or limb of the relaxed participant is moved passively by an experimenter or a (pneumatic or robotic) device, often rhythmically, while movement kinematics are recorded together with MEG/EEG. Coherence between sensorimotor cortex activity and movement kinematics (corticokinematic coherence), driven mainly by proprioceptive afference, and beta ERD/rebound are the main markers.

items.name: 姿势平衡扰动
items.description: 站立（或坐位）被试受到突然、不可预测的平衡扰动（如支撑面平移或牵拉），并作出反应以维持稳定。每次扰动在起始后约 100-200 ms 诱发显著的额中央负波（扰动诱发 N1），并伴随 θ 频段功率增强。
items.descriptionEnglish: Standing (or seated) participants receive sudden, unpredictable perturbations of balance, such as support-surface translations or pulls, and respond to maintain stability. Each perturbation evokes a large fronto-central negativity (perturbation-evoked N1) about 100-200 ms after onset, together with theta-band power increases.

items.name: 平滑追踪眼动
items.description: 被试用眼睛跟随平滑移动的视觉目标（如做正弦运动的圆点），并与注视或眼跳条件对比。平滑追踪激活额眼区、辅助眼区、顶叶皮层和运动敏感皮层。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants follow a smoothly moving visual target (e.g. a dot moving sinusoidally) with their eyes, contrasted with fixation or saccade conditions. Pursuit activates the frontal and supplementary eye fields, parietal cortex and motion-sensitive cortex.

items.name: 中心外伸伸够任务
items.description: 被试从中央起始位置伸手（或移动光标/操纵杆）指向环绕中心径向排列的若干目标之一。运动皮层神经元放电率对运动方向呈宽调谐，群体活动或高 γ 特征用于解码伸够方向。
items.descriptionEnglish: From a central start position, the participant reaches (or moves a cursor/manipulandum) to one of several targets arranged radially around the centre. Firing rates of motor cortical neurons are broadly tuned to movement direction, and population activity or high-gamma features are used to decode reach direction.

items.name: 四方向腕部中心外伸运动（脑磁）
items.description: 被试从中心位置向四个方向之一做实际的腕部运动，依据运动区上受方向调制的低频脑磁活动解码运动方向。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants make actual wrist movements in one of four directions from a centre position, and the movement direction is decoded from directionally modulated low-frequency MEG activity over motor areas.

items.name: 简单/选择反应时
items.description: 被试对刺激尽快作出单一反应（简单反应时），或依据刺激身份在左右手反应之间选择（选择反应时）。偏侧化准备电位（运动皮层上对侧减同侧的差异波）反映反应准备的时间进程与方向。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants respond as quickly as possible to a stimulus with a single response (simple RT) or select between left- and right-hand responses according to stimulus identity (choice RT). The lateralized readiness potential, the contralateral-minus-ipsilateral difference over motor cortex, indexes the timing and direction of response preparation.

items.name: 眼跳任务
items.description: 被试注视中央，周边目标一出现即快速将眼睛移向目标。眼跳起始前出现皮层电位，眼跳产生激活额叶眼区、辅助眼区和顶内沟。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants fixate centrally and make a rapid eye movement to a peripheral target as soon as it appears. Cortical potentials precede saccade onset, and saccade generation activates the frontal and supplementary eye fields and the intraparietal sulcus.

items.name: 记忆引导眼跳
items.description: 被试注视中央时短暂看到一个周边目标，在数秒的延迟期内记住其位置，注视点变暗时向记忆中的位置眼跳；随后目标重新出现，供纠正性眼跳。延迟期活动持续存在于具有拓扑组织的后顶叶区和额叶眼区。
items.descriptionEnglish: While fixating centrally, the participant sees a peripheral target briefly, holds its location in memory during a delay of several seconds, and makes a saccade to the remembered location when the fixation point dims; the target then reappears for a corrective saccade. Delay-period activity is sustained in topographic posterior parietal areas and the frontal eye fields.

items.name: 感觉运动同步（节拍器敲击）
items.description: 被试跟随听觉节拍器用手指敲击，或敲在拍上（同步），或敲在拍间（切分），有时在节拍器停止后继续敲击。计时需求调制感觉运动 β 活动，并调用包括前运动皮层、辅助运动区和小脑在内的运动网络。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants tap a finger in time with an auditory metronome, either on the beat (synchronization) or between beats (syncopation), sometimes continuing after the metronome stops. Timing demands modulate sensorimotor beta activity and engage the motor network, including premotor cortex, SMA and cerebellum.

items.name: 序列反应时（运动序列学习）
items.description: 被试按与视觉提示位置对应的键作答；提示位置在被试不知情的情况下遵循重复序列，切换为随机序列时出现的反应时代价揭示了内隐学习。序列学习表现为偏侧化准备电位提前以及感觉运动 β 活动的调制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants press the key corresponding to the location of a visual cue; unknown to them, cue locations follow a repeating sequence, and switching to a random sequence reveals implicit learning as a reaction-time cost. Sequence learning is reflected in earlier lateralized readiness potentials and in modulation of sensorimotor beta activity.

items.name: 连续轨迹追踪
items.description: 被试用手或光标连续跟随移动的视觉目标，同时记录脑电或皮层脑电，离线重建手的位置与速度。低频脑电幅值（约 2 Hz 以下）与颅内高 γ 活动跟随运动学参数。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants continuously follow a moving visual target with the hand or a cursor while EEG or ECoG is recorded, and hand position and velocity are reconstructed offline. Low-frequency EEG amplitudes (below about 2 Hz) and intracranial high-gamma activity track the kinematics.

items.name: 在线闭环追踪（解码光标）
items.description: 被试追踪移动的目标，同时屏幕显示由低频脑电在线解码驱动的光标，即由解码轨迹而非真实的手提供连续视觉反馈。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants track a moving target while a cursor driven by online decoding of low-frequency EEG is displayed, so that the decoded trajectory, rather than the real hand, provides continuous visual feedback.

items.name: 听觉选择性注意（鸡尾酒会）
items.description: 同时呈现两路或多路语音流（或音调序列），被试只注意其中一路。被注意语流引起更大的听觉 N1，皮层对其语音包络的跟踪更强，据此可识别注意对象，这是神经调控助听设备中听觉注意解码的基础。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two or more concurrent speech streams (or tone sequences) are presented and the listener attends to one of them. The attended stream is identified from enhanced auditory N1 responses and from cortical tracking of its speech envelope, which underlies auditory attention decoding for neuro-steered hearing devices.

items.name: 注意瞬脱
items.description: 在快速序列视觉呈现流中嵌入两个靶刺激。当第二个靶刺激在第一个之后约 200–500 ms 内出现时常被漏报，被漏报的第二靶刺激所诱发的 P3b 较被报告者明显减小或消失。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two targets are embedded in a rapid serial visual presentation stream. When the second target follows the first within roughly 200-500 ms it is often missed, and missed second targets show a reduced or absent P3b compared with reported ones.

items.name: 听觉脑干反应
items.description: 以较高速率呈现短声或短纯音，并对数千次响应进行叠加平均。刺激后约 10 ms 内出现由听神经和脑干通路产生的 I–V 波，其潜伏期用于听力筛查和神经诊断。
items.descriptionEnglish: Brief clicks or tone bursts are presented at high rates and thousands of responses are averaged. The response within the first ~10 ms shows waves I-V generated along the auditory nerve and brainstem pathway; their latencies are used for hearing screening and neurodiagnosis.

items.name: 声学变化复合波
items.description: 在持续的声音中引入变化（如频率、强度或元音过渡的变化），每个试次都出现该变化而不采用 oddball 结构。变化诱发 N1–P2 复合波，即声学变化复合波，表明皮层检测到了变化，临床上用于如人工耳蜗使用者。
items.descriptionEnglish: A change is introduced within an ongoing sound (for example in frequency, intensity or a vowel transition) and is presented in every trial without an oddball structure. The change evokes an N1-P2 complex, the acoustic change complex, which indicates cortical detection of the change and is used clinically, for example in cochlear-implant users.

items.name: 附加单例与干扰抑制
items.description: 被试搜索形状靶刺激，有时会出现显著的颜色单例干扰项。被抑制的偏侧干扰项在其对侧诱发干扰正波（Pd），而捕获注意的干扰项则诱发 N2pc。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants search for a shape target while a salient colour singleton distractor is sometimes present. Lateralised distractors that are suppressed elicit a distractor positivity (Pd) contralateral to the distractor, whereas captured distractors elicit an N2pc.

items.name: 听觉诱发电位（纯音/短声）
items.description: 被动呈现纯音或短声，刺激间隔约 1 秒或更长。每个声音在额中央区诱发必然出现的长潜伏期 N1–P2 复合波，其波幅随刺激强度、上升时间和刺激间隔变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Pure tones or clicks are presented passively with inter-stimulus intervals of about one second or longer. Each sound evokes the obligatory long-latency N1-P2 complex over fronto-central sites, whose amplitude depends on stimulus intensity, rise time and inter-stimulus interval.

items.name: 听觉掩蔽
items.description: 在背景噪声或竞争掩蔽声中以不同信噪比呈现目标纯音或语音。掩蔽使听觉 N1 及目标变化诱发的 MMN 减小、延迟，与检测阈限的变化相平行。
items.descriptionEnglish: Target tones or speech are presented in background noise or with competing maskers at varying signal-to-noise ratios. Masking reduces and delays the auditory N1 and the MMN to changes in the target, in parallel with detection thresholds.

items.name: 身体知觉
items.description: 将人体及身体部位图像（不含面孔）与物体、面孔或打乱图像对比。身体图像在外侧枕颞皮层的纹外身体区引起选择性 BOLD 响应，并在 N170 时程诱发枕颞负波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Images of human bodies and body parts (without faces) are contrasted with objects, faces or scrambled images. Bodies elicit selective BOLD responses in the extrastriate body area of lateral occipito-temporal cortex and an occipito-temporal negativity in the N170 range.

items.name: 身体拥有错觉（橡胶手）
items.description: 在被试视野中的橡胶手或虚拟手与其被遮挡的真手同步受到刷触，诱发对假手的拥有感；异步刷触作为对照。该错觉与前运动皮层和后顶叶的 BOLD 增加相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: A rubber or virtual hand in view is stroked synchronously with the participant's hidden real hand, which induces a feeling of ownership of the fake hand; asynchronous stroking serves as control. The illusion is associated with BOLD increases in premotor and posterior parietal cortex.

items.name: 双眼竞争与双稳态知觉
items.description: 双眼分别呈现不同图像。虽然输入不变，知觉在两幅图像之间交替，被试按键报告每次切换；神经活动（如视觉皮层 BOLD）与报告的切换锁时，或按报告的主导知觉分类。
items.descriptionEnglish: Dissimilar images are presented to the two eyes. Although the input is constant, perception alternates between the two images, and participants report each switch by key press; neural activity, for example visual cortex BOLD, is time-locked to the reported switches or sorted by the reported dominant percept.

items.name: 频率标记双眼竞争
items.description: 两幅竞争图像以不同频率闪烁，从而标记每只眼的输入。各标记频率上的稳态响应随相应图像的主导而起伏，因此无论被试是否报告，都可以从脑活动中追踪知觉。
items.descriptionEnglish: The two rivalling images flicker at different frequencies, so that each eye's input is tagged. The steady-state response at each tag frequency rises and falls with the dominance of the corresponding image, which allows the percept to be tracked from brain activity, with or without the participant's report.

items.name: 视觉物体类别识别
items.description: 呈现不同类别物体的图像（如面孔、身体、场景、工具、动物），常以快速序列呈现。可从枕颞 N170/M170 和腹侧视觉皮层类别选择性 BOLD 响应中读出类别信息，这也是图像类别解码数据集的基础。
items.descriptionEnglish: Images of objects from different categories (for example faces, bodies, places, tools, animals) are presented, often in rapid succession. Category information is read out from the occipito-temporal N170/M170 and from category-selective BOLD responses in ventral visual cortex, and is the basis of image-category decoding datasets.

items.name: 变化盲
items.description: 同一场景的两个版本交替出现，中间插入短暂空屏或其他干扰，被试报告是否发生变化。与未察觉的变化相比，被察觉的变化诱发后部负波（视觉觉知负波），其后出现晚期正波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two versions of a scene alternate with a brief blank or other disruption, and participants report whether a change occurred. Detected compared with undetected changes elicit a posterior negativity (visual awareness negativity) followed by later positivity.

items.name: 情境线索效应
items.description: 被试在干扰项中搜索靶刺激，部分画面布局跨组块重复且靶位置固定。即使不能外显识别，重复布局下的搜索也会变快；习得的情境增强靶刺激的 N2pc，并激活海马。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants search for a target in displays of distractors, some of which repeat across blocks with a fixed target position. Search becomes faster for repeated configurations without explicit recognition; the learned context enhances the N2pc to the target and engages the hippocampus.

items.name: Posner 空间线索
items.description: 中央符号线索（箭头）提示靶刺激可能出现的位置；有效试次中靶出现在被提示位置，无效试次中出现在另一位置，中性线索作为基线。被有效提示的靶检测更快，被注意位置的靶诱发更大的视觉 P1 与 N1。
items.descriptionEnglish: A central symbolic cue (an arrow) indicates where a target is likely to appear; on valid trials the target appears at the cued location, on invalid trials at the other location, with neutral cues as baseline. Validly cued targets are detected faster, and targets at attended locations elicit enlarged visual P1 and N1 components.

items.name: 外周（外源性）线索的 Posner 范式
items.description: 在外周某一靶位置给出短暂、无预测性的闪光或增亮作为线索。线索–靶间隔短时，被提示位置的靶检测更快（注意被反射性捕获）；间隔较长时反应变慢（返回抑制）；P1、N1 的 ERP 效应也呈相同的时程。
items.descriptionEnglish: A brief, non-predictive flash or brightening at one of the peripheral target locations serves as the cue. At short cue-target intervals targets at the cued location are detected faster (reflexive capture of attention), whereas at longer intervals responses are slower (inhibition of return); the ERP effects on P1 and N1 follow the same time course.

items.name: 隐蔽空间注意（α 偏侧化）
items.description: 中央线索指引被试在保持注视的同时将隐蔽注意转向左或右视野，延迟后出现靶刺激。在线索–靶间期，与被注意侧对侧的后部 α 功率降低、同侧升高；这种 α 偏侧化反映注意的空间偏向。
items.descriptionEnglish: A central cue directs covert attention to the left or right visual hemifield while gaze stays at fixation, and a target follows after a delay. In the cue-target interval, posterior alpha power decreases over the hemisphere contralateral to the attended side and increases ipsilaterally; this alpha lateralization indexes the spatial bias of attention.

items.name: 隐蔽注意 α 偏侧化脑机接口
items.description: 用户在注视中央时将隐蔽注意转向左侧或右侧，在线逐试次分类后部 α 功率的偏侧化并给出反馈（如二元选择）。该信号不依赖眼动，可作为不依赖注视的 BCI。
items.descriptionEnglish: The user covertly shifts attention to the left or right while fixating, and the lateralization of posterior alpha power is classified in single trials online and fed back, for example as a binary choice. The signal is independent of eye movements and can serve as a gaze-independent BCI.

items.name: 面孔知觉
items.description: 将面孔与其他物体类别或打乱图像进行对比。面孔诱发更大的枕颞 N170（M170），并在梭状回面孔区等面孔选择性区域引起更强的 BOLD 响应；该对比也用作功能定位任务。
items.descriptionEnglish: Faces are contrasted with other object categories or with scrambled images. Faces elicit a larger occipito-temporal N170 (M170) and stronger BOLD responses in face-selective regions such as the fusiform face area; the contrast is also used as a functional localizer.

items.name: 闪光视觉诱发电位
items.description: 以弥散闪光刺激（常通过闭合的眼睑或护目镜给予）诱发枕区一系列正负波。闪光 VEP 用于无法进行图形刺激的情况，如婴儿或不能配合的患者。
items.descriptionEnglish: Diffuse light flashes, often delivered through closed eyelids or goggles, evoke a sequence of occipital positive and negative waves. The flash VEP is used when pattern stimulation is not possible, for example in infants or uncooperative patients.

items.name: 配对短声感觉门控
items.description: 以约 500 ms 间隔呈现成对的相同短声，每对之间间隔数秒。第二个短声诱发的 P50 通常小于第一个，S2/S1 波幅比被用作感觉门控指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Pairs of identical clicks are presented about 500 ms apart, with several seconds between pairs. The P50 to the second click is normally smaller than to the first, and the S2/S1 amplitude ratio is used as an index of sensory gating.

items.name: 味觉诱发电位
items.description: 由味觉刺激仪在持续冲洗液流中向舌面短脉冲给予味觉溶液（如蔗糖、糖精或盐），使刺激起始不伴随触觉或温度线索。味觉起始在中央区诱发潜伏期较长的味觉诱发电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Taste solutions (for example sucrose, saccharin or salt) are delivered to the tongue in brief pulses by a gustometer in a constant rinsing flow so that onset is not signalled by touch or temperature. Taste onset evokes gustatory evoked potentials with long latencies over central sites.

items.name: 心跳觉察（内感受）
items.description: 外部声音（或光）由被试的 R 波触发，延迟较短（感觉与心跳同时）或较长。被试判断刺激是否与心跳同步；可比较不同条件下与 R 波锁时的皮层响应（心跳诱发电位）。
items.descriptionEnglish: External tones (or lights) are triggered by the participant's R-waves either with a short delay, so that they seem simultaneous with the heartbeat, or with a longer delay. Participants judge whether the stimuli are synchronous with their heartbeats; cortical responses time-locked to the R-peak (heartbeat-evoked potential) can be compared between conditions.

items.name: 心跳计数任务
items.description: 在没有外部刺激、也不触摸脉搏的情况下，被试在不同长度的时间段内默数自己的心跳并报告次数，与心电记录的实际次数比较计算准确度。比较注意心跳与注意外部刺激时的心跳诱发电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Without external stimuli or feeling for the pulse, participants silently count their heartbeats during intervals of different lengths and report the number. Accuracy is computed against the ECG count. The heartbeat-evoked potential is compared between periods of attention to the heartbeat and to external stimuli.

items.name: 非注意盲
items.description: 被试执行要求较高的任务时，出现与任务无关的图案，许多被试并未察觉，每个阶段后以问卷评估。比较察觉与未察觉的被试，可分离出后部视觉觉知负波（VAN），而 P3b 主要在图案变为任务相关时出现。
items.descriptionEnglish: While participants perform a demanding task, task-irrelevant patterns appear that many participants do not notice, assessed with questionnaires after each phase. Comparing aware and unaware participants isolates a posterior visual awareness negativity, whereas the P3b appears mainly when the pattern becomes task-relevant.

items.name: 错觉轮廓知觉
items.description: 将诱导元素（如 Kanizsa “吃豆人”图形）排列成能形成或不能形成错觉图形的两种布局。与旋转诱导元素相比，错觉轮廓布局在外侧枕区调制视觉 N1 时程（IC 效应）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Inducers (for example Kanizsa 'pac-man' elements) are arranged so that they either form an illusory shape or not. Illusory contour configurations modulate the visual N1 range over lateral occipital sites (the IC effect) compared with rotated inducers.

items.name: 激光诱发电位（痛觉）
items.description: CO2 或固体激光发出的短暂辐射热脉冲在不接触皮肤的情况下选择性激活皮肤伤害感受器，诱发顶部 N2–P2 复合波，其前有偏侧化的 N1，用于评估伤害性感觉通路。
items.descriptionEnglish: Brief radiant heat pulses from a CO2 or solid-state laser selectively activate skin nociceptors without touching the skin. They evoke a vertex N2-P2 complex, preceded by a lateralised N1, that is used to assess nociceptive pathways.

items.name: 局部-全局范式
items.description: 以组块呈现五音序列，每组块中某一序列类型高频出现。末音偏离违反局部（序列内）规律时诱发 MMN；而违反全局（序列间）规律的低频序列诱发 P3b，后者与有意识加工相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Sequences of five tones are presented in blocks in which one sequence type is frequent. A deviant final tone violates the local (within-sequence) regularity and elicits an MMN, whereas a rare sequence that violates the global (across-sequence) regularity elicits a P3b that is linked to conscious processing.

items.name: 掩蔽与阈限知觉
items.description: 短暂呈现的靶刺激之后跟随掩蔽刺激（后向掩蔽）或被其环绕（元对比掩蔽），并在可见性阈限附近改变靶–掩蔽间隔。比较“看见”与“未看见”试次：觉知与后部视觉觉知负波（VAN）及其后的 P3b 相关。
items.descriptionEnglish: A brief target is followed (backward masking) or surrounded (metacontrast) by a mask, and the target-mask interval is varied around the visibility threshold. Seen versus unseen trials are compared: awareness is associated with a posterior visual awareness negativity and a later P3b.

items.name: 听觉中潜伏期反应
items.description: 以中等速率呈现短声或短纯音，分析约 10–80 ms 之间的平均响应。其中包含 Na、Pa、Nb、Pb 波，被认为来自丘脑—皮层及初级听皮层活动，用于听力学和麻醉监测。
items.descriptionEnglish: Clicks or tone bursts are presented at moderate rates and the averaged response between about 10 and 80 ms is analysed. It contains the Na, Pa, Nb and Pb waves, thought to arise from thalamo-cortical and primary auditory cortex activity, and is used in audiology and anaesthesia monitoring.

items.name: 被动 oddball（失匹配负波）
items.description: 在高频标准纯音中插入在单一物理特征（如频率、强度或时长）上不同的低频偏差纯音，被试忽略声音。偏差刺激诱发失匹配负波，一种约 100–250 ms 的额中央负波，反映对标准刺激所编码规律的违反的自动检测。
items.descriptionEnglish: Frequent standard tones are interrupted by infrequent deviant tones that differ in one physical feature (for example frequency, intensity or duration) while the participant ignores the sounds. Deviants elicit the mismatch negativity, a fronto-central negativity at about 100-250 ms that reflects automatic detection of a violation of the regularity encoded from the standards.

items.name: 语音（音位对比）失匹配负波
items.description: 以音节或元音作为标准刺激与偏差刺激，例如母语与非母语的音位对比。偏差语音诱发 MMN，其幅度取决于该对比在被试语言中是否构成音位对立，因此可反映语言特异的音位表征。
items.descriptionEnglish: Speech syllables or vowels are used as standards and deviants, for example native and non-native phoneme contrasts. Deviant speech sounds elicit an MMN whose amplitude depends on whether the contrast is phonemic in the listener's language, so the paradigm indexes language-specific phoneme representations.

items.name: 多特征失匹配负波范式（Optimum-1）
items.description: 在同一序列中呈现多种偏差类型（频率、强度、时长、声源位置和无声间隙），每个偏差与一个标准刺激交替，而不是分组块分别做 oddball。短时间记录即可得到所有偏差类型的 MMN，形成听觉辨别能力的剖面。
items.descriptionEnglish: Several deviant types (frequency, intensity, duration, sound location and a silent gap) are presented within one sequence, each deviant alternating with a standard, instead of in separate oddball blocks. MMNs to all deviant types are obtained in a short recording, giving a profile of auditory discrimination abilities.

items.name: 多目标追踪
items.description: 若干相同物体独立运动，其中一部分短暂高亮作为靶，被试需追踪至物体停止。追踪负荷调制偏侧设计中的对侧延迟活动（CDA）以及额顶注意区域的 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Several identical objects move independently; a subset is briefly highlighted as targets and must be tracked until the objects stop. Tracking load modulates contralateral delay activity in lateralised designs and BOLD in frontoparietal attention regions.

items.name: 视听多感觉整合
items.description: 呈现视听音节，口型与语音一致或冲突（如视觉 /ga/ 配听觉 /ba/），并设单通道对照。不一致刺激常产生融合知觉（McGurk 错觉），比较一致、不一致与单通道语音条件下的神经响应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Audiovisual syllables are presented in which the lip movements either match the speech sound or conflict with it (for example visual /ga/ with auditory /ba/), together with unimodal controls. Incongruent stimuli often produce a fused percept (the McGurk illusion), and neural responses are compared between congruent, incongruent and unimodal speech.

items.name: 简单刺激的视听交互（加性模型）
items.english: Audiovisual interaction with simple stimuli (additive model)
items.description: 随机呈现简单听觉刺激（纯音）、视觉刺激（闪光或图形）及其组合，常伴随检测或辨认任务。以视听响应与单通道响应之和的差值（AV −［A + V］）估计多感觉交互，在 200 ms 内即出现偏离。
items.descriptionEnglish: Simple auditory stimuli (tones), visual stimuli (flashes or shapes) and their combination are presented in random order, often with a detection or identification task. Multisensory interaction is estimated as the difference between the audiovisual response and the sum of the unisensory responses (AV - [A + V]), which shows deviations within the first 200 ms.

items.name: 运动起始视觉诱发电位
items.description: 短暂呈现的视觉运动起始（如移动条或扩张图案），对比度与亮度变化很小，诱发以运动特异的枕颞 N2 为主的瞬态 VEP。由于不需要闪烁、对刺激参数稳健，用于视觉运动通路的临床检查。
items.descriptionEnglish: A briefly presented onset of visual motion (for example a moving bar or expanding pattern), with little contrast or luminance change, evokes a transient VEP dominated by a motion-specific occipito-temporal N2. Because it requires no flicker and is robust to stimulus parameters, it is used in clinical testing of the visual motion pathway.

items.name: 运动起始 VEP 脑机接口（多目标）
items.description: 屏幕上多个目标各含一个小运动元素，其运动起始按随机顺序轮流出现。用户注意目标，检测与该目标运动锁时的运动起始 VEP（N2）以选中它，构成无闪烁、带选择反馈的视觉 BCI。
items.descriptionEnglish: Several targets on the screen each contain a small moving element whose motion onsets occur in turn in random order. The user attends to the desired target, and the motion-onset VEP (N2) time-locked to that target's motion is detected to select it, giving a flicker-free visual BCI with selection feedback.

items.name: 自然图像与影片观看
items.description: 被试在无明确任务的情况下自由观看自然图像或连续影片。以被试间时间进程的相关（ISC）以及视皮层 BOLD 对图像特征的编码来识别刺激驱动的活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants freely view natural images or continuous films without an explicit task. Stimulus-driven activity is identified as inter-subject correlation of the time courses across viewers and with visual cortex BOLD encoding of image features.

items.name: Navon 全局-局部
items.description: 呈现层级刺激（由小字母组成的大字母），被试辨认整体或局部层面。整体优先与干扰效应伴随后部 N2 和 P3b 的调制。
items.descriptionEnglish: Hierarchical stimuli (a large letter made of small letters) are presented, and participants identify either the global or the local level. Global precedence and interference effects are accompanied by modulation of the posterior N2 and of the P3b.

items.name: Oddball 范式（怪球范式）
items.description: 两类刺激随机呈现：高频标准刺激与低频靶刺激（如两种音高的纯音，或两种视觉符号）。被试对靶刺激计数或按键。靶刺激诱发顶区 P3b，靶概率越低，P3b 越大。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two kinds of stimuli are presented in random order: frequent standards and infrequent targets (for example tones of two pitches, or two visual symbols). Participants count the targets or press a button to them. Targets elicit a parietal P3b whose amplitude grows as target probability falls.

items.name: 三刺激 oddball
items.description: 在 oddball 的标准刺激与靶刺激之外，加入第三类低频非靶刺激（偏差干扰刺激或新异声音/图片）。被试只对靶刺激反应。靶刺激诱发顶区 P3b，低频非靶干扰刺激诱发潜伏期更早、额中央分布的 P3a。
items.descriptionEnglish: A third, infrequent non-target stimulus (a deviant distractor or a novel sound or picture) is added to the standard and target stimuli of the oddball. Participants respond only to targets. Targets elicit a parietal P3b, whereas the rare non-target distractors elicit an earlier, fronto-central P3a.

items.name: P300 拼写器（行/列矩阵）
items.description: 屏幕显示字符矩阵（原始版本为 6×6），各行、各列以随机顺序逐一闪烁。用户注视目标字符并默数其闪烁次数；包含该字符的行与列是低频靶刺激并诱发 P300，响应最大的行与列交点即为选中字符，并显示为反馈。
items.descriptionEnglish: A matrix of characters (6 x 6 in the original) is shown and its rows and columns are flashed one at a time in random order. The user attends to the desired character and counts its flashes; the row and the column containing it are the rare targets and elicit a P300, so the character is selected at the intersection of the row and column with the largest responses, and the selected character is displayed as feedback.

items.name: RSVP 靶检测（图像筛查）
items.description: 图像在同一位置以高速率（每秒数张）逐张呈现。被试在非靶图像中寻找低频出现的靶类别图像；通过单试次检测靶图像诱发的 P300 来标记或排序图像（如皮层耦合计算机视觉）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Images are shown one after another at the same location at a high rate (several per second). The participant looks for a rare target category among non-target images; single-trial P300 responses to targets are detected to label or rank images, as in cortically coupled computer vision.

items.name: RSVP 拼写器（不依赖注视）
items.description: 字母与符号在屏幕中央快速逐个呈现。用户注意要书写的字母，该字母出现时诱发 P300，经若干次重复后选定并显示为反馈。所有符号都出现在注视点，因而无需眼动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Letters and symbols are presented one at a time in rapid succession at the centre of the screen. The user attends to the letter to be written; its occurrences elicit a P300, the letter is selected after several repetitions and is shown as feedback. Because all symbols appear at fixation, the speller does not require eye movements.

items.name: P300 拼写器（棋盘格范式）
items.description: 较大矩阵（原始版本为 8×9）的各项被分配到虚拟棋盘格的白格与黑格，形成两个 6×6 子矩阵，按随机顺序闪烁其行与列。相邻项因而不会同时闪烁，减少了行/列拼写器的相邻错误与连续闪烁。
items.descriptionEnglish: The items of a larger matrix (8 x 9 in the original) are assigned to the white and black cells of a virtual checkerboard, giving two 6 x 6 sub-matrices whose rows and columns are flashed in random order. Adjacent items therefore never flash together, which reduces adjacency errors and double flashes of the row/column speller.

items.name: 单项闪烁 P300 界面（六幅图像）
items.description: 屏幕显示少量图像（六幅，电视、台灯、门等家居设备），每幅图像单独按随机顺序闪烁。用户注意目标指令的图像，其闪烁诱发 P300，响应最大的图像对应的指令被选中。该界面为残障用户设计。
items.descriptionEnglish: A small set of images (six, showing household devices such as a television, lamp or door) is displayed, and each image is flashed on its own in random order. The user attends to the image of the desired command, whose flashes elicit a P300; the command is selected from the image with the largest response. The interface was designed for disabled users.

items.name: 听觉空间 P300 脑机接口（AMUSE）
items.description: 短促声音以随机顺序从被试周围的多个扬声器播放（公开数据集中为环形排列的 8 个扬声器）。用户注意与目标选项对应的方向，该方向的声音诱发 P300，从而在完全没有视觉刺激的情况下实现多类选择与拼写。
items.descriptionEnglish: Short sounds are played in random order from several loudspeakers placed around the listener (eight in a circle in the public dataset). The user attends to the direction associated with the desired choice; sounds from that direction elicit a P300, which allows multi-class selection and spelling without any visual stimulation.

items.name: 触觉 P300 脑机接口
items.description: 放置在身体多个部位（如腰部一圈）的振动器按随机顺序逐一振动。用户在干扰振动中注意目标振动器，目标振动诱发 P300，据此识别所选位置。
items.descriptionEnglish: Vibrotactile stimulators (tactors) placed at several body sites, for example around the waist, vibrate one at a time in random order. The user attends to the vibrations of the target tactor among the distracters; target vibrations elicit a P300 that identifies the chosen location.

items.name: 嗅觉诱发电位
items.description: 通过嗅觉刺激仪将气味以短脉冲形式嵌入恒温加湿的持续气流中，使气味出现时不伴随触觉或温度变化。气味起始诱发潜伏期较长的嗅觉事件相关电位（N1、P2 及其后的正波）。
items.descriptionEnglish: Odorants are delivered in brief pulses embedded in a constant warm, humidified air stream (olfactometer) so that no tactile or thermal change accompanies the odour. Odour onset evokes olfactory event-related potentials (N1, P2 and later positivity) with long latencies.

items.name: 刺激遗漏范式
items.description: 外部定时的规则声音序列中偶尔遗漏一个刺激。尽管没有输入，在被遗漏声音的预期时刻仍诱发遗漏响应，被视为感觉预测的证据。
items.descriptionEnglish: A regular, externally timed sound sequence occasionally omits a stimulus. Although no input arrives, an omission response is evoked at the expected time of the missing sound, taken as evidence of sensory prediction.

items.name: 自发产生声音的遗漏范式
items.description: 被试自定步调按键（约每秒一次），每次按键通常产生一个声音，偶尔按键后没有声音。自发产生的声音被遗漏时，诱发与听觉响应相似的遗漏响应；声音身份可预测时响应更大，表明存在声音特异的预测。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants press a button at their own pace (about once per second), and each press normally produces a sound; occasionally the press produces no sound. Omissions of the self-generated sound evoke responses resembling the auditory response, larger when the identity of the sound is predictable, which shows sound-specific prediction.

items.name: 失谐谐波与同时声音分离
items.description: 呈现复合音，其中某个谐波或调谐或失谐。失谐使听者感知到两个同时存在的声音，并诱发客体相关负波（ORN），即约 150–250 ms 的负性差异波，在忽略声音时也会出现。
items.descriptionEnglish: Complex tones are presented in which one harmonic is either in tune or mistuned. Mistuning makes listeners hear two concurrent sounds and elicits the object-related negativity, a negative difference at about 150-250 ms, which is present even when the sounds are ignored.

items.name: 棋盘格翻转 VEP
items.description: 被试注视棋盘格中心，棋盘格以固定速率进行黑白翻转。每次翻转诱发一个 VEP，其稳定的枕区 P100 潜伏期是临床评估视神经传导的标准指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: A black-and-white checkerboard reverses contrast at a fixed rate while the participant fixates its centre. Each reversal evokes a VEP with a robust occipital P100, whose latency is the standard clinical measure of optic nerve conduction.

items.name: 视网膜拓扑映射
items.description: 闪烁棋盘格构成的缓慢旋转楔形和扩张环周期性地扫过视野。每个体素视觉皮层 BOLD 响应在刺激频率上的相位给出其偏好的极角或离心率，据此绘制视野图并划定早期视觉区边界。
items.descriptionEnglish: A slowly rotating wedge and an expanding ring of flickering checkerboard sweep periodically across the visual field. The phase of the visual cortex BOLD response at the stimulation frequency at each voxel gives its preferred polar angle or eccentricity, which maps the visual field and delineates the borders of early visual areas.

items.name: 群体感受野（pRF）映射
items.description: 在 fMRI 中呈现高对比图案孔径，典型为沿多个方向扫过视野的条带并穿插空白期（也可用环和楔形）。对每个体素的时间进程拟合群体感受野模型（位置与大小），同时得到视野图与感受野大小。
items.descriptionEnglish: Apertures of high-contrast pattern, typically bars moving across the visual field in several directions with blank periods (and also rings and wedges), are shown during fMRI. A model of each voxel's population receptive field (position and size) is fitted to the time course, giving visual field maps together with receptive field size.

items.name: 呼吸相关诱发电位
items.description: 通过口器在吸气起始时短暂阻断气道（或施加吸气阻力负荷）。气流中断在中央—顶区诱发呼吸相关诱发电位，用于研究呼吸内感受。
items.descriptionEnglish: Brief occlusions of the airway at inspiration onset (or inspiratory resistive loads) are delivered through a mouthpiece. The interruption evokes a respiratory-related evoked potential over centro-parietal sites, used to study respiratory interoception.

items.name: 视觉对称知觉
items.description: 呈现对称与随机的点阵或多边形图案，持续约 1 秒或更长。相对于随机图案，对称图案在约 250 ms 起产生持续性后部负波（SPN），其波幅随对称程度增加而增大。
items.descriptionEnglish: Symmetrical and random dot or polygon patterns are presented for about one second or longer. Symmetrical patterns produce a sustained posterior negativity relative to random patterns, starting at roughly 250 ms, whose amplitude scales with the proportion of symmetry.

items.name: 听觉流分离
items.description: 以不同频率间隔和速率呈现交替音序列（如 ABA- 三音组），使其被听成一个或两个声流。只有在声流分离时，定义在单一声流内的偏差才诱发 MMN，以此作为声流形成的指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Alternating tone sequences (for example ABA- triplets) are presented with varying frequency separation and rate, so that they are heard as one or as two streams. Deviants defined within one stream elicit an MMN only when the streams are segregated, which is used as an index of stream formation.

items.name: 触觉空间注意
items.description: 对左右手（或多个身体部位）给予触觉刺激，被试注意其中一个部位以检测低频靶刺激。被注意部位的刺激诱发增强的体感 N140，被注意的靶刺激还会诱发 P3b。
items.descriptionEnglish: Tactile stimuli are delivered to the left and right hands (or several body sites) while participants attend to one location to detect infrequent targets. Stimuli at the attended location elicit an enhanced somatosensory N140, and attended targets additionally elicit a P3b.

items.name: 音调拓扑映射
items.description: 按频率递进（或随机顺序）呈现纯音或窄带声。拟合每个体素听皮层 BOLD 响应的最佳频率，可显示初级听皮层及周边听区的音调拓扑梯度。
items.descriptionEnglish: Tones or narrow-band sounds are presented in progressions of frequency (or in randomised order). Fitting the preferred frequency of the auditory cortex BOLD response at each voxel reveals the tonotopic gradients of primary and surrounding auditory fields.

items.name: 视觉失匹配负波
items.description: 被试执行无关任务时，高频标准视觉刺激中穿插低频偏差刺激（如颜色、朝向或面部表情的变化）。偏差刺激在约 150–350 ms 诱发后部负波，即视觉失匹配负波，被视为听觉 MMN 的视觉对应物。
items.descriptionEnglish: Frequent standard visual stimuli are interrupted by rare deviants (for example in colour, orientation or facial expression) while the participant performs an unrelated task. Deviants elicit a posterior negativity at roughly 150-350 ms, the visual mismatch negativity, considered the visual counterpart of the auditory MMN.

items.name: 嗓音知觉（颞叶嗓音区定位）
items.description: 将人声（言语和非言语发声）组块与非人声环境声组块对比。人声沿颞上沟和颞上回引起更强的 BOLD 响应，据此界定颞叶嗓音区。
items.descriptionEnglish: Blocks of vocal sounds (speech and non-speech vocalisations) are contrasted with blocks of non-vocal environmental sounds. Voices evoke stronger BOLD responses along the superior temporal sulcus and gyrus, defining the temporal voice areas.

items.name: 视觉搜索
items.description: 被试在干扰项中搜索由单一特征或特征结合定义的靶刺激。偏侧呈现的靶刺激诱发 N2pc，即约 200–300 ms 在被注意项目对侧后部电极出现的负波，反映注意选择。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants search a display for a target defined by a single feature or by a conjunction of features among distractors. Lateralised targets elicit the N2pc, a negativity over posterior sites contralateral to the attended item at about 200-300 ms that indexes attentional selection.

items.name: 几何图形动画心智化（Frith-Happé 动画）
items.description: 短动画中移动的几何图形表现出诱发心理状态归因的互动（如哄骗、嘲弄）、目标导向动作或随机运动，被试对其进行描述或分类。心理状态类动画增强颞顶联合区与内侧前额叶的活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: Short animations of moving geometric shapes depict interactions that invite mental-state attribution (e.g. coaxing, mocking), goal-directed actions or random movement, and participants describe or classify them. Mental-state animations increase activity in the temporoparietal junction and medial prefrontal cortex.

items.name: 生物运动知觉
items.description: 将表现人体动作的光点显示与保留局部光点运动但破坏身体结构的打乱版或倒置版进行比较。完整生物运动比对照刺激诱发更大的后部 N170／N2 以及后颞上沟 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Point-light displays depicting human actions are compared with scrambled or inverted versions in which the local dot motions are kept but the body configuration is destroyed. Intact biological motion evokes larger posterior N170/N2 responses and pSTS BOLD than the control displays.

items.name: 社会从众
items.description: 被试先对面孔等项目评分，随后看到与其一致或冲突的群体评分，之后再次评分。与群体意见冲突引发类似预测误差的反应：后内侧额叶（喙部扣带区）BOLD 增强、腹侧纹状体 BOLD 减弱，并可预测之后的从众。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants rate items such as faces, are then shown a group rating that agrees or conflicts with theirs, and later re-rate the items. Conflict with the group elicits a prediction-error-like response, with increased posterior medial frontal (rostral cingulate) BOLD and decreased ventral striatal BOLD, which predicts later conformity.

items.name: 网络传球社会排斥（Cyberball）
items.description: 被试与名义上的其他玩家进行虚拟传球游戏，其他玩家先接纳被试，随后不再把球传给被试。排斥阶段伴随背侧前扣带 BOLD 变化；在脑电中，接球事件诱发的 P3b 在接纳与排斥条件间不同。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants play a virtual ball-tossing game with ostensible co-players who first include them and then stop passing the ball to them. Exclusion is associated with dorsal anterior cingulate BOLD, and ball-receipt events in EEG elicit P3b differences between inclusion and exclusion.

items.name: 独裁者博弈
items.description: 独裁者决定如何在自己与不能作出回应的匿名被动接受者之间分配一笔钱。亲社会选择的价值反映在腹内侧前额叶 BOLD 中。
items.descriptionEnglish: A dictator decides how to divide an endowment between themselves and a passive anonymous recipient who cannot respond. The value of prosocial choices is reflected in ventromedial prefrontal BOLD.

items.name: 慈善捐赠任务
items.description: 被试在多个试次中决定是否从自己的本金中向真实慈善机构捐款，并与自己获得金钱或强制向慈善机构转移的试次比较。捐赠决策激活中脑边缘奖赏系统与腹内侧前额叶价值信号。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants decide on repeated trials whether to donate money from their own endowment to real charitable organisations, compared with trials in which they receive money for themselves or in which transfers to the charity are mandatory. Donation decisions engage the mesolimbic reward system and ventromedial prefrontal value signals.

items.name: 真人双向目光接触
items.description: 两名同伴面对面，在相互注视对方眼睛与注视对照目标（如照片中的眼睛）之间交替，同时记录双方脑活动。真实目光接触增强额、颞、顶区血流动力学信号的脑间相干。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two partners face each other and alternate between looking into each other's eyes and looking at a control target such as eyes in a photograph, while both brains are recorded. Real eye contact increases cross-brain coherence of hemodynamic signals in frontal, temporal and parietal regions.

items.name: 目光线索与共同注意
items.description: 中央面孔先将视线转向一侧，随后外周出现靶刺激；即使视线方向不能预测靶位置，被注视位置的靶刺激也被更快检测。视线线索调制面孔诱发的 N170 与靶刺激诱发的 P1，并激活后颞上沟。
items.descriptionEnglish: A central face shifts its gaze to one side before a peripheral target appears; targets at the gazed-at location are detected faster even when gaze does not predict target location. Gaze cues modulate the face-evoked N170 and target-evoked P1 and engage the pSTS.

items.name: 注视联动的交互式共同注意
items.description: 眼动仪把被试的注视与屏幕上的虚拟同伴联动：同伴的目光跟随被试看向物体（自我发起的共同注意）、引导被试看向物体（他人发起），或看向别处（非共同注意对照）。发起共同注意除后颞上沟外还激活腹侧纹状体奖赏区。
items.descriptionEnglish: An eye tracker links the participant's gaze to an on-screen partner, so that the partner's eyes follow the participant to an object (self-initiated joint attention), lead the participant to an object (other-initiated), or look elsewhere (non-joint control). Initiating joint attention recruits ventral striatal reward regions in addition to the pSTS.

items.name: 内隐联想测验
items.description: 被试用两个按键对来自两个概念类别和两个属性类别的词或图片进行归类；在不同组块中，按键配对与假定的联想相容或不相容。不相容配对使反应变慢，并调制 N400 与晚期正电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants sort words or pictures from two concept categories and two attribute categories using two response keys, in blocks where the key pairings are compatible or incompatible with an assumed association. Incompatible pairings slow responses and modulate the N400 and late positive potential.

items.name: 模仿抑制（自动模仿）
items.description: 被试根据提示执行手指动作，同时观看一只手做相同（一致）或不同（不一致）的动作；观察到不一致动作时反应变慢。模仿抑制涉及颞顶联合区 BOLD，动作观察则调制感觉运动节律。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants execute a cued finger movement while watching a hand perform the same (congruent) or a different (incongruent) movement; incongruent observed actions slow responses. Imitation inhibition involves temporoparietal junction BOLD, and action observation modulates sensorimotor rhythms.

items.name: 联合动作与人际协调
items.description: 两名或多名被试为共同目标协调动作，例如同步手指敲击、联合按键或合奏，通常同时记录双方的脑活动。协调过程调制感觉运动节律，并伴随同伴之间的脑间同步。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two or more participants coordinate their movements toward a shared goal, for example synchronised finger tapping, joint button presses or ensemble playing, often while both brains are recorded simultaneously. Coordination modulates sensorimotor rhythms and is accompanied by inter-brain synchrony between partners.

items.name: 道德两难判断
items.description: 被试阅读道德两难情境（如电车难题的各种变体），这些情境在伤害行为是否由本人亲自实施上有所不同，并判断该行为是否恰当。与非亲身及非道德两难相比，亲身两难增强内侧前额叶 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants read moral dilemmas, such as variants of the trolley problem, that differ in how personally the harmful action is carried out, and judge whether the action is appropriate. Personal dilemmas increase medial prefrontal BOLD relative to impersonal and non-moral dilemmas.

items.name: 自我名字范式
items.description: 被试被动聆听，自己的名字以较低概率夹在其他名字中出现。自身名字比其他名字诱发更大的 P3b，这一反应也用于意识障碍患者的检测。
items.descriptionEnglish: The participant's own first name is presented infrequently among other names while the participant listens passively. The own name elicits a larger P3b than other names, a response also probed in patients with disorders of consciousness.

items.name: 主动计数自身名字范式
items.description: 呈现包含被试自身名字的口语名字序列；在不同组块中，指示被试数自己的名字、数另一个目标名字或被动聆听。被主动计数的名字所诱发的 P3 大于被动聆听，可用于检测意识障碍患者能否执行指令。
items.descriptionEnglish: Sequences of spoken names that include the participant's own name are presented, and in different blocks the participant is instructed to count their own name, to count another target name, or to listen passively. The P3 to a voluntarily counted name is larger than during passive listening, which is used to detect command following in patients with disorders of consciousness.

items.name: 疼痛共情
items.description: 伴侣在场，符号线索提示即将接受疼痛或非疼痛刺激的是被试本人还是伴侣，从而比较自身疼痛与他人疼痛。观察他人疼痛增强前岛叶 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: With a partner present, symbolic cues indicate whether the participant or the partner is about to receive painful or non-painful stimulation, so that pain to self and observed pain to the other can be compared. Observed pain increases anterior insula BOLD.

items.name: 疼痛共情图片任务
items.description: 被试观看手或脚处于疼痛或非疼痛日常情境中的照片，评定画中人的疼痛强度或仅观看。疼痛图片增强前岛叶与前扣带 BOLD，并增大晚期正电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants view photographs of hands or feet in painful or non-painful everyday situations and judge the pain intensity felt by the depicted person or simply observe. Painful pictures increase anterior insula and anterior cingulate BOLD and enhance the late positive potential.

items.name: 种族与群体身份面孔分类
items.description: 呈现种族（常同时包括性别）不同的面孔，被试按种族、性别或无关特征分类。包括视觉 P2 在内的早期注意相关 ERP 成分在内群体与外群体面孔之间存在差异。
items.descriptionEnglish: Faces varying in race (and often gender) are presented while participants categorize them by race, gender or an unrelated feature. Early attention-related ERP components, including the visual P2, differ between ingroup and outgroup faces.

items.name: 眼中读心测验
items.english: Reading the mind in the eyes
aliases: Reading the Mind in the Eyes Test
items.description: 呈现面孔眼部区域的照片，被试从四个心理状态词中选出最能描述此人所想或所感的一个，并与年龄或性别判断等对照任务比较。心理状态判断激活颞顶联合区与内侧前额叶。
items.descriptionEnglish: Photographs of the eye region of faces are shown and participants choose which of four mental-state words best describes what the person is thinking or feeling, compared with a control judgement such as age or gender. Mental-state judgements engage the temporoparietal junction and medial prefrontal cortex.

items.name: 自我面孔识别
items.description: 被试观看或分类自己的面孔、熟悉面孔和陌生面孔，有时使用自我与他人之间的形变面孔。自我面孔调制 N170，并比他人面孔诱发更大的 P3b。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants view or classify their own face, familiar faces and unfamiliar faces, sometimes as morphs between self and other. The own face modulates the N170 and elicits a larger P3b than other faces.

items.name: 社会评价反馈（社会判断范式）
items.description: 被试被告知同伴已判断是否喜欢他们，并接收与其预期一致或不一致的接纳或拒绝反馈。背侧前扣带 BOLD 反映预期违背，腹侧前扣带则对社会反馈的效价作出反应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are led to believe that peers have judged whether they like them, and receive acceptance or rejection feedback that is consistent or inconsistent with their expectations. Dorsal anterior cingulate BOLD tracks expectancy violation, whereas ventral anterior cingulate responds to the valence of the social feedback.

items.name: 心理理论（错误信念）
items.description: 被试观看或聆听一个短故事：主人公没有看到物品被移走，因而对其位置持有错误信念；随后回答主人公会到哪里寻找，以及现实与记忆控制问题。信念归因增强颞顶联合区 BOLD。
