items.descriptionEnglish: Participants watch or listen to a short story in which a character does not see an object being moved and therefore holds a false belief about its location, and then answer a question about where the character will look, alongside reality and memory control questions. Belief attribution increases BOLD in the temporoparietal junction.

items.name: 错误信念－错误照片定位任务
items.description: 被试以组块方式阅读简短文字故事：错误信念故事描述人物过时的信念，与之匹配的错误照片故事描述照片或地图等过时的物理表征，每个故事后回答判断题。二者之差分离出信念归因，增强颞顶联合区 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants read short written stories in blocks; false-belief stories describe a character's outdated belief, and matched false-photograph stories describe an outdated physical representation such as a photograph or map, each followed by a true/false question. The contrast isolates belief attribution and increases BOLD in the temporoparietal junction.

items.name: 第三方惩罚
items.description: 未受影响的第三方观察另外两名玩家之间的分配决策（如独裁者与接受者），并可花费自己的资源惩罚不公平行为。惩罚决策激活背外侧前额叶 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: An unaffected third party observes a distribution decision between two other players, for example a dictator and a recipient, and can spend own resources to punish unfair behaviour. Punishment decisions engage dorsolateral prefrontal BOLD.

items.name: 单次信任（投资）博弈
items.description: 投资者决定把多少本金转给匿名受托人，转出金额被放大，受托人再决定返还多少；每对被试只进行一次。对方的决策在脑电中诱发反馈相关负波，在 fMRI 中引起纹状体奖赏 BOLD。
items.descriptionEnglish: An investor decides how much of an endowment to send to an anonymous trustee, the amount is multiplied, and the trustee decides how much to return; each pair plays once. Partner decisions elicit the feedback-related negativity in EEG and striatal reward BOLD in fMRI.

items.name: 重复囚徒困境
items.description: 两名玩家在多轮中同时选择合作或背叛，每轮后公布双方选择与收益；双方合作的收益高于双方背叛，但每人都有背叛的诱惑。相互合作与纹状体奖赏 BOLD 有关，对方的选择诱发反馈相关负波。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two players repeatedly and simultaneously choose to cooperate or defect, and after each round both choices and payoffs are revealed; mutual cooperation pays more than mutual defection but each player is tempted to defect. Mutual cooperation is associated with striatal reward BOLD, and partner choices elicit the feedback-related negativity.

items.name: 固定搭档多轮信任博弈
items.english: Multi-round trust game with a fixed partner
items.description: 同一对投资者与受托人连续进行多轮投资博弈，双方的决策逐渐形成声誉，影响对方之后的选择；超扫描版本同时记录两名玩家。受托人尾状核中的互惠信号随轮次推进而提前出现。
items.descriptionEnglish: The same investor and trustee play the investment game for many consecutive rounds, so that each player's decisions build a reputation that shapes the partner's later choices; in hyperscanning versions both players are scanned. Reciprocity signals in the trustee's caudate come to anticipate the investor's decisions over rounds.

items.name: 最后通牒博弈
items.description: 提议者提出一笔钱的分配方案，回应者接受则双方按方案获得报酬，拒绝则双方都得不到。不公平提议比公平提议引起更强的前岛叶 BOLD，并诱发更大的内侧额叶负波（FRN）。
items.descriptionEnglish: A proposer offers a split of a sum of money and the responder accepts it, so both are paid, or rejects it, so neither is paid. Unfair offers increase anterior insula BOLD and elicit a larger medial frontal negativity (FRN) than fair offers.

items.name: 视觉观点采择
items.description: 被试判断场景中另一个体能看到什么（一级），或从其视角看场景是什么样子（二级），并与从自身视角作出的判断比较。采择他人视角激活颞顶联合区，并调制后部 α 功率。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants judge what another agent in a scene can see (level 1) or how the scene looks from that agent's viewpoint (level 2), compared with judgements from their own perspective. Taking another's perspective engages the temporoparietal junction and modulates posterior alpha power.

items.name: 武器识别任务
items.description: 短暂呈现某社会群体（如黑人或白人）的面孔启动刺激，随后呈现枪或工具图片，被试在时间压力下分类；与刻板印象一致的错误反映刻板偏差。启动刺激与靶刺激调制视觉 P2 以及与控制相关的额中央 N2。
items.descriptionEnglish: A briefly presented face prime of a social group (e.g. Black or White) precedes a picture of a gun or tool that participants classify under time pressure; race-congruent errors index stereotype bias. Primes and targets modulate the visual P2 and the fronto-central N2 associated with control.

items.name: 听觉稳态响应
items.description: 以恒定速率（经典为约 40 Hz）被动呈现短声或调幅音。听觉系统跟随刺激速率，在该频率产生听觉稳态响应，用于估计听阈（也用 80–100 Hz 调制）和探测 γ 频段功能。
items.descriptionEnglish: Clicks or amplitude-modulated tones are presented passively at a constant rate, classically around 40 Hz. The auditory system follows the stimulation rate, producing an auditory steady-state response at that frequency, which is used to estimate hearing thresholds (also with 80-100 Hz modulation) and to probe gamma-band function.

items.name: 基于 ASSR 的听觉脑机接口（选择性注意两路声流）
items.english: ASSR-based auditory BCI (selective attention to two streams)
items.description: 两路调制（拍）频率不同的短纯音串（如 37 Hz 与 43 Hz）同时从左右两侧扬声器播放。用户注意其中一路，比较被注意速率与另一速率上的 ASSR 作二元选择，完全不需要视觉；该配置已在线运行。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two tone-burst trains with different modulation (beat) rates, for example 37 and 43 Hz, are played at the same time from loudspeakers on the left and right. The user attends to one of them, and the ASSR at the attended rate is compared with the other to make a binary, vision-free choice; the configuration has been run online.

items.name: 节律与节拍跟随
items.description: 被试聆听节奏性声音模式或音乐，有时同时想象某种节拍结构。脑电频谱在节拍和拍律频率处出现峰值，被解释为神经活动对所知觉节拍的夹带。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants listen to rhythmic sound patterns or music, sometimes while imagining a metre. The EEG shows peaks at the beat and metre frequencies in the frequency spectrum, interpreted as neural entrainment to the perceived beat.

items.name: 编码调制视觉诱发电位
items.description: 每个目标按照伪随机二值编码闪烁，通常为同一 m 序列的不同循环移位。将脑电响应与各编码对应的模板进行匹配，识别被注视的目标，从而在拼写器中支持大量目标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Each target flickers according to a pseudorandom binary code, typically circularly shifted versions of one m-sequence. The attended target is identified by matching the EEG response to code-specific templates, which allows many targets in a speller.

items.name: 调制 Gold 码 c-VEP 拼写器
items.english: c-VEP speller with modulated Gold codes
items.description: 6×6 拼写矩阵的每个单元以各自的调制 Gold 码闪烁，这些伪随机序列彼此不是时间移位关系。将对某一编码的响应建模为对其长短闪光的瞬态响应的叠加（重卷积），从而用少量训练数据预测所有编码的模板；选中单元显示为反馈。
items.descriptionEnglish: Each cell of a 6 x 6 speller matrix flickers with its own modulated Gold code, a pseudorandom sequence that is not a time shift of the others. The response to a code is modelled as the superposition of transient responses to its short and long flashes (reconvolution), so templates for all codes can be predicted from limited training data; the selected cell is shown as feedback.

items.name: 突发（burst）编码 c-VEP
items.description: 目标以由短促闪光突发组成的稀疏序列编码，而不是致密的 m 序列。目的是诱发更大、更易区分的瞬态响应，减少所需校准数据，并减轻刺激带来的疲劳；公开数据集使用 4 个目标、2.2 s 刺激期，并有 100% 与 40% 两种幅度深度。
items.descriptionEnglish: Targets are coded by sparse sequences of short flash bursts instead of dense m-sequences. The aim is to elicit larger, more distinct transient responses, to reduce the calibration data needed and to make the stimulation less tiring; the public dataset uses four targets with a 2.2 s stimulation period, at full and at 40 % amplitude depth.

items.name: 频率跟随响应
items.description: 低频纯音重复呈现多次。听觉脑干的锁相活动跟随刺激波形，平均后的响应重现刺激频率。
items.descriptionEnglish: Low-frequency pure tones are repeated many times. Phase-locked activity of the auditory brainstem follows the stimulus waveform, so that the averaged response reproduces the stimulus frequency.

items.name: 语音诱发 FFR（复杂声听觉脑干反应）
items.description: 短辅音–元音音节（如 /da/）或其他复杂声重复呈现数千次，常采用交替极性。平均后的脑干反应包含对辅音的起始响应，以及重现元音基频与谐波的频率跟随成分；其保真度用于研究发育、老化、音乐训练和语言障碍中的语音编码。
items.descriptionEnglish: A short consonant-vowel syllable such as /da/ (or another complex sound) is repeated thousands of times, often in alternating polarity. The averaged brainstem response contains an onset response to the consonant and a frequency-following component that reproduces the fundamental frequency and harmonics of the vowel; its fidelity is used to study speech encoding in development, ageing, musicians and language disorders.

items.name: 快速周期听觉刺激
items.description: 以较快的固定速率呈现短声，并以较慢的周期速率插入目标类别的声音（如人声）。oddball 频率处的响应表明类别辨别，与视觉 FPVS 相类似。
items.descriptionEnglish: Short sounds are presented at a fast fixed rate, with sounds of a target category (for example voices) inserted at a slower periodic rate. A response at the oddball frequency indicates category discrimination, analogous to visual FPVS.

items.name: 快速周期视觉刺激（频率标记）
items.description: 以较快的固定速率（如 6 Hz）呈现图像，并以较慢的周期速率（如每第五张）插入不同类别或身份的图像。在 oddball 频率及其谐波处出现、区别于基频响应的反应，表明大脑对 oddball 类别进行了辨别。
items.descriptionEnglish: Images are presented at a fast fixed rate (for example 6 Hz), and an image of a different category or identity appears at a slower periodic rate (for example every fifth image). A response at the oddball frequency and its harmonics, separate from the base-frequency response, indicates that the brain discriminates the oddball category.

items.name: 互调频率标记
items.description: 刺激的两部分（如面孔左右两半）分别以不同频率 f1、f2 闪烁。互调频率（如 f1+f2）处的响应只能来自同时整合两路输入的神经群体，因此反映对各部分的整合。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two parts of a stimulus (for example the two halves of a face) flicker at different frequencies f1 and f2. Responses at intermodulation frequencies (such as f1+f2) can only arise from neural populations that integrate both inputs, and therefore index integration of the parts.

items.name: 伤害性稳态诱发电位
items.description: 以快速周期性热（激光）刺激皮肤（如 7 Hz），反复激活伤害感受器。脑电在刺激频率处出现稳态响应，其头皮分布不同于非伤害性振动触觉稳态响应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Rapid periodic thermal (laser) stimulation of the skin, for example at 7 Hz, activates nociceptors repeatedly. The EEG shows a steady-state response at the stimulation frequency with a topography different from non-nociceptive vibrotactile steady-state responses.

items.name: 节律性视觉刺激（α 夹带）
items.description: 在接近阈限的靶刺激之前呈现处于或接近 α 频率的节律性视觉刺激流，靶刺激相对于节律处于不同相位。被夹带的 α 振荡在刺激流结束后短暂持续，靶检测率随夹带节律的相位而变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: A rhythmic visual stream at or near the alpha frequency precedes a near-threshold target presented at different phases relative to the rhythm. Entrained alpha oscillations persist briefly after the stream, and target detection varies with the phase of the entrained rhythm.

items.name: 稳态运动视觉诱发电位
items.description: 目标以不同频率进行周期性运动（如振荡牛顿环、收缩—扩张棋盘格或移动光栅），且亮度变化很小。运动敏感视皮层跟随运动频率，产生稳态运动视觉诱发电位，视觉疲劳低于闪烁 SSVEP。
items.descriptionEnglish: Targets show periodic motion (for example oscillating Newton's rings, expanding-contracting checkerboards or moving gratings) at distinct frequencies with little luminance change. Motion-sensitive visual cortex follows the motion frequency, producing a steady-state motion VEP with less visual fatigue than flicker SSVEP.

items.name: 稳态体感诱发电位
items.description: 在被试静息时，以恒定频率（通常 20–30 Hz）对手指或手腕施加振动刺激。初级体感皮层在刺激频率及其谐波上产生响应，即稳态体感诱发电位，其幅度依赖刺激频率。
items.descriptionEnglish: Vibrotactile stimulation at a constant frequency (typically 20-30 Hz) is applied to a finger or wrist while the participant rests. Primary somatosensory cortex responds at the stimulation frequency and its harmonics, giving the steady-state somatosensory evoked potential, whose amplitude depends on the stimulation frequency.

items.name: 稳态触觉空间注意脑机接口
items.description: 双手（或双腕）同时接受两种不同频率的振动刺激。用户按指令注意左侧或右侧的振动；被注意一侧频率上的 SSSEP 增强，据此分类为二元指令。
items.descriptionEnglish: Both hands (or wrists) are stimulated at the same time with vibrations at two different frequencies. The user attends to the left or the right vibration as instructed; the SSSEP at the frequency of the attended side is enhanced, which is classified as a binary command.

items.name: 稳态视觉诱发电位范式
items.description: 被试被动观看以恒定频率调制的单一光源，各次运行改变频率。平均的枕区响应跟随刺激频率及其谐波；其幅度与相位随频率的变化刻画了稳态视觉诱发电位。
items.descriptionEnglish: A single light source modulated at a constant frequency is viewed passively, and the frequency is changed between runs. The averaged occipital response follows the stimulation frequency and its harmonics; its amplitude and phase as a function of frequency characterise the steady-state visual evoked potential.

items.name: 频率编码多目标 SSVEP 脑机接口
items.description: 多个目标同时闪烁，各有自己的频率。用户注视目标，枕区脑电频谱中占优势的频率对应的目标被选中并反馈给用户，通常在提示后经数秒刺激完成一次选择。
items.descriptionEnglish: Several targets flicker simultaneously, each at its own frequency. The user gazes at the desired target, and the target whose frequency dominates the occipital EEG spectrum is selected and fed back to the user, typically after a cue and a stimulation period of a few seconds.

items.name: 光驱动（临床间断闪光刺激）
items.description: 临床脑电检查中，置于患者前方的频闪灯以一系列固定频率给出闪光串，分别在睁眼和闭眼时进行。记录枕区节律在闪光频率及其谐波上的驱动，并筛查光阵发性反应。
items.descriptionEnglish: During a clinical EEG, a stroboscopic lamp in front of the patient delivers trains of flashes at a series of fixed frequencies, with the eyes open and closed. Driving of the occipital rhythm at the flash frequency and its harmonics is noted, and photoparoxysmal responses are screened for.

items.name: 并存刺激的频率标记注意
items.description: 同时呈现两个或多个刺激（如分别位于左右视野），各以自己的频率闪烁。被试注视中央，按提示隐蔽地注意其中一个；被注意刺激频率上的 SSVEP 增强，因此各标记频率追踪注意的分配。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two or more stimuli are shown at the same time, for example in the left and right visual hemifields, each flickering at its own frequency. Participants are cued to attend covertly to one of them while fixating centrally; the SSVEP at the frequency of the attended stimulus is enhanced, so the tagged frequencies track the allocation of attention.

items.name: 联合频率–相位调制 40 目标 SSVEP 拼写器
items.description: 虚拟键盘的 40 个字符同时闪烁，每个字符由唯一的频率（基准数据集中为 8–15.8 Hz，间隔 0.2 Hz）与相位组合标记。视觉提示后进入短暂闪烁期，用基于模板的空间滤波识别被注视的字符，在线拼写时显示为反馈。
items.descriptionEnglish: Forty characters of a virtual keyboard flicker simultaneously; each is tagged by a unique combination of frequency (8-15.8 Hz in 0.2 Hz steps in the benchmark dataset) and phase. A visual cue precedes a short flicker period, and the attended character is identified with template-based spatial filtering and shown as feedback in online spelling.

items.name: 含静息（非控制）类的频率编码 SSVEP
items.english: Frequency-coded SSVEP with a no-control (rest) class
items.description: 三个 LED 分别以 13、17、21 Hz 闪烁。听觉指令告诉用户注视哪一个 LED，或都不注视；静息试次构成明确的非控制类，分类器既要区分频率，也要拒识非意图时段。该配置用黎曼几何分类器进行了在线测试。
items.descriptionEnglish: Three LEDs flicker at 13, 17 and 21 Hz. An auditory instruction tells the user which LED to attend to, or to attend none of them; the resting trials form an explicit no-control class, so the classifier must reject non-intentional periods as well as discriminate the frequencies. The configuration was used online with Riemannian classifiers.

items.name: 异步（自定步调）SSVEP 脑机接口
items.description: 频率编码的目标持续闪烁，用户自行决定何时注视某个目标。系统先判断用户处于控制状态还是空闲状态，再判别被注视的频率，因此指令在用户自选的时刻发出，没有提示驱动的试次。
items.descriptionEnglish: Frequency-coded targets flicker continuously and the user decides when to look at a target. The system first detects whether the user is in a control state or an idle state and only then discriminates the attended frequency, so commands are issued at self-chosen times without cue-paced trials.

items.name: 扫描 VEP（视敏度评估）
items.description: 以固定速率翻转的图形刺激在数秒的单个试次中扫过一系列空间频率（或对比度）。将稳态 VEP 波幅对空间频率作图并外推至零，估计视敏度，例如用于婴儿。
items.descriptionEnglish: A pattern stimulus reversing at a fixed rate is swept through a range of spatial frequencies (or contrasts) within a single trial of several seconds. The amplitude of the steady-state VEP is plotted against spatial frequency and extrapolated to zero to estimate visual acuity, for example in infants.

items.name: 麻醉与意识水平
items.description: 在给予与撤除麻醉药（如丙泊酚）的过程中记录脑电，常以周期性的听觉或言语探测确定反应性的丧失与恢复。意识丧失伴随大幅慢波以及 α 功率向额区前移。
items.descriptionEnglish: EEG is recorded while an anaesthetic such as propofol is administered and withdrawn, often with periodic auditory or verbal probes to determine loss and return of responsiveness. Unconsciousness is accompanied by large slow waves and by anteriorization of alpha power toward frontal sites.

items.name: 睡眠慢振荡闭环听觉刺激
items.english: Closed-loop auditory stimulation of sleep slow oscillations
items.description: 在 NREM 睡眠期间实时监测脑电，并将短暂声音（如粉红噪声脉冲）锁相于慢振荡的上升态呈现。同相刺激增强慢振荡节律及与其相位耦合的纺锤波活动。
items.descriptionEnglish: During NREM sleep, the online EEG is monitored and brief sounds such as pink-noise bursts are delivered phase-locked to the up-states of slow oscillations. In-phase stimulation enhances the slow oscillation rhythm and phase-coupled spindle activity.

items.name: 系列唤醒梦境报告范式
items.description: 被试在不同睡眠阶段被声音反复唤醒，并被询问醒前是否有任何体验，比较有梦与无梦报告之前的脑电。梦境体验与后部皮层局部低频（慢波）活动降低有关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants are repeatedly awakened from different sleep stages by a sound and asked whether they were experiencing anything, and EEG preceding awakenings with and without dream reports is compared. Dream experience is associated with local decreases in low-frequency (slow-wave) activity over posterior cortex.

items.name: 模拟驾驶与持续警觉
items.description: 被试在驾驶模拟器中长时间驾驶，在随机出现的车道偏移事件中保持车辆居中；对每次偏移的反应时作为困倦程度的指标。困倦加深伴随 θ 与后部 α 功率升高。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants drive in a simulator for a prolonged session, keeping the vehicle in lane while random lane-departure events occur, and the reaction time to each event indexes drowsiness. Increasing drowsiness is accompanied by higher theta and posterior alpha power.

items.name: 连续模拟驾驶（眼动警觉标注）
items.english: Continuous simulated driving with eye-tracking vigilance labels
items.description: 被试在虚拟驾驶系统中进行长时间单调驾驶，不设离散的车道偏移事件；眼动眼镜计算 PERCLOS（眼睑闭合百分比），作为同步脑电的连续警觉标注。将脑电频段功率（尤其 θ 与 α）对连续警觉指标进行回归。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants drive in a virtual driving system for a long monotonous session without discrete lane-departure events, while eye-tracking glasses compute PERCLOS (percentage of eyelid closure) as a continuous vigilance label for the simultaneous EEG. EEG band power, notably theta and alpha, is regressed on the continuous vigilance index.

items.name: 自然视频与学习中的投入度
items.english: Engagement during naturalistic video and learning
items.description: 多名被试观看相同的影片片段或教学视频，有时通过重复或时间打乱降低投入度，并计算其神经反应的相似性。投入度以脑电被试间相关为指标，并伴随后部 α 功率降低。
items.descriptionEnglish: Groups of participants watch the same film clips or instructional videos, sometimes repeated or temporally scrambled to reduce engagement, and the similarity of their neural responses is computed. Engagement is indexed by inter-subject correlation of EEG, accompanied by reduced posterior alpha power.

items.name: 催眠诱导
items.description: 高、低催眠易感性的被试聆听标准化的催眠诱导，并与静息或对照条件（如记忆回忆）比较。催眠状态伴随背侧前扣带活动降低，以及前额叶与默认模式网络之间连接的改变。
items.descriptionEnglish: Highly and low hypnotizable participants listen to a standardized hypnotic induction and are compared with rest or control conditions such as memory recall. The hypnotic state is accompanied by reduced dorsal anterior cingulate activity and altered connectivity between prefrontal cortex and the default mode network.

items.name: 多属性任务组（MATB）
items.description: 被试在模拟驾驶舱中同时监视仪表、追踪目标、管理燃油资源并回应通信请求，工作负荷由子任务的速率和数量设定。负荷升高时额中线 θ 和前额叶 HbO 增加，后部 α 功率降低。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants simultaneously monitor gauges, track a target, manage fuel resources and respond to communication requests in a simulated cockpit, with workload set by the rate and number of subtasks. Higher workload increases frontal midline theta and prefrontal HbO and decreases posterior alpha power.

items.name: 冥想
items.description: 冥想者或受训新手进行数分钟的专注型、开放觉察型或其他冥想，并与走神或静息基线比较。冥想状态与后部 α 及额中线 θ 功率的变化有关。
items.descriptionEnglish: Practitioners or trained novices perform focused-attention, open-monitoring or other meditation for minutes, compared with mind-wandering or rest baselines. Meditation states are associated with changes in posterior alpha and frontal midline theta power.

items.name: 走神（思维探测采样）
items.description: 在单调的持续任务中，思维探测在随机时刻询问被试注意力是在任务上还是在别处，并比较“在任务”与“离任务”报告之前的神经活动。离任务期间任务刺激诱发的 P3b 减小，后部 α 增强，默认模式网络被激活。
items.descriptionEnglish: During a monotonous ongoing task, thought probes ask participants at random times whether their attention was on the task or elsewhere, and neural activity preceding on- and off-task reports is compared. Off-task periods show reduced P3b to task stimuli, increased posterior alpha and engagement of the default mode network.

items.name: 走神（自我觉察报告）
items.description: 在阅读等持续任务中，被试每当察觉自己的注意离开任务时就按键；比较这些自我觉察报告之前的时段与专注时段。该方法常与思维探测结合，以区分有觉察与无觉察的走神。走神时段伴随后部 α 增强与刺激诱发反应减弱。
items.descriptionEnglish: During an ongoing task such as reading, participants press a key whenever they notice that their attention has drifted away from the task, and the periods before these self-caught reports are compared with on-task periods; the method is often combined with thought probes to separate lapses with and without awareness. Off-task periods are accompanied by increased posterior alpha and reduced stimulus-evoked responses.

items.name: 脑电频段功率神经反馈
items.description: 实时提取目标脑电频段（如感觉运动节律或后部 α）的功率，以视觉、听觉显示或奖励信号的形式反馈；经过多次训练，被试学会使其朝目标方向变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Power in a target EEG frequency band, such as the sensorimotor rhythm or posterior alpha, is extracted in real time and fed back as a visual or auditory display or a reward signal, and over sessions the participant learns to change it in the target direction.

items.name: 血流动力学区域神经反馈（rtfMRI／fNIRS）
items.description: 实时计算预先选定的目标脑区的血流动力学信号并加以显示（如温度计条），被试在试图上调或下调该信号的组块与休息组块之间交替。习得的调节由目标脑区本身读出，如情绪调节训练中的杏仁核。
items.descriptionEnglish: The haemodynamic signal of a predefined target region is computed in real time and shown, for example as a thermometer bar, while participants alternate between blocks in which they try to up- or down-regulate it and rest blocks. Learned regulation is read out from the target region itself, such as the amygdala in emotion-regulation training.

items.name: 致幻剂药物状态
items.description: 在被试内设计中，给予 LSD 或裸盖菇素等致幻剂后记录静息态脑活动，并与安慰剂比较。致幻状态伴随后部 α 功率降低和默认模式网络整合性下降。
items.descriptionEnglish: Brain activity is recorded at rest after administration of a psychedelic such as LSD or psilocybin and compared with placebo in a within-subject design. The psychedelic state is accompanied by decreased posterior alpha power and reduced integrity of the default mode network.

items.name: 精神运动警觉任务（PVT）
items.description: 在 3–10 分钟的测试中，简单视觉刺激（如毫秒计数器）以数秒的随机间隔出现，被试尽快反应；反应失误和变慢反映警觉下降，尤其在睡眠不足后。反应变慢之前 θ 与后部 α 功率升高。
items.descriptionEnglish: A simple visual stimulus such as a millisecond counter appears at random intervals of a few seconds over a 3-10 minute session, and participants respond as fast as possible; lapses and slowing index reduced vigilance, particularly after sleep loss. Slower responses are preceded by increased theta and posterior alpha power.

items.name: 静息态（单一连续条件）
items.description: 被试在单一条件下安静休息数分钟，不执行任务，闭眼或睁眼注视十字。自发波动揭示默认模式网络等功能网络，闭眼静息时后部 α 明显。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants rest quietly without a task for several minutes in a single condition, either with eyes closed or with eyes open on a fixation cross. Spontaneous fluctuations reveal functional networks such as the default mode network, and eyes-closed rest shows strong posterior alpha.

items.name: 闭眼／睁眼交替静息
items.description: 被试不执行任务，在闭眼与睁眼组块之间交替休息，比较两种条件。睁眼使后部 α 功率被阻断（α 反应性），可用于快速检查信号质量，也作为静息态生物标志物。
items.descriptionEnglish: Participants rest without a task in alternating blocks with eyes closed and eyes open, and the two conditions are compared. Eye opening blocks posterior alpha power (alpha reactivity), which serves as a quick check of signal quality and as a resting biomarker.

items.name: 慢皮层电位自我调节训练（二分类）
items.description: 每个试次中，提示要求被试产生持续数秒的头顶慢皮层电位负向或正向偏移，SCP 以移动的光标或物体连续显示。被训练的信号就是慢皮层电位本身。
items.descriptionEnglish: On each trial a cue indicates whether the participant should produce a negative or a positive shift of the vertex slow cortical potential lasting several seconds, and the SCP is shown continuously as a moving cursor or object. The trained signal is the slow cortical potential itself.

items.name: 慢皮层电位拼写装置（思维翻译装置）
items.description: 已学会控制头顶慢皮层电位的使用者，通过负向或正向偏移来选择或拒绝屏幕上逐步缩小的字母组，以一连串二元选择拼出单词。每个选择区间内以视觉方式反馈 SCP。
items.descriptionEnglish: A person who has learned to control the vertex slow cortical potential uses negative or positive shifts to select or reject successively smaller groups of letters presented on a screen, so that binary selections spell words. Visual feedback shows the SCP during each selection interval.

items.name: 睡眠分期（Rechtschaffen & Kales 规则）
items.description: 整夜记录中央导联脑电及眼电、颏肌电，按 Rechtschaffen 与 Kales 规则以 30 秒为一帧判读为清醒、NREM 1–4 期与 REM 期。NREM 各期由睡眠纺锤波、K 复合波与慢波所占比例界定。
items.descriptionEnglish: Overnight EEG from central derivations, together with electro-oculogram and chin electromyogram, is scored in 30-s epochs into wake, NREM stages 1-4 and REM according to the Rechtschaffen and Kales rules. NREM stages are defined by sleep spindles, K-complexes and the proportion of slow waves.

items.name: 睡眠分期（AASM 规则）
items.description: 按美国睡眠医学会手册将整夜多导睡眠图以 30 秒一帧判读为清醒、N1、N2、N3 与 R 五期；该手册把原 3、4 期合并为 N3，并为慢波判读增加额区导联。目前多数自动睡眠分期模型以这一标注为目标。
items.descriptionEnglish: Overnight polysomnography is scored in 30-s epochs into five stages, wake, N1, N2, N3 and R, according to the American Academy of Sleep Medicine manual, which merges the former stages 3 and 4 into N3 and adds frontal EEG derivations for slow-wave scoring. These labels are the targets of most current automatic sleep-staging models.

items.name: 自适应（闭环）深部脑刺激
items.description: 在植入 DBS 电极的患者（通常为帕金森病丘脑底核）中，从刺激电极记录局部场电位，当生物标记物（通常为 β 频段功率）超过阈值时开启或调整刺激。丘脑底核 β 信号既是控制变量，也是结果指标。
items.descriptionEnglish: In patients with DBS electrodes (typically in the subthalamic nucleus for Parkinson's disease), local field potentials are recorded from the stimulating lead and stimulation is switched on or adjusted when a biomarker, usually beta-band power, exceeds a threshold. The subthalamic beta signal serves both as the control variable and as the outcome measure.

items.name: 皮层-皮层诱发电位
items.description: 在植入硬膜下或深部电极的患者中，向一对触点反复施加单个电脉冲，同时在其余所有触点记录响应。远隔部位的平均响应（早期 N1 和较晚的 N2 波）揭示从受刺激皮层出发的有效连接。
items.descriptionEnglish: In patients with implanted subdural or depth electrodes, single electrical pulses are delivered repeatedly to a pair of contacts while responses are recorded from all other contacts. Averaged responses at distant sites (an early N1 and a later N2 deflection) reveal effective connectivity from the stimulated cortex.

items.name: 深部脑刺激诱发电位
items.description: 通过植入电极（如丘脑底核）以短串或单脉冲方式施加深部脑刺激，同时从同一电极的非刺激触点和/或头皮脑电记录响应。刺激诱发高频、逐渐衰减的局部共振响应（ERNA）以及皮层诱发电位，其特征随电极位置而变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Deep brain stimulation is delivered through an implanted electrode (e.g. in the subthalamic nucleus) in short bursts or single pulses while responses are recorded from non-stimulating contacts of the same lead and/or from scalp EEG. Stimulation evokes a high-frequency, decaying resonant local response (ERNA) and cortical evoked potentials whose features vary with electrode location.

items.name: 直流电前庭刺激
items.description: 在双侧乳突电极之间施加弱电流，刺激前庭神经并产生倾斜或自身运动的感觉，并与伪刺激或皮肤对照刺激比较。刺激激活多感觉前庭皮层（后岛叶/顶-岛区域），并伴随视觉与体感区域的信号下降。
items.descriptionEnglish: Weak electrical current is applied between electrodes over the mastoid processes, stimulating the vestibular nerve and producing sensations of tilt or self-motion, compared with sham or cutaneous control stimulation. Stimulation activates multisensory vestibular cortex (posterior insula/parieto-insular regions) and is accompanied by signal decreases in visual and somatosensory areas.

items.name: 成对联合刺激
items.description: 将外周神经电刺激（通常为正中神经）与对侧运动皮层 TMS 以固定刺激间隔反复配对，使传入冲动与皮层脉冲同时到达或错开。该方案诱导依赖时序的皮层兴奋性改变；同步记录脑电时，通过 TMS 诱发电位以及决定配对时序的正中神经 SEP N20 评估其效应。
items.descriptionEnglish: Peripheral nerve stimulation (typically of the median nerve) is repeatedly paired with TMS of the contralateral motor cortex at a fixed interstimulus interval, so that the afferent volley and the cortical pulse coincide or are offset. The protocol induces timing-dependent changes in cortical excitability; with concurrent EEG, effects are assessed through TMS-evoked potentials and the median-nerve SEP N20 that times the pairing.

items.name: 经颅光生物调节同步脑电
items.description: 在真刺激与伪刺激组块中，将近红外激光或 LED 光施加于头皮（通常在前额），并在刺激前、刺激中和刺激后记录脑电。主要报告的神经结果是相对于伪刺激的静息态 α、β 频段功率变化。
items.descriptionEnglish: Near-infrared laser or LED light is applied to the scalp (typically over the forehead) in active and sham blocks while the EEG is recorded before, during and after stimulation. Changes in resting-state alpha and beta band power relative to sham are the main reported neural outcome.

items.name: 脑电相位触发 TMS
items.description: 实时分析进行中的脑电，在目标节律（通常为感觉运动 mu 节律）的预设相位（如负峰与正峰）触发 TMS 脉冲，并与随机相位刺激比较。兴奋性与可塑性效应取决于脉冲施加时 mu 节律的相位。
items.descriptionEnglish: Ongoing EEG is analysed in real time and TMS pulses are triggered at a predefined phase of a target oscillation, typically the sensorimotor mu rhythm (e.g. negative peak vs positive peak), compared with random-phase stimulation. Excitability and plasticity effects depend on the phase of the mu rhythm at which pulses are delivered.

items.name: 正中神经体感诱发电位
items.description: 以低重复频率在腕部向正中神经施加短暂电脉冲，对数百次刺激的 EEG/MEG 响应进行平均。最早的皮层响应——对侧顶区头皮上的 N20——反映初级体感皮层的激活，用于临床评估并作为时间参照。
items.descriptionEnglish: Brief electrical pulses are applied to the median nerve at the wrist at a low repetition rate, and EEG/MEG responses are averaged over hundreds of stimuli. The earliest cortical response, the N20 over the contralateral parietal scalp, reflects activation of primary somatosensory cortex and is used clinically and as a timing reference.

items.name: 经颅交流电刺激同步脑电
items.english: Transcranial alternating current stimulation with EEG
items.description: 通过头皮电极施加选定频率（常为个体 α 频率）的弱正弦电流，在刺激前、刺激中和刺激后记录脑电，并与伪刺激比较。刺激可使进行中的节律与刺激频率相位对齐（夹带），刺激结束后该频段功率升高。
items.descriptionEnglish: A weak sinusoidal current at a chosen frequency (often the individual alpha frequency) is applied through scalp electrodes, and EEG is recorded before, during and after stimulation, compared with sham. Stimulation can phase-align ongoing oscillations at the stimulation frequency (entrainment) and is followed by an increase in power in the stimulated band after stimulation ends.

items.name: 经皮耳迷走神经刺激
items.description: 在外耳（耳甲艇）对迷走神经耳支施加电刺激，并与耳垂伪刺激比较，被试同时完成任务或静息。通过同时进行的 oddball 任务中 P3b 的波幅等指标评估其对去甲肾上腺素能系统的作用。
items.descriptionEnglish: Electrical stimulation is applied to the auricular branch of the vagus nerve at the outer ear (cymba conchae), compared with sham stimulation of the earlobe, while participants perform a task or rest. Effects on the noradrenergic system are assessed through the amplitude of the P3b in a concurrent oddball task, among other measures.

items.name: 经颅直流电刺激同步记录
items.english: Transcranial direct current stimulation with EEG / fNIRS
items.description: 在头皮电极之间施加数分钟的弱恒定电流（阳极或阴极），在刺激前、刺激中或刺激后记录脑活动，并与伪刺激比较。通过脑电频段功率变化（如感觉运动 mu ERD）以及受刺激区域下方的血流动力学响应评估依极性而定的兴奋性改变。
items.descriptionEnglish: A weak constant current (anodal or cathodal) is applied between scalp electrodes for several minutes, with brain activity recorded before, during or after stimulation and compared with sham. Polarity-dependent changes in excitability are assessed through band-power changes in EEG (for example of sensorimotor mu ERD) and haemodynamic responses under the stimulated region.

items.name: TMS 诱发脑电
items.description: 在使用兼容 TMS 的放大器记录脑电的同时，向皮层靶点施加单个 TMS 脉冲，并对多次脉冲的响应进行平均。由此得到的 TMS 诱发电位是刺激后数百毫秒内由受刺激部位向外扩散的一系列波，反映局部皮层反应性与有效连接。
items.descriptionEnglish: Single TMS pulses are delivered to a cortical target while EEG is recorded with TMS-compatible amplifiers, and responses are averaged across pulses. The resulting TMS-evoked potential, a series of deflections over the first few hundred milliseconds that spreads from the stimulated site, indexes local cortical reactivity and effective connectivity.

items.name: 时间干涉电刺激
items.description: 通过两组独立的头皮电极施加频率略有差异的两路高频交流电，二者干涉在差频处形成包络，并在深部靶点（如海马）达到最大。通过任务期间靶区 BOLD 响应并与对照刺激比较，评估对靶点的作用。
items.descriptionEnglish: Two high-frequency alternating currents with slightly different frequencies are applied through separate scalp electrode pairs, so that their interference produces an envelope at the difference frequency that is maximal in a deep target (e.g. the hippocampus). Target engagement is assessed with BOLD responses in the targeted region during a task, compared with control stimulation.

items.name: TMS 与功能磁共振同步
items.description: 在磁共振扫描仪内与图像采集交错施加 TMS 单脉冲或短串，变化刺激强度或部位（包括伪刺激）。测量受刺激皮层及远隔连接区域的 BOLD 响应，以评估刺激的局部与网络效应。
items.descriptionEnglish: TMS pulses or short trains are delivered inside the MRI scanner, interleaved with image acquisition, at different intensities or sites (including sham). BOLD responses are measured at the stimulated cortex and in remote, connected regions, providing a measure of local and network effects of stimulation.

items.name: 经颅超声刺激
items.description: 经颅骨向皮层或深部靶点施加低强度聚焦超声，可单独施加或与感觉刺激锁时，并与伪刺激或非靶点刺激比较。效应以体感诱发电位的变化（如靶向 S1 时对正中神经刺激的响应）或受刺激区域及其连接区域的 BOLD 响应来测量。
items.descriptionEnglish: Low-intensity focused ultrasound is delivered through the skull to a cortical or deep target, either alone or time-locked to a sensory stimulus, and compared with sham or off-target sonication. Effects are measured as changes in somatosensory evoked potentials (e.g. to median-nerve stimulation when targeting S1) or as BOLD responses at and connected to the sonicated region.

items.name: 肌腱振动运动错觉
items.description: 对静止肢体的肌腱施加高频振动（约 80-110 Hz），激活肌梭传入并产生肢体在运动的错觉，并与不引起错觉的邻近皮肤部位振动比较。运动错觉激活包括初级运动皮层、辅助运动区和小脑在内的运动网络。
items.descriptionEnglish: High-frequency vibration (around 80-110 Hz) is applied to a tendon of a stationary limb, which activates muscle spindle afferents and produces an illusion that the limb is moving, compared with vibration of a nearby skin site that does not induce the illusion. Illusory movement activates motor network regions including primary motor cortex, SMA and cerebellum.
